verses.textZh: 奉神旨意蒙召作基督耶稣使徒的保罗，和苏提尼弟兄，
verses.textZhCnvs: 奉神旨意蒙召作基督耶稣使徒的保罗，和苏提尼弟兄，
verses.textZhCuv: 奉神旨意，蒙召作耶稣基督使徒的保罗，同兄弟所提尼，
verses.textEnNiv: Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,
verses.textEnEsv: Paul, called by the will of God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and our brother Sosthenes,
verses.textEnNkjv: Paul, called tobe an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from Paul, chosen by the will of God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from our brother Sosthenes.
verses.textEnNasb: Paul, called as an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,
verses.textEn: Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

verses.textZh: 写信给在哥林多神的教会，就是在基督耶稣里已经被分别为圣，蒙召为圣徒的人，和所有在各地呼求我们主耶稣基督的名的人。基督是他们的主，也是我们的主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 写信给在哥林多神的教会，就是在基督耶稣里已经被分别为圣，蒙召为圣徒的人，和所有在各地呼求我们主耶稣基督的名的人。基督是他们的主，也是我们的主。
verses.textZhCuv: 写信给在哥林多神的教会，就是在基督耶稣里成圣、蒙召作圣徒的，以及所有在各处求告我主耶稣基督之名的人。基督是他们的主，也是我们的主。
verses.textEnNiv: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be his holy people, together with all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ—their Lord and ours:
verses.textEnEsv: To the church of God that is in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints together with all those who in every place call upon the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, both their Lord and ours:
verses.textEnNkjv: To the church of God which is at Corinth, to those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called tobe saints, with all who in every place call on the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:
verses.textEnNlt: I am writing to God’s church in Corinth, to you who have been called by God to be his own holy people. He made you holy by means of Christ Jesus, just as he did for all people everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours.
verses.textEnNasb: To the church of God which is in Corinth, to those who have been sanctified in Christ Jesus, saints by calling, with all who in every place call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours:
verses.textEn: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be his holy people, together with all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ—their Lord and ours:

verses.textZh: 愿恩惠平安从我们的父神和主耶稣基督临到你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿恩惠平安从我们的父神和主耶稣基督临到你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿恩惠、平安从神我们的父并主耶稣基督归与你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.
verses.textEnNasb: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 我因着神在基督耶稣里赐给你们的恩典，常常为你们感谢我的神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我因着神在基督耶稣里赐给你们的恩典，常常为你们感谢我的神，
verses.textZhCuv: 我常为你们感谢我的神，因神在基督耶稣里所赐给你们的恩惠；
verses.textEnNiv: I always thank my God for you because of his grace given you in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: I give thanks to my God always for you because of the grace of God that was given you in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnNkjv: I thank my God always concerning you for the grace of God which was given to you by Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnNlt: I always thank my God for you and for the gracious gifts he has given you, now that you belong to Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: I thank my God always concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEn: I always thank my God for you because of his grace given you in Christ Jesus.

verses.textZh: 因为你们在他里面凡事都富足，很有口才，知识丰富，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们在他里面凡事都富足，很有口才，知识丰富，
verses.textZhCuv: 又因你们在他里面凡事富足，口才、知识都全备，
verses.textEnNiv: For in him you have been enriched in every way—with all kinds of speech and with all knowledge—
verses.textEnEsv: that in every way you were enriched in him in all speech and all knowledge—
verses.textEnNkjv: that you were enriched in everything by Him in all utterance and all knowledge,
verses.textEnNlt: Through him, God has enriched your church in every way—with all of your eloquent words and all of your knowledge.
verses.textEnNasb: that in everything you were enriched in Him, in all speech and all knowledge,
verses.textEn: For in him you have been enriched in every way—with all kinds of speech and with all knowledge—

verses.textZh: 就如我们为基督所作的见证在你们中间得到坚立一样，
verses.textZhCnvs: 就如我们为基督所作的见证在你们中间得到坚立一样，
verses.textZhCuv: 正如我为基督作的见证，在你们心里得以坚固，
verses.textEnNiv: God thus confirming our testimony about Christ among you.
verses.textEnEsv: even as the testimony about Christ was confirmed among you—
verses.textEnNkjv: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you,
verses.textEnNlt: This confirms that what I told you about Christ is true.
verses.textEnNasb: just as the testimony concerning Christ was confirmed in you,
verses.textEn: God thus confirming our testimony about Christ among you.

verses.textZh: 以致你们在恩赐上一无所缺，殷切盼望着我们主耶稣基督的显现；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以致你们在恩赐上一无所缺，殷切盼望着我们主耶稣基督的显现；
verses.textZhCuv: 以致你们在恩赐上没有一样不及人的，等候我们的主耶稣基督显现。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore you do not lack any spiritual gift as you eagerly wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to be revealed.
verses.textEnEsv: so that you are not lacking in any gift, as you wait for the revealing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNkjv: so that you come short in no gift, eagerly waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNlt: Now you have every spiritual gift you need as you eagerly wait for the return of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: so that you are not lacking in any gift, as you eagerly await the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEn: Therefore you do not lack any spiritual gift as you eagerly wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to be revealed.

verses.textZh: 他也必坚定你们到底，使你们在我们主耶稣基督的日子无可指摘。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他也必坚定你们到底，使你们在我们主耶稣基督的日子无可指摘。
verses.textZhCuv: 他也必坚固你们到底，叫你们在我们主耶稣基督的日子无可责备。
verses.textEnNiv: He will also keep you firm to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: who will sustain you to the end, guiltless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: who will also confirm you to the end, thatyoumaybe blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: He will keep you strong to the end so that you will be free from all blame on the day when our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
verses.textEnNasb: who will also confirm you to the end, blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: He will also keep you firm to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 神是信实的，他呼召了你们，是要你们与他的儿子我们主耶稣基督连合在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神是信实的，他呼召了你们，是要你们与他的儿子我们主耶稣基督连合在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 神是信实的，你们原是被他所召，好与他儿子－我们的主耶稣基督一同得分。
verses.textEnNiv: God is faithful, who has called you into fellowship with his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: God is faithful, by whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: God is faithful, by whom you were called into the fellowship of His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: God will do this, for he is faithful to do what he says, and he has invited you into partnership with his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: God is faithful, through whom you were called into fellowship with His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.textEn: God is faithful, who has called you into fellowship with his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我凭着我们主耶稣基督的名，劝你们大家要同心，在你们中间不要分党，只要在同一的心思、同一的意念上团结起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我凭着我们主耶稣基督的名，劝你们大家要同心，在你们中间不要分党，只要在同一的心思、同一的意念上团结起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我藉我们主耶稣基督的名劝你们都说一样的话。你们中间也不可分党，只要一心一意，彼此相合。
verses.textEnNiv: I appeal to you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree with one another in what you say and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfectly united in mind and thought.
verses.textEnEsv: I appeal to you, brothers, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be united in the same mind and the same judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I plead with you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: I appeal to you, dear brothers and sisters, by the authority of our Lord Jesus Christ, to live in harmony with each other. Let there be no divisions in the church. Rather, be of one mind, united in thought and purpose.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you all agree and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be made complete in the same mind and in the same judgment.
verses.textEn: I appeal to you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree with one another in what you say and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfectly united in mind and thought.

verses.textZh: 我的弟兄们，革来氏家里的人向我提到你们，说你们中间有纷争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的弟兄们，革来氏家里的人向我提到你们，说你们中间有纷争。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为革来氏家里的人曾对我提起弟兄们来，说你们中间有纷争。
verses.textEnNiv: My brothers and sisters, some from Chloe’s household have informed me that there are quarrels among you.
verses.textEnEsv: For it has been reported to me by Chloe’s people that there is quarreling among you, my brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: For it has been declared to me concerning you, my brethren, by those of Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.
verses.textEnNlt: For some members of Chloe’s household have told me about your quarrels, my dear brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnNasb: For I have been informed concerning you, my brothers and sisters, by Chloe’s people, that there are quarrels among you.
verses.textEn: My brothers and sisters, some from Chloe’s household have informed me that there are quarrels among you.

verses.textZh: 我的意思就是，你们各人说，我是保罗派的，我是亚波罗派的，我是矶法派的，我是基督派的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的意思就是，你们各人说，我是保罗派的，我是亚波罗派的，我是矶法派的，我是基督派的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的意思就是你们各人说：「我是属保罗的」；「我是属亚波罗的」；「我是属矶法的」；「我是属基督的」。
verses.textEnNiv: What I mean is this: One of you says, "I follow Paul"; another, "I follow Apollos"; another, "I follow Cephas "; still another, "I follow Christ."
verses.textEnEsv: What I mean is that each one of you says, "I follow Paul," or "I follow Apollos," or "I follow Cephas," or "I follow Christ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I say this, that each of you says, "I am of Paul," or "I am of Apollos," or "I am of Cephas," or "I am of Christ."
verses.textEnNlt: Some of you are saying, "I am a follower of Paul." Others are saying, "I follow Apollos," or "I follow Peter, " or "I follow only Christ."
verses.textEnNasb: Now I mean this, that each one of you is saying, "I am with Paul," or "I am with Apollos," or "I am with Cephas," or "I am with Christ."
verses.textEn: What I mean is this: One of you says, "I follow Paul"; another, "I follow Apollos"; another, "I follow Cephas "; still another, "I follow Christ."

verses.textZh: 基督是分开的吗？保罗为你们钉了十字架吗？你们受洗是归入保罗的名下吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 基督是分开的吗？保罗为你们钉了十字架吗？你们受洗是归入保罗的名下吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 基督是分开的吗？保罗为你们钉了十字架吗？你们是奉保罗的名受了洗吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Were you baptized in the name of Paul?
verses.textEnEsv: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized in the name of Paul?
verses.textEnNkjv: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized in the name of Paul?
verses.textEnNlt: Has Christ been divided into factions? Was I, Paul, crucified for you? Were any of you baptized in the name of Paul? Of course not!
verses.textEnNasb: Has Christ been divided? Paul was not crucified for you, was he? Or were you baptized in the name of Paul?
verses.textEn: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Were you baptized in the name of Paul?

verses.textZh: 我感谢神，除了基利司布和该犹以外，我没有给你们任何人施过洗，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我感谢神，除了基利司布和该犹以外，我没有给你们任何人施过洗，
verses.textZhCuv: 我感谢神，除了基利司布并该犹以外，我没有给你们一个人施洗，
verses.textEnNiv: I thank God that I did not baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius,
verses.textEnEsv: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,
verses.textEnNkjv: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,
verses.textEnNlt: I thank God that I did not baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius,
verses.textEnNasb: I am thankful that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,
verses.textEn: I thank God that I did not baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius,

verses.textZh: 所以你们没有人可以说是受洗归入我名下的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们没有人可以说是受洗归入我名下的。
verses.textZhCuv: 免得有人说，你们是奉我的名受洗。
verses.textEnNiv: so no one can say that you were baptized in my name.
verses.textEnEsv: so that no one may say that you were baptized in my name.
verses.textEnNkjv: lest anyone should say that I had baptized in my own name.
verses.textEnNlt: for now no one can say they were baptized in my name.
verses.textEnNasb: so that no one would say you were baptized in my name!
verses.textEn: so no one can say that you were baptized in my name.

verses.textZh: 我也给司提反一家的人施过洗；此外，有没有给别人施过洗，我就不记得了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也给司提反一家的人施过洗；此外，有没有给别人施过洗，我就不记得了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也给司提反家施过洗，此外给别人施洗没有，我却记不清。
verses.textEnNiv: (Yes, I also baptized the household of Stephanas; beyond that, I don’t remember if I baptized anyone else.)
verses.textEnEsv: (I did baptize also the household of Stephanas. Beyond that, I do not know whether I baptized anyone else.)
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, I also baptized the household of Stephanas. Besides, I do not know whether I baptized any other.
verses.textEnNlt: (Oh yes, I also baptized the household of Stephanas, but I don’t remember baptizing anyone else.)
verses.textEnNasb: But I did baptize the household of Stephanas also; beyond that, I do not know if I baptized anyone else.
verses.textEn: (Yes, I also baptized the household of Stephanas; beyond that, I don’t remember if I baptized anyone else.)

verses.textZh: 基督差遣我，不是要我去施洗，而是去传福音；不是靠着智慧的言论去传，免得基督的十字架失去了效力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基督差遣我，不是要我去施洗，而是去传福音；不是靠着智慧的言论去传，免得基督的十字架失去了效力。
verses.textZhCuv: 基督差遣我，原不是为施洗，乃是为传福音，并不用智慧的言语，免得基督的十字架落了空。
verses.textEnNiv: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel—not with wisdom and eloquence, lest the cross of Christ be emptied of its power.
verses.textEnEsv: For Christ did not send me to baptize but to preach the gospel, and not with words of eloquent wisdom, lest the cross of Christ be emptied of its power.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel, not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of no effect.
verses.textEnNlt: For Christ didn’t send me to baptize, but to preach the Good News—and not with clever speech, for fear that the cross of Christ would lose its power.
verses.textEnNasb: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel, not with cleverness of speech, so that the cross of Christ would not be made of no effect.
verses.textEn: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel—not with wisdom and eloquence, lest the cross of Christ be emptied of its power.

verses.textZh: 因为十字架的道理，对走向灭亡的人来说是愚笨的，但对我们这些得救的人，却是神的大能。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为十字架的道理，对走向灭亡的人来说是愚笨的，但对我们这些得救的人，却是神的大能。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为十字架的道理，在那灭亡的人为愚拙；在我们得救的人，却为神的大能。
verses.textEnNiv: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
verses.textEnEsv: For the word of the cross is folly to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
verses.textEnNlt: The message of the cross is foolish to those who are headed for destruction! But we who are being saved know it is the very power of God.
verses.textEnNasb: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
verses.textEn: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

verses.textZh: 因为经上记着说： "我要灭绝智慧人的智慧， 废弃聪明人的聪明。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为经上记着说： "我要灭绝智慧人的智慧， 废弃聪明人的聪明。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就如经上所记： 我要灭绝智慧人的智慧， 废弃聪明人的聪明。
verses.textEnNiv: For it is written: "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise; the intelligence of the intelligent I will frustrate."
verses.textEnEsv: For it is written, "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and the discernment of the discerning I will thwart."
verses.textEnNkjv: For it is written: "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, And bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent."
verses.textEnNlt: As the Scriptures say, "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise and discard the intelligence of the intelligent."
verses.textEnNasb: For it is written: "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, And the understanding of those who have understanding, I will confound."
verses.textEn: For it is written: "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise; the intelligence of the intelligent I will frustrate."

verses.textZh: 智慧人在哪里？经学家在哪里？今世的辩士在哪里？神不是使属世的智慧变成了愚笨吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧人在哪里？经学家在哪里？今世的辩士在哪里？神不是使属世的智慧变成了愚笨吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人在哪里？文士在哪里？这世上的辩士在哪里？神岂不是叫这世上的智慧变成愚拙吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Where is the wise person? Where is the teacher of the law? Where is the philosopher of this age? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?
verses.textEnEsv: Where is the one who is wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?
verses.textEnNkjv: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the disputer of this age? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
verses.textEnNlt: So where does this leave the philosophers, the scholars, and the world’s brilliant debaters? God has made the wisdom of this world look foolish.
verses.textEnNasb: Where is the wise person? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Has God not made foolish the wisdom of the world?
verses.textEn: Where is the wise person? Where is the teacher of the law? Where is the philosopher of this age? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?

verses.textZh: 因为在神的智慧里，世人凭自己的智慧，既然不能认识神，神就乐意借着所传的愚笨的道理，去拯救那些信的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为在神的智慧里，世人凭自己的智慧，既然不能认识神，神就乐意借着所传的愚笨的道理，去拯救那些信的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 世人凭自己的智慧，既不认识神，神就乐意用人所当作愚拙的道理拯救那些信的人；这就是神的智慧了。
verses.textEnNiv: For since in the wisdom of God the world through its wisdom did not know him, God was pleased through the foolishness of what was preached to save those who believe.
verses.textEnEsv: For since, in the wisdom of God, the world did not know God through wisdom, it pleased God through the folly of what we preach to save those who believe.
verses.textEnNkjv: For since, in the wisdom of God, the world through wisdom did not know God, it pleased God through the foolishness of the message preached to save those who believe.
verses.textEnNlt: Since God in his wisdom saw to it that the world would never know him through human wisdom, he has used our foolish preaching to save those who believe.
verses.textEnNasb: For since in the wisdom of God the world through its wisdom did not come to know God, God was pleased through the foolishness of the message preached to save those who believe.
verses.textEn: For since in the wisdom of God the world through its wisdom did not know him, God was pleased through the foolishness of what was preached to save those who believe.

verses.textZh: 犹太人要求神迹，希腊人寻找智慧，
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人要求神迹，希腊人寻找智慧，
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人是要神迹，希腊人是求智慧，
verses.textEnNiv: Jews demand signs and Greeks look for wisdom,
verses.textEnEsv: For Jews demand signs and Greeks seek wisdom,
verses.textEnNkjv: For Jews request a sign, and Greeks seek after wisdom;
verses.textEnNlt: It is foolish to the Jews, who ask for signs from heaven. And it is foolish to the Greeks, who seek human wisdom.
verses.textEnNasb: For indeed Jews ask for signs and Greeks search for wisdom;
verses.textEn: Jews demand signs and Greeks look for wisdom,

verses.textZh: 我们却传扬钉十字架的基督；在犹太人看来是绊脚石，在外族人看来是愚笨的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们却传扬钉十字架的基督；在犹太人看来是绊脚石，在外族人看来是愚笨的，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们却是传钉在十字架的基督，在犹太人为绊脚石，在外邦人为愚拙；
verses.textEnNiv: but we preach Christ crucified: a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles,
verses.textEnEsv: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and folly to Gentiles,
verses.textEnNkjv: but we preach Christ crucified, to the Jews a stumbling block and to the Greeks foolishness,
verses.textEnNlt: So when we preach that Christ was crucified, the Jews are offended and the Gentiles say it’s all nonsense.
verses.textEnNasb: but we preach Christ crucified, to Jews a stumbling block, and to Gentiles foolishness,
verses.textEn: but we preach Christ crucified: a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles,

verses.textZh: 但对那些蒙召的人，不论是犹太人或希腊人，基督是神的能力，神的智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但对那些蒙召的人，不论是犹太人或希腊人，基督是神的能力，神的智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 但在那蒙召的，无论是犹太人、希腊人，基督总为神的能力，神的智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: but to those whom God has called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.
verses.textEnEsv: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.
verses.textEnNlt: But to those called by God to salvation, both Jews and Gentiles, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God.
verses.textEnNasb: but to those who are the called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.
verses.textEn: but to those whom God has called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.

verses.textZh: 因为神的愚笨总比人智慧，神的软弱总比人刚强。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神的愚笨总比人智慧，神的软弱总比人刚强。
verses.textZhCuv: 因神的愚拙总比人智慧，神的软弱总比人强壮。
verses.textEnNiv: For the foolishness of God is wiser than human wisdom, and the weakness of God is stronger than human strength.
verses.textEnEsv: For the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
verses.textEnNlt: This foolish plan of God is wiser than the wisest of human plans, and God’s weakness is stronger than the greatest of human strength.
verses.textEnNasb: For the foolishness of God is wiser than mankind, and the weakness of God is stronger than mankind.
verses.textEn: For the foolishness of God is wiser than human wisdom, and the weakness of God is stronger than human strength.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，你们想想，你们这些蒙召的，按人 来看有智慧的不多，有权势的不多，出身尊贵的也不多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，你们想想，你们这些蒙召的，按人 来看有智慧的不多，有权势的不多，出身尊贵的也不多。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们哪，可见你们蒙召的，按着肉体有智慧的不多，有能力的不多，有尊贵的也不多。
verses.textEnNiv: Brothers and sisters, think of what you were when you were called. Not many of you were wise by human standards; not many were influential; not many were of noble birth.
verses.textEnEsv: For consider your calling, brothers: not many of you were wise according to worldly standards, not many were powerful, not many were of noble birth.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you see your calling, brethren, that not many wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, arecalled.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember, dear brothers and sisters, that few of you were wise in the world’s eyes or powerful or wealthy when God called you.
verses.textEnNasb: For consider your calling, brothers and sisters, that there were not many wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble;
verses.textEn: Brothers and sisters, think of what you were when you were called. Not many of you were wise by human standards; not many were influential; not many were of noble birth.

verses.textZh: 但是神却拣选了世上愚笨的，使那些有智慧的羞愧。他也拣选了世上软弱的，使那些刚强的羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是神却拣选了世上愚笨的，使那些有智慧的羞愧。他也拣选了世上软弱的，使那些刚强的羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 神却拣选了世上愚拙的，叫有智慧的羞愧；又拣选了世上软弱的，叫那强壮的羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.
verses.textEnEsv: But God chose what is foolish in the world to shame the wise; God chose what is weak in the world to shame the strong;
verses.textEnNkjv: But God has chosen the foolish things of the world to put to shame the wise, and God has chosen the weak things of the world to put to shame the things which are mighty;
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, God chose things the world considers foolish in order to shame those who think they are wise. And he chose things that are powerless to shame those who are powerful.
verses.textEnNasb: but God has chosen the foolish things of the world to shame the wise, and God has chosen the weak things of the world to shame the things which are strong,
verses.textEn: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.

verses.textZh: 他也拣选了世上卑贱的和被人轻视的，以及算不得甚么的，为了要废弃那些自以为是的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他也拣选了世上卑贱的和被人轻视的，以及算不得甚么的，为了要废弃那些自以为是的，
verses.textZhCuv: 神也拣选了世上卑贱的，被人厌恶的，以及那无有的，为要废掉那有的，
verses.textEnNiv: God chose the lowly things of this world and the despised things—and the things that are not—to nullify the things that are,
verses.textEnEsv: God chose what is low and despised in the world, even things that are not, to bring to nothing things that are,
verses.textEnNkjv: and the base things of the world and the things which are despised God has chosen, and the things which are not, to bring to nothing the things that are,
verses.textEnNlt: God chose things despised by the world, things counted as nothing at all, and used them to bring to nothing what the world considers important.
verses.textEnNasb: and the insignificant things of the world and the despised God has chosen, the things that are not, so that He may nullify the things that are,
verses.textEn: God chose the lowly things of this world and the despised things—and the things that are not—to nullify the things that are,

verses.textZh: 使所有的人在神面前都不能自夸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使所有的人在神面前都不能自夸。
verses.textZhCuv: 使一切有血气的，在神面前一个也不能自夸。
verses.textEnNiv: so that no one may boast before him.
verses.textEnEsv: so that no human being might boast in the presence of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: that no flesh should glory in His presence.
verses.textEnNlt: As a result, no one can ever boast in the presence of God.
verses.textEnNasb: so that no human may boast before God.
verses.textEn: so that no one may boast before him.

verses.textZh: 你们因着神得以在基督耶稣里，他使基督成了我们的智慧；就是公义、圣洁和救赎，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们因着神得以在基督耶稣里，他使基督成了我们的智慧；就是公义、圣洁和救赎，
verses.textZhCuv: 但你们得在基督耶稣里是本乎神，神又使他成为我们的智慧、公义、圣洁、救赎。
verses.textEnNiv: It is because of him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God—that is, our righteousness, holiness and redemption.
verses.textEnEsv: And because of him you are in Christ Jesus, who became to us wisdom from God, righteousness and sanctification and redemption,
verses.textEnNkjv: But of Him you are in Christ Jesus, who became for us wisdom from God—and righteousness and sanctification and redemption—
verses.textEnNlt: God has united you with Christ Jesus. For our benefit God made him to be wisdom itself. Christ made us right with God; he made us pure and holy, and he freed us from sin.
verses.textEnNasb: But it is due to Him that you are in Christ Jesus, who became to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,
verses.textEn: It is because of him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God—that is, our righteousness, holiness and redemption.

verses.textZh: 正如经上所说的： "夸口的应当靠着主夸口。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如经上所说的： "夸口的应当靠着主夸口。"
verses.textZhCuv: 如经上所记：「夸口的，当指着主夸口。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, as it is written: "Let the one who boasts boast in the Lord."
verses.textEnEsv: so that, as it is written, "Let the one who boasts, boast in the Lord."
verses.textEnNkjv: that, as it is written, "He who glories, let him glory in the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, as the Scriptures say, "If you want to boast, boast only about the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: so that, just as it is written: "Let the one who boasts, boast in the Lord."
verses.textEn: Therefore, as it is written: "Let the one who boasts boast in the Lord."

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我从前到你们那里去，并没有用高言大智向你们传讲神的奥秘。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我从前到你们那里去，并没有用高言大智向你们传讲神的奥秘。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，从前我到你们那里去，并没有用高言大智对你们宣传神的奥秘。
verses.textEnNiv: And so it was with me, brothers and sisters. When I came to you, I did not come with eloquence or human wisdom as I proclaimed to you the testimony about God.
verses.textEnEsv: And I, when I came to you, brothers, did not come proclaiming to you the testimony of God with lofty speech or wisdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I, brethren, when I came to you, did not come with excellence of speech or of wisdom declaring to you the testimony of God.
verses.textEnNlt: When I first came to you, dear brothers and sisters, I didn’t use lofty words and impressive wisdom to tell you God’s secret plan.
verses.textEnNasb: And when I came to you, brothers and sisters, I did not come as someone superior in speaking ability or wisdom, as I proclaimed to you the testimony of God.
verses.textEn: And so it was with me, brothers and sisters. When I came to you, I did not come with eloquence or human wisdom as I proclaimed to you the testimony about God.

verses.textZh: 因为我曾立定主意，在你们中间甚么都不想知道，只知道耶稣基督和他钉十字架的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我曾立定主意，在你们中间甚么都不想知道，只知道耶稣基督和他钉十字架的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我曾定了主意，在你们中间不知道别的，只知道耶稣基督并他钉十字架。
verses.textEnNiv: For I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.
verses.textEnEsv: For I decided to know nothing among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and Him crucified.
verses.textEnNlt: For I decided that while I was with you I would forget everything except Jesus Christ, the one who was crucified.
verses.textEnNasb: For I determined to know nothing among you except Jesus Christ, and Him crucified.
verses.textEn: For I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

verses.textZh: 我在你们那里的时候，又软弱又惧怕，而且战战兢兢；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在你们那里的时候，又软弱又惧怕，而且战战兢兢；
verses.textZhCuv: 我在你们那里，又软弱，又惧怕又甚战兢。
verses.textEnNiv: I came to you in weakness with great fear and trembling.
verses.textEnEsv: And I was with you in weakness and in fear and much trembling,
verses.textEnNkjv: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.
verses.textEnNlt: I came to you in weakness—timid and trembling.
verses.textEnNasb: I also was with you in weakness and fear, and in great trembling,
verses.textEn: I came to you in weakness with great fear and trembling.

verses.textZh: 我说的话、讲的道，都不是用智慧的话去说服人，而是用圣灵和能力来证明，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说的话、讲的道，都不是用智慧的话去说服人，而是用圣灵和能力来证明，
verses.textZhCuv: 我说的话、讲的道，不是用智慧委婉的言语，乃是用圣灵和大能的明证，
verses.textEnNiv: My message and my preaching were not with wise and persuasive words, but with a demonstration of the Spirit’s power,
verses.textEnEsv: and my speech and my message were not in plausible words of wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,
verses.textEnNkjv: And my speech and my preaching were not with persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,
verses.textEnNlt: And my message and my preaching were very plain. Rather than using clever and persuasive speeches, I relied only on the power of the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: and my message and my preaching were not in persuasive words of wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,
verses.textEn: My message and my preaching were not with wise and persuasive words, but with a demonstration of the Spirit’s power,

verses.textZh: 使你们的信不是凭着人的智慧，而是凭着神的能力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使你们的信不是凭着人的智慧，而是凭着神的能力。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫你们的信不在乎人的智慧，只在乎神的大能。
verses.textEnNiv: so that your faith might not rest on human wisdom, but on God’s power.
verses.textEnEsv: so that your faith might not rest in the wisdom of men but in the power of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: that your faith should not be in the wisdom of men but in the power of God.
verses.textEnNlt: I did this so you would trust not in human wisdom but in the power of God.
verses.textEnNasb: so that your faith would not rest on the wisdom of mankind, but on the power of God.
verses.textEn: so that your faith might not rest on human wisdom, but on God’s power.

verses.textZh: 然而在信心成熟的人中间，我们也讲智慧，但不是这世代的智慧，也不是这世代将要灭亡的执政者的智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而在信心成熟的人中间，我们也讲智慧，但不是这世代的智慧，也不是这世代将要灭亡的执政者的智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，在完全的人中，我们也讲智慧。但不是这世上的智慧，也不是这世上有权有位、将要败亡之人的智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: We do, however, speak a message of wisdom among the mature, but not the wisdom of this age or of the rulers of this age, who are coming to nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet among the mature we do impart wisdom, although it is not a wisdom of this age or of the rulers of this age, who are doomed to pass away.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, we speak wisdom among those who are mature, yet not the wisdom of this age, nor of the rulers of this age, who are coming to nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet when I am among mature believers, I do speak with words of wisdom, but not the kind of wisdom that belongs to this world or to the rulers of this world, who are soon forgotten.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet we do speak wisdom among those who are mature; a wisdom, however, not of this age nor of the rulers of this age, who are passing away;
verses.textEn: We do, however, speak a message of wisdom among the mature, but not the wisdom of this age or of the rulers of this age, who are coming to nothing.

verses.textZh: 我们所讲的，是从前隐藏的、神奥秘的智慧，就是神在万世以前，为我们的荣耀所预定的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们所讲的，是从前隐藏的、神奥秘的智慧，就是神在万世以前，为我们的荣耀所预定的；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们讲的，乃是从前所隐藏、神奥秘的智慧，就是神在万世以前预定使我们得荣耀的。
verses.textEnNiv: No, we declare God’s wisdom, a mystery that has been hidden and that God destined for our glory before time began.
verses.textEnEsv: But we impart a secret and hidden wisdom of God, which God decreed before the ages for our glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery, the hidden wisdom which God ordained before the ages for our glory,
verses.textEnNlt: No, the wisdom we speak of is the mystery of God —his plan that was previously hidden, even though he made it for our ultimate glory before the world began.
verses.textEnNasb: but we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the hidden wisdom which God predestined before the ages to our glory;
verses.textEn: No, we declare God’s wisdom, a mystery that has been hidden and that God destined for our glory before time began.

verses.textZh: 这智慧，这世代执政的人没有一个知道，如果他们知道，就不会把荣耀的主钉在十字架上了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这智慧，这世代执政的人没有一个知道，如果他们知道，就不会把荣耀的主钉在十字架上了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这智慧世上有权有位的人没有一个知道的，他们若知道，就不把荣耀的主钉在十字架上了。
verses.textEnNiv: None of the rulers of this age understood it, for if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
verses.textEnEsv: None of the rulers of this age understood this, for if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: which none of the rulers of this age knew; for had they known, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
verses.textEnNlt: But the rulers of this world have not understood it; if they had, they would not have crucified our glorious Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: the wisdom which none of the rulers of this age has understood; for if they had understood it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory;
verses.textEn: None of the rulers of this age understood it, for if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

verses.textZh: 正如经上所记： "神为爱他的人所预备的， 是眼睛未曾见过，耳朵未曾听过， 人心也未曾想到的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如经上所记： "神为爱他的人所预备的， 是眼睛未曾见过，耳朵未曾听过， 人心也未曾想到的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 如经上所记：神为爱他的人所预备的 是眼睛未曾看见， 耳朵未曾听见， 人心也未曾想到的。
verses.textEnNiv: However, as it is written: "What no eye has seen, what no ear has heard, and what no human mind has conceived" — the things God has prepared for those who love him—
verses.textEnEsv: But, as it is written, "What no eye has seen, nor ear heard, nor the heart of man imagined, what God has prepared for those who love him"—
verses.textEnNkjv: But as it is written: "Eye has not seen, nor ear heard, Nor have entered into the heart of man The things which God has prepared for those who love Him."
verses.textEnNlt: That is what the Scriptures mean when they say, "No eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no mind has imagined what God has prepared for those who love him."
verses.textEnNasb: but just as it is written: "Things which eye has not seen and ear has not heard, And which have not entered the human heart, All that God has prepared for those who love Him."
verses.textEn: However, as it is written: "What no eye has seen, what no ear has heard, and what no human mind has conceived" — the things God has prepared for those who love him—

verses.textZh: 但神却借着圣灵把这些向我们显明了，因为圣灵测透万事，连神深奥的事也测透了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但神却借着圣灵把这些向我们显明了，因为圣灵测透万事，连神深奥的事也测透了。
verses.textZhCuv: 只有神藉着圣灵向我们显明了，因为圣灵参透万事，就是神深奥的事也参透了。
verses.textEnNiv: these are the things God has revealed to us by his Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.
verses.textEnEsv: these things God has revealed to us through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches everything, even the depths of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But God has revealed them to us through His Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.
verses.textEnNlt: But it was to us that God revealed these things by his Spirit. For his Spirit searches out everything and shows us God’s deep secrets.
verses.textEnNasb: For to us God revealed them through the Spirit; for the Spirit searches all things, even the depths of God.
verses.textEn: these are the things God has revealed to us by his Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.

verses.textZh: 除了在人里面的灵，谁能知道人的事呢？同样，除了神的灵，也没有人知道神的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 除了在人里面的灵，谁能知道人的事呢？同样，除了神的灵，也没有人知道神的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 除了在人里头的灵，谁知道人的事？像这样，除了神的灵，也没有人知道神的事。
verses.textEnNiv: For who knows a person’s thoughts except their own spirit within them? In the same way no one knows the thoughts of God except the Spirit of God.
verses.textEnEsv: For who knows a person’s thoughts except the spirit of that person, which is in him? So also no one comprehends the thoughts of God except the Spirit of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For what man knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so no one knows the things of God except the Spirit of God.
verses.textEnNlt: No one can know a person’s thoughts except that person’s own spirit, and no one can know God’s thoughts except God’s own Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: For who among people knows the thoughts of a person except the spirit of the person that is in him? So also the thoughts of God no one knows, except the Spirit of God.
verses.textEn: For who knows a person’s thoughts except their own spirit within them? In the same way no one knows the thoughts of God except the Spirit of God.

verses.textZh: 我们所领受的，不是这世界的灵，而是从神来的灵，使我们能知道神开恩赐给我们的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们所领受的，不是这世界的灵，而是从神来的灵，使我们能知道神开恩赐给我们的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们所领受的，并不是世上的灵，乃是从神来的灵，叫我们能知道神开恩赐给我们的事。
verses.textEnNiv: What we have received is not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, so that we may understand what God has freely given us.
verses.textEnEsv: Now we have received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, that we might understand the things freely given us by God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now we have received, not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, that we might know the things that have been freely given to us by God.
verses.textEnNlt: And we have received God’s Spirit (not the world’s spirit), so we can know the wonderful things God has freely given us.
verses.textEnNasb: Now we have not received the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, so that we may know the things freely given to us by God.
verses.textEn: What we have received is not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, so that we may understand what God has freely given us.

verses.textZh: 我们也讲这些事，不是用人的智慧所教的言语，而是用圣灵所教的言语，向属灵的人解释属灵的事 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们也讲这些事，不是用人的智慧所教的言语，而是用圣灵所教的言语，向属灵的人解释属灵的事 。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我们讲说这些事，不是用人智慧所指教的言语，乃是用圣灵所指教的言语，将属灵的话解释属灵的事 。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what we speak, not in words taught us by human wisdom but in words taught by the Spirit, explaining spiritual realities with Spirit-taught words.
verses.textEnEsv: And we impart this in words not taught by human wisdom but taught by the Spirit, interpreting spiritual truths to those who are spiritual.
verses.textEnNkjv: These things we also speak, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual.
verses.textEnNlt: When we tell you these things, we do not use words that come from human wisdom. Instead, we speak words given to us by the Spirit, using the Spirit’s words to explain spiritual truths.
verses.textEnNasb: We also speak these things, not in words taught by human wisdom, but in those taught by the Spirit, combining spiritual thoughts with spiritual words.
verses.textEn: This is what we speak, not in words taught us by human wisdom but in words taught by the Spirit, explaining spiritual realities with Spirit-taught words.

verses.textZh: 然而属血气的人不接受神的灵的事，因为他以为是愚笨的；而且他也不能够明白，因为这些事，要有属灵的眼光才能领悟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而属血气的人不接受神的灵的事，因为他以为是愚笨的；而且他也不能够明白，因为这些事，要有属灵的眼光才能领悟。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，属血气的人不领会神圣灵的事，反倒以为愚拙，并且不能知道，因为这些事惟有属灵的人才能看透。
verses.textEnNiv: The person without the Spirit does not accept the things that come from the Spirit of God but considers them foolishness, and cannot understand them because they are discerned only through the Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: The natural person does not accept the things of the Spirit of God, for they are folly to him, and he is not able to understand them because they are spiritually discerned.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the natural man does not receive the things of the Spirit of God, for they are foolishness to him; nor can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
verses.textEnNlt: But people who aren’t spiritual can’t receive these truths from God’s Spirit. It all sounds foolish to them and they can’t understand it, for only those who are spiritual can understand what the Spirit means.
verses.textEnNasb: But a natural person does not accept the things of the Spirit of God, for they are foolishness to him; and he cannot understand them, because they are spiritually discerned.
verses.textEn: The person without the Spirit does not accept the things that come from the Spirit of God but considers them foolishness, and cannot understand them because they are discerned only through the Spirit.

verses.textZh: 属灵的人能看透万事，却没有人能看透他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 属灵的人能看透万事，却没有人能看透他，
verses.textZhCuv: 属灵的人能看透万事，却没有一人能看透了他。
verses.textEnNiv: The person with the Spirit makes judgments about all things, but such a person is not subject to merely human judgments,
verses.textEnEsv: The spiritual person judges all things, but is himself to be judged by no one.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who is spiritual judges all things, yet he himself is rightly judged by no one.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who are spiritual can evaluate all things, but they themselves cannot be evaluated by others.
verses.textEnNasb: But the one who is spiritual discerns all things, yet he himself is discerned by no one.
verses.textEn: The person with the Spirit makes judgments about all things, but such a person is not subject to merely human judgments,

verses.textZh: 如经上所记： "谁曾知道主的心意， 能够指教他呢？" 但我们已经得着基督的心意了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如经上所记： "谁曾知道主的心意， 能够指教他呢？" 但我们已经得着基督的心意了。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁曾知道主的心去教导他呢？但我们是有基督的心了。
verses.textEnNiv: for, "Who has known the mind of the Lord so as to instruct him?" But we have the mind of Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: "For who has understood the mind of the Lord so as to instruct him?" But we have the mind of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For "who has known the mind of the Lord that he may instruct Him?" But we have the mind of Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: For, "Who can know the Lord ’s thoughts? Who knows enough to teach him?" But we understand these things, for we have the mind of Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For who has known the mind of the Lord, that he will instruct Him? But we have the mind of Christ.
verses.textEn: for, "Who has known the mind of the Lord so as to instruct him?" But we have the mind of Christ.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我从前对你们说话，还不能把你们看作属灵的人，只能看作属肉体的人，看作在基督里的婴孩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我从前对你们说话，还不能把你们看作属灵的人，只能看作属肉体的人，看作在基督里的婴孩。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我从前对你们说话，不能把你们当作属灵的，只得把你们当作属肉体，在基督里为婴孩的。
verses.textEnNiv: Brothers and sisters, I could not address you as people who live by the Spirit but as people who are still worldly—mere infants in Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: But I, brothers, could not address you as spiritual people, but as people of the flesh, as infants in Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I, brethren, could not speak to you as to spiritual people but as to carnal, as to babes in Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, when I was with you I couldn’t talk to you as I would to spiritual people. I had to talk as though you belonged to this world or as though you were infants in Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: And I, brothers and sisters, could not speak to you as spiritual people, but only as fleshly, as to infants in Christ.
verses.textEn: Brothers and sisters, I could not address you as people who live by the Spirit but as people who are still worldly—mere infants in Christ.

verses.textZh: 我喂给你们吃的是奶，不是饭，因为那时你们不能吃，就是现在还是不能，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我喂给你们吃的是奶，不是饭，因为那时你们不能吃，就是现在还是不能，
verses.textZhCuv: 我是用奶喂你们，没有用饭喂你们。那时你们不能吃，就是如今还是不能。
verses.textEnNiv: I gave you milk, not solid food, for you were not yet ready for it. Indeed, you are still not ready.
verses.textEnEsv: I fed you with milk, not solid food, for you were not ready for it. And even now you are not yet ready,
verses.textEnNkjv: I fed you with milk and not with solid food; for until now you were not able toreceiveit, and even now you are still not able;
verses.textEnNlt: I had to feed you with milk, not with solid food, because you weren’t ready for anything stronger. And you still aren’t ready,
verses.textEnNasb: I gave you milk to drink, not solid food; for you were not yet able to consume it. But even now you are not yet able,
verses.textEn: I gave you milk, not solid food, for you were not yet ready for it. Indeed, you are still not ready.

verses.textZh: 因为你们仍然是属肉体的。在你们当中既然有嫉妒纷争，你们不还是属肉体，照着世人的方式而行吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们仍然是属肉体的。在你们当中既然有嫉妒纷争，你们不还是属肉体，照着世人的方式而行吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们仍是属肉体的，因为在你们中间有嫉妒、纷争，这岂不是属乎肉体、照着世人的样子行吗？
verses.textEnNiv: You are still worldly. For since there is jealousy and quarreling among you, are you not worldly? Are you not acting like mere humans?
verses.textEnEsv: for you are still of the flesh. For while there is jealousy and strife among you, are you not of the flesh and behaving only in a human way?
verses.textEnNkjv: for you are still carnal. For where thereare envy, strife, and divisions among you, are you not carnal and behaving like mere men?
verses.textEnNlt: for you are still controlled by your sinful nature. You are jealous of one another and quarrel with each other. Doesn’t that prove you are controlled by your sinful nature? Aren’t you living like people of the world?
verses.textEnNasb: for you are still fleshly. For since there is jealousy and strife among you, are you not fleshly, and are you not walking like ordinary people?
verses.textEn: You are still worldly. For since there is jealousy and quarreling among you, are you not worldly? Are you not acting like mere humans?

verses.textZh: 有人说"我是保罗派的"，又有人说"我是亚波罗派的"，你们不是和世人一样吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人说"我是保罗派的"，又有人说"我是亚波罗派的"，你们不是和世人一样吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 有说：「我是属保罗的」；有说：「我是属亚波罗的。」这岂不是你们和世人一样吗？
verses.textEnNiv: For when one says, "I follow Paul," and another, "I follow Apollos," are you not mere human beings?
verses.textEnEsv: For when one says, "I follow Paul," and another, "I follow Apollos," are you not being merely human?
verses.textEnNkjv: For when one says, "I am of Paul," and another, "I am of Apollos," are you not carnal?
verses.textEnNlt: When one of you says, "I am a follower of Paul," and another says, "I follow Apollos," aren’t you acting just like people of the world?
verses.textEnNasb: For when one person says, "I am with Paul," and another, "I am with Apollos," are you not ordinary people?
verses.textEn: For when one says, "I follow Paul," and another, "I follow Apollos," are you not mere human beings?

verses.textZh: 亚波罗算甚么？保罗算甚么？我们不过是神的仆人，你们借着我们信了主；按着主所赐给各人的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚波罗算甚么？保罗算甚么？我们不过是神的仆人，你们借着我们信了主；按着主所赐给各人的，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚波罗算什么？保罗算什么？无非是执事，照主所赐给他们各人的，引导你们相信。
verses.textEnNiv: What, after all, is Apollos? And what is Paul? Only servants, through whom you came to believe—as the Lord has assigned to each his task.
verses.textEnEsv: What then is Apollos? What is Paul? Servants through whom you believed, as the Lord assigned to each.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers through whom you believed, as the Lord gave to each one?
verses.textEnNlt: After all, who is Apollos? Who is Paul? We are only God’s servants through whom you believed the Good News. Each of us did the work the Lord gave us.
verses.textEnNasb: What then is Apollos? And what is Paul? Servants through whom you believed, even as the Lord gave opportunity to each one.
verses.textEn: What, after all, is Apollos? And what is Paul? Only servants, through whom you came to believe—as the Lord has assigned to each his task.

verses.textZh: 我栽种了，亚波罗浇灌了，唯有神使它生长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我栽种了，亚波罗浇灌了，唯有神使它生长。
verses.textZhCuv: 我栽种了，亚波罗浇灌了，惟有神叫他生长。
verses.textEnNiv: I planted the seed, Apollos watered it, but God has been making it grow.
verses.textEnEsv: I planted, Apollos watered, but God gave the growth.
verses.textEnNkjv: I planted, Apollos watered, but God gave the increase.
verses.textEnNlt: I planted the seed in your hearts, and Apollos watered it, but it was God who made it grow.
verses.textEnNasb: I planted, Apollos watered, but God was causing the growth.
verses.textEn: I planted the seed, Apollos watered it, but God has been making it grow.

verses.textZh: 所以，栽种的算不得甚么，浇灌的也算不得甚么，只在乎那使它生长的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，栽种的算不得甚么，浇灌的也算不得甚么，只在乎那使它生长的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 可见栽种的，算不得什么，浇灌的，也算不得什么；只在那叫他生长的神。
verses.textEnNiv: So neither the one who plants nor the one who waters is anything, but only God, who makes things grow.
verses.textEnEsv: So neither he who plants nor he who waters is anything, but only God who gives the growth.
verses.textEnNkjv: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.
verses.textEnNlt: It’s not important who does the planting, or who does the watering. What’s important is that God makes the seed grow.
verses.textEnNasb: So then neither the one who plants nor the one who waters is anything, but God who causes the growth.
verses.textEn: So neither the one who plants nor the one who waters is anything, but only God, who makes things grow.

verses.textZh: 栽种的和浇灌的都是一样，只是各人要照着自己的劳苦得着自己的报酬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 栽种的和浇灌的都是一样，只是各人要照着自己的劳苦得着自己的报酬。
verses.textZhCuv: 栽种的和浇灌的，都是一样，但将来各人要照自己的工夫得自己的赏赐。
verses.textEnNiv: The one who plants and the one who waters have one purpose, and they will each be rewarded according to their own labor.
verses.textEnEsv: He who plants and he who waters are one, and each will receive his wages according to his labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now he who plants and he who waters are one, and each one will receive his own reward according to his own labor.
verses.textEnNlt: The one who plants and the one who waters work together with the same purpose. And both will be rewarded for their own hard work.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the one who plants and the one who waters are one; but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.
verses.textEn: The one who plants and the one who waters have one purpose, and they will each be rewarded according to their own labor.

verses.textZh: 我们是神的同工，你们是神的田地，神的房屋。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们是神的同工，你们是神的田地，神的房屋。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我们是与神同工的；你们是神所耕种的田地，所建造的房屋。
verses.textEnNiv: For we are co-workers in God’s service; you are God’s field, God’s building.
verses.textEnEsv: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s field, God’s building.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we are God’s fellow workers; you are God’s field, youare God’s building.
verses.textEnNlt: For we are both God’s workers. And you are God’s field. You are God’s building.
verses.textEnNasb: For we are God’s fellow workers; you are God’s field, God’s building.
verses.textEn: For we are co-workers in God’s service; you are God’s field, God’s building.

verses.textZh: 我照着神赐给我的恩典，就像一个聪明的工程师，立好了根基，别人在上面建造。各人要注意怎样在上面建造，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我照着神赐给我的恩典，就像一个聪明的工程师，立好了根基，别人在上面建造。各人要注意怎样在上面建造，
verses.textZhCuv: 我照神所给我的恩，好像一个聪明的工头，立好了根基，有别人在上面建造；只是各人要谨慎怎样在上面建造。
verses.textEnNiv: By the grace God has given me, I laid a foundation as a wise builder, and someone else is building on it. But each one should build with care.
verses.textEnEsv: According to the grace of God given to me, like a skilled master builder I laid a foundation, and someone else is building upon it. Let each one take care how he builds upon it.
verses.textEnNkjv: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I have laid the foundation, and another builds on it. But let each one take heed how he builds on it.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of God’s grace to me, I have laid the foundation like an expert builder. Now others are building on it. But whoever is building on this foundation must be very careful.
verses.textEnNasb: According to the grace of God which was given to me, like a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another is building on it. But each person must be careful how he builds on it.
verses.textEn: By the grace God has given me, I laid a foundation as a wise builder, and someone else is building on it. But each one should build with care.

verses.textZh: 因为除了那已经立好的根基以外，没有人能立别的根基。那根基就是耶稣基督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为除了那已经立好的根基以外，没有人能立别的根基。那根基就是耶稣基督。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为那已经立好的根基就是耶稣基督，此外没有人能立别的根基。
verses.textEnNiv: For no one can lay any foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: For no one can lay a foundation other than that which is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For no other foundation can anyone lay than that which is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: For no one can lay any foundation other than the one we already have—Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For no one can lay a foundation other than the one which is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: For no one can lay any foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 如果有人用金、银、宝石、草、木、禾秸，在这根基上建造，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人用金、银、宝石、草、木、禾秸，在这根基上建造，
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人用金、银、宝石、草木、禾秸在这根基上建造，
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone builds on this foundation using gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay or straw,
verses.textEnEsv: Now if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, straw—
verses.textEnNkjv: Now if anyone builds on this foundation with gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, straw,
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who builds on that foundation may use a variety of materials—gold, silver, jewels, wood, hay, or straw.
verses.textEnNasb: Now if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, or straw,
verses.textEn: If anyone builds on this foundation using gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay or straw,

verses.textZh: 各人的工程将来必要显露，因为那日子必把它显明出来。有火要把它显露出来，那火要考验各人的工程是怎样的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 各人的工程将来必要显露，因为那日子必把它显明出来。有火要把它显露出来，那火要考验各人的工程是怎样的。
verses.textZhCuv: 各人的工程必然显露，因为那日子要将它表明出来，有火发现；这火要试验各人的工程怎样。
verses.textEnNiv: their work will be shown for what it is, because the Day will bring it to light. It will be revealed with fire, and the fire will test the quality of each person’s work.
verses.textEnEsv: each one’s work will become manifest, for the Day will disclose it, because it will be revealed by fire, and the fire will test what sort of work each one has done.
verses.textEnNkjv: each one’s work will become clear; for the Day will declare it, because it will be revealed by fire; and the fire will test each one’s work, of what sort it is.
verses.textEnNlt: But on the judgment day, fire will reveal what kind of work each builder has done. The fire will show if a person’s work has any value.
verses.textEnNasb: each one’s work will become evident; for the day will show it because it is to be revealed with fire, and the fire itself will test the quality of each one’s work.
verses.textEn: their work will be shown for what it is, because the Day will bring it to light. It will be revealed with fire, and the fire will test the quality of each person’s work.

verses.textZh: 如果有人在这根基上建造的工程存得住，他就要得到赏赐；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人在这根基上建造的工程存得住，他就要得到赏赐；
verses.textZhCuv: 人在那根基上所建造的工程若存得住，他就要得赏赐。
verses.textEnNiv: If what has been built survives, the builder will receive a reward.
verses.textEnEsv: If the work that anyone has built on the foundation survives, he will receive a reward.
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone’s work which he has built on it endures, he will receive a reward.
verses.textEnNlt: If the work survives, that builder will receive a reward.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone’s work which he has built on it remains, he will receive a reward.
verses.textEn: If what has been built survives, the builder will receive a reward.

verses.textZh: 如果有人的工程被烧毁，他就要受亏损；自己却要得救，只是要像从火里经过一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人的工程被烧毁，他就要受亏损；自己却要得救，只是要像从火里经过一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 人的工程若被烧了，他就要受亏损，自己却要得救；虽然得救，乃像从火里经过的一样。
verses.textEnNiv: If it is burned up, the builder will suffer loss but yet will be saved—even though only as one escaping through the flames.
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone’s work is burned up, he will suffer loss, though he himself will be saved, but only as through fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone’s work is burned, he will suffer loss; but he himself will be saved, yet so as through fire.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the work is burned up, the builder will suffer great loss. The builder will be saved, but like someone barely escaping through a wall of flames.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone’s work is burned up, he will suffer loss; but he himself will be saved, yet only so as through fire.
verses.textEn: If it is burned up, the builder will suffer loss but yet will be saved—even though only as one escaping through the flames.

verses.textZh: 难道不知道你们是神的殿，神的灵住在你们里面吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道不知道你们是神的殿，神的灵住在你们里面吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 岂不知你们是神的殿，神的灵住在你们里头吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Don’t you know that you yourselves are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit dwells in your midst?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you not know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit dwells in you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you not know that you are the temple of God and that the Spirit of God dwells in you?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you realize that all of you together are the temple of God and that the Spirit of God lives in you?
verses.textEnNasb: Do you not know that you are a temple of God and that the Spirit of God dwells in you?
verses.textEn: Don’t you know that you yourselves are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit dwells in your midst?

verses.textZh: 如果有人毁坏神的殿，神必要毁坏这人，因为神的殿是圣洁的，这殿就是你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人毁坏神的殿，神必要毁坏这人，因为神的殿是圣洁的，这殿就是你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人毁坏神的殿，神必要毁坏那人；因为神的殿是圣的，这殿就是你们。
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy that person; for God’s temple is sacred, and you together are that temple.
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him. For God’s temple is holy, and you are that temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone defiles the temple of God, God will destroy him. For the temple of God is holy, which temple you are.
verses.textEnNlt: God will destroy anyone who destroys this temple. For God’s temple is holy, and you are that temple.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone destroys the temple of God, God will destroy that person; for the temple of God is holy, and that is what you are.
verses.textEn: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy that person; for God’s temple is sacred, and you together are that temple.

verses.textZh: 谁也不要自欺。如果你们当中有人以为自己在这世代里是有智慧的，他就应该变为愚笨，好让他有智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁也不要自欺。如果你们当中有人以为自己在这世代里是有智慧的，他就应该变为愚笨，好让他有智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 人不可自欺。你们中间若有人在这世界自以为有智慧，倒不如变作愚拙，好成为有智慧的。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not deceive yourselves. If any of you think you are wise by the standards of this age, you should become "fools" so that you may become wise.
verses.textEnEsv: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone among you thinks that he is wise in this age, let him become a fool that he may become wise.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone among you seems to be wise in this age, let him become a fool that he may become wise.
verses.textEnNlt: Stop deceiving yourselves. If you think you are wise by this world’s standards, you need to become a fool to be truly wise.
verses.textEnNasb: Take care that no one deceives himself. If anyone among you thinks that he is wise in this age, he must become foolish, so that he may become wise.
verses.textEn: Do not deceive yourselves. If any of you think you are wise by the standards of this age, you should become "fools" so that you may become wise.

verses.textZh: 因为这世界的智慧，在神看来是愚笨的，如经上所记： "他使有智慧的人中了自己的诡计。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这世界的智慧，在神看来是愚笨的，如经上所记： "他使有智慧的人中了自己的诡计。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因这世界的智慧，在神看是愚拙。如经上记着说：「主叫有智慧的，中了自己的诡计」；
verses.textEnNiv: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness in God’s sight. As it is written: "He catches the wise in their craftiness" ;
verses.textEnEsv: For the wisdom of this world is folly with God. For it is written, "He catches the wise in their craftiness,"
verses.textEnNkjv: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, "He catches the wise in their own craftiness";
verses.textEnNlt: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness to God. As the Scriptures say, "He traps the wise in the snare of their own cleverness."
verses.textEnNasb: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness in the sight of God. For it is written: "He isthe one who catches the wise by their craftiness";
verses.textEn: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness in God’s sight. As it is written: "He catches the wise in their craftiness" ;

verses.textZh: 又说： "主知道智慧人的意念是虚妄的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又说： "主知道智慧人的意念是虚妄的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「主知道智慧人的意念是虚妄的。」
verses.textEnNiv: and again, "The Lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are futile."
verses.textEnEsv: and again, "The Lord knows the thoughts of the wise, that they are futile."
verses.textEnNkjv: and again, "The Lord knows the thoughts of the wise, that they are futile."
verses.textEnNlt: And again, "The Lord knows the thoughts of the wise; he knows they are worthless."
verses.textEnNasb: and again, "The Lord knows the thoughts of the wise, that they are useless."
verses.textEn: and again, "The Lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are futile."

verses.textZh: 所以，谁都不可拿人来夸耀，因为一切都是你们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，谁都不可拿人来夸耀，因为一切都是你们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以无论谁，都不可拿人夸口，因为万有全是你们的。
verses.textEnNiv: So then, no more boasting about human leaders! All things are yours,
verses.textEnEsv: So let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours:
verses.textEnNlt: So don’t boast about following a particular human leader. For everything belongs to you—
verses.textEnNasb: So then, no one is to be boasting in people. For all things belong to you,
verses.textEn: So then, no more boasting about human leaders! All things are yours,

verses.textZh: 无论是保罗，是亚波罗，是矶法，是世界，是生，是死，是现在的事，是将来的事，都是你们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论是保罗，是亚波罗，是矶法，是世界，是生，是死，是现在的事，是将来的事，都是你们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 或保罗，或亚波罗，或矶法，或世界，或生，或死，或现今的事，或将来的事，全是你们的；
verses.textEnNiv: whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas or the world or life or death or the present or the future—all are yours,
verses.textEnEsv: whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas or the world or life or death or the present or the future—all are yours,
verses.textEnNkjv: whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas, or the world or life or death, or things present or things to come—all are yours.
verses.textEnNlt: whether Paul or Apollos or Peter, or the world, or life and death, or the present and the future. Everything belongs to you,
verses.textEnNasb: whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas, or the world or life or death, or things present or things to come; all things belong to you,
verses.textEn: whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas or the world or life or death or the present or the future—all are yours,

verses.textZh: 你们是属基督的，基督是属神的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们是属基督的，基督是属神的。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且你们是属基督的，基督又是属神的。
verses.textEnNiv: and you are of Christ, and Christ is of God.
verses.textEnEsv: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.
verses.textEnNlt: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
verses.textEnNasb: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
verses.textEn: and you are of Christ, and Christ is of God.

verses.textZh: 这样，人应该把我们看作基督的仆人，神奥秘的事的管家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，人应该把我们看作基督的仆人，神奥秘的事的管家。
verses.textZhCuv: 人应当以我们为基督的执事，为神奥秘事的管家。
verses.textEnNiv: This, then, is how you ought to regard us: as servants of Christ and as those entrusted with the mysteries God has revealed.
verses.textEnEsv: This is how one should regard us, as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let a man so consider us, as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God.
verses.textEnNlt: So look at Apollos and me as mere servants of Christ who have been put in charge of explaining God’s mysteries.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the way any person is to regard us: as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God.
verses.textEn: This, then, is how you ought to regard us: as servants of Christ and as those entrusted with the mysteries God has revealed.

verses.textZh: 对于管家的要求，就是要他忠心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对于管家的要求，就是要他忠心。
verses.textZhCuv: 所求于管家的，是要他有忠心。
verses.textEnNiv: Now it is required that those who have been given a trust must prove faithful.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover it is required in stewards that one be found faithful.
verses.textEnNlt: Now, a person who is put in charge as a manager must be faithful.
verses.textEnNasb: In this case, moreover, it is required of stewards that one be found trustworthy.
verses.textEn: Now it is required that those who have been given a trust must prove faithful.

verses.textZh: 我被你们论断，或被人间法庭审判，我都认为是极小的事，连我自己也不论断自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我被你们论断，或被人间法庭审判，我都认为是极小的事，连我自己也不论断自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 我被你们论断，或被别人论断，我都以为极小的事；连我自己也不论断自己。
verses.textEnNiv: I care very little if I am judged by you or by any human court; indeed, I do not even judge myself.
verses.textEnEsv: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you or by any human court. In fact, I do not even judge myself.
verses.textEnNkjv: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you or by a human court. In fact, I do not even judge myself.
verses.textEnNlt: As for me, it matters very little how I might be evaluated by you or by any human authority. I don’t even trust my own judgment on this point.
verses.textEnNasb: But to me it is an insignificant matter that I would be examined by you, or by any human court; in fact, I do not even examine myself.
verses.textEn: I care very little if I am judged by you or by any human court; indeed, I do not even judge myself.

verses.textZh: 我虽然问心无愧，却不能因此自以为义，因为判断我的是主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我虽然问心无愧，却不能因此自以为义，因为判断我的是主。
verses.textZhCuv: 我虽不觉得自己有错，却也不能因此得以称义；但判断我的乃是主。
verses.textEnNiv: My conscience is clear, but that does not make me innocent. It is the Lord who judges me.
verses.textEnEsv: For I am not aware of anything against myself, but I am not thereby acquitted. It is the Lord who judges me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I know of nothing against myself, yet I am not justified by this; but He who judges me is the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: My conscience is clear, but that doesn’t prove I’m right. It is the Lord himself who will examine me and decide.
verses.textEnNasb: For I am not aware of anything against myself; however I am not vindicated by this, but the one who examines me is the Lord.
verses.textEn: My conscience is clear, but that does not make me innocent. It is the Lord who judges me.

verses.textZh: 所以时候还没有到，你们不要批评，直等到主来；他要照出黑暗中的隐情，显明人心里的动机。那时，各人要从神那里得着称赞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以时候还没有到，你们不要批评，直等到主来；他要照出黑暗中的隐情，显明人心里的动机。那时，各人要从神那里得着称赞。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，时候未到，什么都不要论断，只等主来，他要照出暗中的隐情，显明人心的意念。那时，各人要从神那里得着称赞。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore judge nothing before the appointed time; wait until the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of the heart. At that time each will receive their praise from God.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore do not pronounce judgment before the time, before the Lord comes, who will bring to light the things now hidden in darkness and will disclose the purposes of the heart. Then each one will receive his commendation from God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each one’s praise will come from God.
verses.textEnNlt: So don’t make judgments about anyone ahead of time—before the Lord returns. For he will bring our darkest secrets to light and will reveal our private motives. Then God will give to each one whatever praise is due.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore do not go on passing judgment before the time, but wait until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the things hidden in the darkness and disclose the motives of human hearts; and then praise will come to each person from God.
verses.textEn: Therefore judge nothing before the appointed time; wait until the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of the heart. At that time each will receive their praise from God.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我为你们的缘故，拿了这些事来比拟自己和亚波罗，让你们在我们身上学到的，不会超过圣经所记的，免得你们中间有人自高自大，看重这个轻视那个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我为你们的缘故，拿了这些事来比拟自己和亚波罗，让你们在我们身上学到的，不会超过圣经所记的，免得你们中间有人自高自大，看重这个轻视那个。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我为你们的缘故，拿这些事转比自己和亚波罗，叫你们效法我们不可过于圣经所记，免得你们自高自大，贵重这个，轻看那个。
verses.textEnNiv: Now, brothers and sisters, I have applied these things to myself and Apollos for your benefit, so that you may learn from us the meaning of the saying, "Do not go beyond what is written." Then you will not be puffed up in being a follower of one of us over against the other.
verses.textEnEsv: I have applied all these things to myself and Apollos for your benefit, brothers, that you may learn by us not to go beyond what is written, that none of you may be puffed up in favor of one against another.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these things, brethren, I have figuratively transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that you may learn in us not to think beyond what is written, that none of you may be puffed up on behalf of one against the other.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, I have used Apollos and myself to illustrate what I’ve been saying. If you pay attention to what I have quoted from the Scriptures, you won’t be proud of one of your leaders at the expense of another.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these things, brothers and sisters, I have figuratively applied to myself and Apollos on your account, so that in us you may learn not to exceed what is written, so that no one of you will become arrogant in behalf of one against the other.
verses.textEn: Now, brothers and sisters, I have applied these things to myself and Apollos for your benefit, so that you may learn from us the meaning of the saying, "Do not go beyond what is written." Then you will not be puffed up in being a follower of one of us over against the other.

verses.textZh: 使你与人不同的是谁呢？你有甚么不是领受的呢？既然是领受的，为甚么要自夸，好象不是领受的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 使你与人不同的是谁呢？你有甚么不是领受的呢？既然是领受的，为甚么要自夸，好象不是领受的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 使你与人不同的是谁呢？你有什么不是领受的呢？若是领受的，为何自夸，仿佛不是领受的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: For who makes you different from anyone else? What do you have that you did not receive? And if you did receive it, why do you boast as though you did not?
verses.textEnEsv: For who sees anything different in you? What do you have that you did not receive? If then you received it, why do you boast as if you did not receive it?
verses.textEnNkjv: For who makes you differ fromanother? And what do you have that you did not receive? Now if you did indeed receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?
verses.textEnNlt: For what gives you the right to make such a judgment? What do you have that God hasn’t given you? And if everything you have is from God, why boast as though it were not a gift?
verses.textEnNasb: For who considers you as superior? What do you have that you did not receive? And if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?
verses.textEn: For who makes you different from anyone else? What do you have that you did not receive? And if you did receive it, why do you boast as though you did not?

verses.textZh: 你们已经满足了，已经丰富了，不需要我们，自己作王了。我恨不得你们真的作了王，让我们也可以跟你们一同作王！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们已经满足了，已经丰富了，不需要我们，自己作王了。我恨不得你们真的作了王，让我们也可以跟你们一同作王！
verses.textZhCuv: 你们已经饱足了！已经丰富了！不用我们，自己就作王了！我愿意你们果真作王，叫我们也得与你们一同作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Already you have all you want! Already you have become rich! You have begun to reign—and that without us! How I wish that you really had begun to reign so that we also might reign with you!
verses.textEnEsv: Already you have all you want! Already you have become rich! Without us you have become kings! And would that you did reign, so that we might share the rule with you!
verses.textEnNkjv: You are already full! You are already rich! You have reigned as kings without us—and indeed I could wish you did reign, that we also might reign with you!
verses.textEnNlt: You think you already have everything you need. You think you are already rich. You have begun to reign in God’s kingdom without us! I wish you really were reigning already, for then we would be reigning with you.
verses.textEnNasb: You are already filled, you have already become rich, you have become kings without us; and indeed, I wish that you had become kings so that we also might reign with you!
verses.textEn: Already you have all you want! Already you have become rich! You have begun to reign—and that without us! How I wish that you really had begun to reign so that we also might reign with you!

verses.textZh: 我想神是把我们作使徒的列在最后，好象定了死刑的人，因为我们成了一台戏给宇宙观看，就是给天使和世人观看！
verses.textZhCnvs: 我想神是把我们作使徒的列在最后，好象定了死刑的人，因为我们成了一台戏给宇宙观看，就是给天使和世人观看！
verses.textZhCuv: 我想神把我们使徒明明列在末后，好像定死罪的囚犯；因为我们成了一台戏，给世人和天使观看。
verses.textEnNiv: For it seems to me that God has put us apostles on display at the end of the procession, like those condemned to die in the arena. We have been made a spectacle to the whole universe, to angels as well as to human beings.
verses.textEnEsv: For I think that God has exhibited us apostles as last of all, like men sentenced to death, because we have become a spectacle to the world, to angels, and to men.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last, as men condemned to death; for we have been made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and to men.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, I sometimes think God has put us apostles on display, like prisoners of war at the end of a victor’s parade, condemned to die. We have become a spectacle to the entire world—to people and angels alike.
verses.textEnNasb: For I think, God has exhibited us, the apostles, last of all as men condemned to death, because we have become a spectacle to the world, both to angels and to mankind.
verses.textEn: For it seems to me that God has put us apostles on display at the end of the procession, like those condemned to die in the arena. We have been made a spectacle to the whole universe, to angels as well as to human beings.

verses.textZh: 我们为基督的缘故，成了愚笨的；你们在基督里，倒成了聪明的。我们软弱，你们倒强壮；你们受人尊敬，我们倒被轻视。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们为基督的缘故，成了愚笨的；你们在基督里，倒成了聪明的。我们软弱，你们倒强壮；你们受人尊敬，我们倒被轻视。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们为基督的缘故算是愚拙的，你们在基督里倒是聪明的；我们软弱，你们倒强壮；你们有荣耀，我们倒被藐视。
verses.textEnNiv: We are fools for Christ, but you are so wise in Christ! We are weak, but you are strong! You are honored, we are dishonored!
verses.textEnEsv: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You are held in honor, but we in disrepute.
verses.textEnNkjv: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ! We are weak, but you are strong! You are distinguished, but we are dishonored!
verses.textEnNlt: Our dedication to Christ makes us look like fools, but you claim to be so wise in Christ! We are weak, but you are so powerful! You are honored, but we are ridiculed.
verses.textEnNasb: We are fools on account of Christ, but you are prudent in Christ! We are weak, but you are strong! You are distinguished, but we are without honor!
verses.textEn: We are fools for Christ, but you are so wise in Christ! We are weak, but you are strong! You are honored, we are dishonored!

verses.textZh: 直到现在，我们还是又饥又渴，衣不蔽体，又挨打，又没有栖身的地方，
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到现在，我们还是又饥又渴，衣不蔽体，又挨打，又没有栖身的地方，
verses.textZhCuv: 直到如今，我们还是又饥又渴，又赤身露体，又挨打，又没有一定的住处，
verses.textEnNiv: To this very hour we go hungry and thirsty, we are in rags, we are brutally treated, we are homeless.
verses.textEnEsv: To the present hour we hunger and thirst, we are poorly dressed and buffeted and homeless,
verses.textEnNkjv: To the present hour we both hunger and thirst, and we are poorly clothed, and beaten, and homeless.
verses.textEnNlt: Even now we go hungry and thirsty, and we don’t have enough clothes to keep warm. We are often beaten and have no home.
verses.textEnNasb: Up to this present hour we are both hungry and thirsty, and are poorly clothed and roughly treated and homeless;
verses.textEn: To this very hour we go hungry and thirsty, we are in rags, we are brutally treated, we are homeless.

verses.textZh: 并且劳苦，亲手作工。被人咒骂，我们就祝福；遭受迫害，我们就忍受；
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且劳苦，亲手作工。被人咒骂，我们就祝福；遭受迫害，我们就忍受；
verses.textZhCuv: 并且劳苦，亲手做工。被人咒骂，我们就祝福；被人逼迫，我们就忍受；
verses.textEnNiv: We work hard with our own hands. When we are cursed, we bless; when we are persecuted, we endure it;
verses.textEnEsv: and we labor, working with our own hands. When reviled, we bless; when persecuted, we endure;
verses.textEnNkjv: And we labor, working with our own hands. Being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we endure;
verses.textEnNlt: We work wearily with our own hands to earn our living. We bless those who curse us. We are patient with those who abuse us.
verses.textEnNasb: and we labor, working with our own hands; when we are verbally abused, we bless; when we are persecuted, we endure it;
