verses.textEn: We work hard with our own hands. When we are cursed, we bless; when we are persecuted, we endure it;

verses.textZh: 被人毁谤，我们却好好地劝导；直到现在，人还是把我们当作世上的垃圾，万物的渣滓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 被人毁谤，我们却好好地劝导；直到现在，人还是把我们当作世上的垃圾，万物的渣滓。
verses.textZhCuv: 被人毁谤，我们就善劝。直到如今，人还把我们看作世界上的污秽，万物中的渣滓。
verses.textEnNiv: when we are slandered, we answer kindly. We have become the scum of the earth, the garbage of the world—right up to this moment.
verses.textEnEsv: when slandered, we entreat. We have become, and are still, like the scum of the world, the refuse of all things.
verses.textEnNkjv: being defamed, we entreat. We have been made as the filth of the world, the offscouring of all things until now.
verses.textEnNlt: We appeal gently when evil things are said about us. Yet we are treated like the world’s garbage, like everybody’s trash—right up to the present moment.
verses.textEnNasb: when we are slandered, we reply as friends; we have become as the scum of the world, the dregs of all things, even until now.
verses.textEn: when we are slandered, we answer kindly. We have become the scum of the earth, the garbage of the world—right up to this moment.

verses.textZh: 我写这些话，不是要叫你们羞愧，而是把你们当作我亲爱的儿女一样劝戒你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我写这些话，不是要叫你们羞愧，而是把你们当作我亲爱的儿女一样劝戒你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我写这话，不是叫你们羞愧，乃是警戒你们，好像我所亲爱的儿女一样。
verses.textEnNiv: I am writing this not to shame you but to warn you as my dear children.
verses.textEnEsv: I do not write these things to make you ashamed, but to admonish you as my beloved children.
verses.textEnNkjv: I do not write these things to shame you, but as my beloved children I warn you.
verses.textEnNlt: I am not writing these things to shame you, but to warn you as my beloved children.
verses.textEnNasb: I do not write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.
verses.textEn: I am writing this not to shame you but to warn you as my dear children.

verses.textZh: 纵然你们在基督里有上万的启蒙教师，可是父亲却不多，因为是我在基督耶稣里借着福音生了你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 纵然你们在基督里有上万的启蒙教师，可是父亲却不多，因为是我在基督耶稣里借着福音生了你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们学基督的，师傅虽有一万，为父的却是不多，因我在基督耶稣里用福音生了你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Even if you had ten thousand guardians in Christ, you do not have many fathers, for in Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel.
verses.textEnEsv: For though you have countless guides in Christ, you do not have many fathers. For I became your father in Christ Jesus through the gospel.
verses.textEnNkjv: For though you might have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet youdo not have many fathers; for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel.
verses.textEnNlt: For even if you had ten thousand others to teach you about Christ, you have only one spiritual father. For I became your father in Christ Jesus when I preached the Good News to you.
verses.textEnNasb: For if you were to have countless tutors in Christ, yet you would not have many fathers, for in Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel.
verses.textEn: Even if you had ten thousand guardians in Christ, you do not have many fathers, for in Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel.

verses.textZh: 所以我劝你们要效法我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我劝你们要效法我。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我求你们效法我。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I urge you to imitate me.
verses.textEnEsv: I urge you, then, be imitators of me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I urge you, imitate me.
verses.textEnNlt: So I urge you to imitate me.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I urge you, be imitators of me.
verses.textEn: Therefore I urge you to imitate me.

verses.textZh: 因此，我打发提摩太到你们那里去。他是我在主里亲爱又忠心的儿子，他要提醒你们我在基督里是怎样行事为人，正如我在各处教会中所教导的一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我打发提摩太到你们那里去。他是我在主里亲爱又忠心的儿子，他要提醒你们我在基督里是怎样行事为人，正如我在各处教会中所教导的一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此我已打发提摩太到你们那里去。他在主里面，是我所亲爱、有忠心的儿子。他必提醒你们，记念我在基督里怎样行事，在各处各教会中怎样教导人。
verses.textEnNiv: For this reason I have sent to you Timothy, my son whom I love, who is faithful in the Lord. He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus, which agrees with what I teach everywhere in every church.
verses.textEnEsv: That is why I sent you Timothy, my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, to remind you of my ways in Christ, as I teach them everywhere in every church.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this reason I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful son in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways in Christ, as I teach everywhere in every church.
verses.textEnNlt: That’s why I have sent Timothy, my beloved and faithful child in the Lord. He will remind you of how I follow Christ Jesus, just as I teach in all the churches wherever I go.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason I have sent to you Timothy, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, and he will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, just as I teach everywhere in every church.
verses.textEn: For this reason I have sent to you Timothy, my son whom I love, who is faithful in the Lord. He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus, which agrees with what I teach everywhere in every church.

verses.textZh: 有人以为我不会到你们那里去，就自高自大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人以为我不会到你们那里去，就自高自大。
verses.textZhCuv: 有些人自高自大，以为我不到你们那里去；
verses.textEnNiv: Some of you have become arrogant, as if I were not coming to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Some are arrogant, as though I were not coming to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of you have become arrogant, thinking I will not visit you again.
verses.textEnNasb: Now some have become arrogant, as though I were not coming to you.
verses.textEn: Some of you have become arrogant, as if I were not coming to you.

verses.textZh: 然而主若愿意，我很快就要到你们那里去；到时我要知道的，不是那些自高自大的人所讲的，而是他们的能力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而主若愿意，我很快就要到你们那里去；到时我要知道的，不是那些自高自大的人所讲的，而是他们的能力。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，主若许我，我必快到你们那里去，并且我所要知道的，不是那些自高自大之人的言语，乃是他们的权能。
verses.textEnNiv: But I will come to you very soon, if the Lord is willing, and then I will find out not only how these arrogant people are talking, but what power they have.
verses.textEnEsv: But I will come to you soon, if the Lord wills, and I will find out not the talk of these arrogant people but their power.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord wills, and I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.
verses.textEnNlt: But I will come—and soon—if the Lord lets me, and then I’ll find out whether these arrogant people just give pretentious speeches or whether they really have God’s power.
verses.textEnNasb: But I will come to you soon, if the Lord wills, and I shall find out, not the words of those who are arrogant, but their power.
verses.textEn: But I will come to you very soon, if the Lord is willing, and then I will find out not only how these arrogant people are talking, but what power they have.

verses.textZh: 因为神的国不在乎言语，而在乎权能。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神的国不在乎言语，而在乎权能。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神的国不在乎言语，乃在乎权能。
verses.textEnNiv: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of talk but of power.
verses.textEnEsv: For the kingdom of God does not consist in talk but in power.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the kingdom of God is not in word but in power.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Kingdom of God is not just a lot of talk; it is living by God’s power.
verses.textEnNasb: For the kingdom of God is not in words, but in power.
verses.textEn: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of talk but of power.

verses.textZh: 你们愿意怎么样呢？要我带着刑杖到你们那里去，还是以温柔的灵，带着爱心去呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们愿意怎么样呢？要我带着刑杖到你们那里去，还是以温柔的灵，带着爱心去呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们愿意怎么样呢？是愿意我带着刑杖到你们那里去呢？还是要我存慈爱温柔的心呢？
verses.textEnNiv: What do you prefer? Shall I come to you with a rod of discipline, or shall I come in love and with a gentle spirit?
verses.textEnEsv: What do you wish? Shall I come to you with a rod, or with love in a spirit of gentleness?
verses.textEnNkjv: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?
verses.textEnNlt: Which do you choose? Should I come with a rod to punish you, or should I come with love and a gentle spirit?
verses.textEnNasb: What do you desire? That I come to you with a rod, or with love and a spirit of gentleness?
verses.textEn: What do you prefer? Shall I come to you with a rod of discipline, or shall I come in love and with a gentle spirit?

verses.textZh: 听说你们中间竟然有淫乱的事，这样的淫乱在教外人中间都没有，就是有人和他的继母同居。
verses.textZhCnvs: 听说你们中间竟然有淫乱的事，这样的淫乱在教外人中间都没有，就是有人和他的继母同居。
verses.textZhCuv: 风闻在你们中间有淫乱的事。这样的淫乱连外邦人中也没有，就是有人收了他的继母。
verses.textEnNiv: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that even pagans do not tolerate: A man is sleeping with his father’s wife.
verses.textEnEsv: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that is not tolerated even among pagans, for a man has his father’s wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: It is actually reported thatthereis sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles—that a man has his father’s wife!
verses.textEnNlt: I can hardly believe the report about the sexual immorality going on among you—something that even pagans don’t do. I am told that a man in your church is living in sin with his stepmother.
verses.textEnNasb: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and sexual immorality of such a kind as does not exist even among the Gentiles, namely, that someone has his father’s wife.
verses.textEn: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that even pagans do not tolerate: A man is sleeping with his father’s wife.

verses.textZh: 你们还是自高自大！难道你们不该觉得痛心，把作这件事的人从你们中间赶出去吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们还是自高自大！难道你们不该觉得痛心，把作这件事的人从你们中间赶出去吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们还是自高自大，并不哀痛，把行这事的人从你们中间赶出去。
verses.textEnNiv: And you are proud! Shouldn’t you rather have gone into mourning and have put out of your fellowship the man who has been doing this?
verses.textEnEsv: And you are arrogant! Ought you not rather to mourn? Let him who has done this be removed from among you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he who has done this deed might be taken away from among you.
verses.textEnNlt: You are so proud of yourselves, but you should be mourning in sorrow and shame. And you should remove this man from your fellowship.
verses.textEnNasb: You have become arrogant and have not mourned instead, so that the one who had done this deed would be removed from your midst.
verses.textEn: And you are proud! Shouldn’t you rather have gone into mourning and have put out of your fellowship the man who has been doing this?

verses.textZh: 我身体虽然不在你们那里，心灵却与你们在一起，好象我亲身在那里审判了作这件事的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我身体虽然不在你们那里，心灵却与你们在一起，好象我亲身在那里审判了作这件事的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 我身子虽不在你们那里，心却在你们那里，好像我亲自与你们同在，已经判断了行这事的人。
verses.textEnNiv: For my part, even though I am not physically present, I am with you in spirit. As one who is present with you in this way, I have already passed judgment in the name of our Lord Jesus on the one who has been doing this.
verses.textEnEsv: For though absent in body, I am present in spirit; and as if present, I have already pronounced judgment on the one who did such a thing.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I indeed, as absent in body but present in spirit, have already judged (as though I were present) him who has so done this deed.
verses.textEnNlt: Even though I am not with you in person, I am with you in the Spirit. And as though I were there, I have already passed judgment on this man
verses.textEnNasb: For I, on my part, though absent in body but present in spirit, have already judged him who has so committed this, as though I were present.
verses.textEn: For my part, even though I am not physically present, I am with you in spirit. As one who is present with you in this way, I have already passed judgment in the name of our Lord Jesus on the one who has been doing this.

verses.textZh: 就是当你们奉我们主耶稣的名聚集在一起，我的灵在那里，我们主耶稣的权能也同在的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是当你们奉我们主耶稣的名聚集在一起，我的灵在那里，我们主耶稣的权能也同在的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 就是你们聚会的时候，我的心也同在。奉我们主耶稣的名，并用我们主耶稣的权能，
verses.textEnNiv: So when you are assembled and I am with you in spirit, and the power of our Lord Jesus is present,
verses.textEnEsv: When you are assembled in the name of the Lord Jesus and my spirit is present, with the power of our Lord Jesus,
verses.textEnNkjv: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together, along with my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNlt: in the name of the Lord Jesus. You must call a meeting of the church. I will be present with you in spirit, and so will the power of our Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: In the name of our Lord Jesus, when you are assembled, and I with you in spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus,
verses.textEn: So when you are assembled and I am with you in spirit, and the power of our Lord Jesus is present,

verses.textZh: 要把这样的人交给撒但，败坏他的身体，使他的灵魂在主的日子可以得救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把这样的人交给撒但，败坏他的身体，使他的灵魂在主的日子可以得救。
verses.textZhCuv: 要把这样的人交给撒但，败坏他的肉体，使他的灵魂在主耶稣的日子可以得救。
verses.textEnNiv: hand this man over to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may be saved on the day of the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: you are to deliver this man to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that his spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you must throw this man out and hand him over to Satan so that his sinful nature will be destroyed and he himself will be saved on the day the Lord returns.
verses.textEnNasb: I have decided to turn such a person over to Satan for the destruction of his body, so that his spirit may be saved on the day of the Lord.
verses.textEn: hand this man over to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may be saved on the day of the Lord.

verses.textZh: 你们这样自夸是不好的。你们不知道一点面酵能使全团面发起来吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们这样自夸是不好的。你们不知道一点面酵能使全团面发起来吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这自夸是不好的。岂不知一点面酵能使全团发起来吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole batch of dough?
verses.textEnEsv: Your boasting is not good. Do you not know that a little leaven leavens the whole lump?
verses.textEnNkjv: Your glorying is not good. Do you not know that a little leaven leavens the whole lump?
verses.textEnNlt: Your boasting about this is terrible. Don’t you realize that this sin is like a little yeast that spreads through the whole batch of dough?
verses.textEnNasb: Your boasting is not good. Do you not know that a little leaven leavens the whole lump of dough?
verses.textEn: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole batch of dough?

verses.textZh: 你们既是无酵的面，就应当把旧酵除净，好让你们成为新的面团；因为我们逾越节的羊羔基督已经被杀献祭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们既是无酵的面，就应当把旧酵除净，好让你们成为新的面团；因为我们逾越节的羊羔基督已经被杀献祭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们既是无酵的面，应当把旧酵除净，好使你们成为新团；因为我们逾越节的羔羊基督已经被杀献祭了。
verses.textEnNiv: Get rid of the old yeast, so that you may be a new unleavened batch—as you really are. For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.
verses.textEnEsv: Cleanse out the old leaven that you may be a new lump, as you really are unleavened. For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore purge out the old leaven, that you may be a new lump, since you truly are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, was sacrificed for us.
verses.textEnNlt: Get rid of the old "yeast" by removing this wicked person from among you. Then you will be like a fresh batch of dough made without yeast, which is what you really are. Christ, our Passover Lamb, has been sacrificed for us.
verses.textEnNasb: Clean out the old leaven so that you may be a new lump, just as you are in fact unleavened. For Christ our Passover also has been sacrificed.
verses.textEn: Get rid of the old yeast, so that you may be a new unleavened batch—as you really are. For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.

verses.textZh: 所以我们守这节，不可用旧酵，也不可用又邪又恶的酵，而是要用纯洁真实的无酵饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我们守这节，不可用旧酵，也不可用又邪又恶的酵，而是要用纯洁真实的无酵饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我们守这节不可用旧酵，也不可用恶毒 、邪恶的酵，只用诚实真正的无酵饼。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore let us keep the Festival, not with the old bread leavened with malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
verses.textEnEsv: Let us therefore celebrate the festival, not with the old leaven, the leaven of malice and evil, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, nor with the leaven of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
verses.textEnNlt: So let us celebrate the festival, not with the old bread of wickedness and evil, but with the new bread of sincerity and truth.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore let’s celebrate the feast, not with old leaven, nor with the leaven of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
verses.textEn: Therefore let us keep the Festival, not with the old bread leavened with malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

verses.textZh: 我以前写信告诉你们，不可与淫乱的人来往。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我以前写信告诉你们，不可与淫乱的人来往。
verses.textZhCuv: 我先前写信给你们说，不可与淫乱的人相交。
verses.textEnNiv: I wrote to you in my letter not to associate with sexually immoral people—
verses.textEnEsv: I wrote to you in my letter not to associate with sexually immoral people—
verses.textEnNkjv: I wrote to you in my epistle not to keep company with sexually immoral people.
verses.textEnNlt: When I wrote to you before, I told you not to associate with people who indulge in sexual sin.
verses.textEnNasb: I wrote to you in my letter not to associate with sexually immoral people;
verses.textEn: I wrote to you in my letter not to associate with sexually immoral people—

verses.textZh: 这话当然不是指这世上行淫乱的、贪心的、勒索的，或拜偶像的人；如果是这样，你们就非脱离这世界不可。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这话当然不是指这世上行淫乱的、贪心的、勒索的，或拜偶像的人；如果是这样，你们就非脱离这世界不可。
verses.textZhCuv: 此话不是指这世上一概行淫乱的，或贪婪的，勒索的，或拜偶像的；若是这样，你们除非离开世界方可。
verses.textEnNiv: not at all meaning the people of this world who are immoral, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters. In that case you would have to leave this world.
verses.textEnEsv: not at all meaning the sexually immoral of this world, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters, since then you would need to go out of the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet I certainly did not mean with the sexually immoral people of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or idolaters, since then you would need to go out of the world.
verses.textEnNlt: But I wasn’t talking about unbelievers who indulge in sexual sin, or are greedy, or cheat people, or worship idols. You would have to leave this world to avoid people like that.
verses.textEnNasb: I did not at all mean with the sexually immoral people of this world, or with the greedy and swindlers, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.
verses.textEn: not at all meaning the people of this world who are immoral, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters. In that case you would have to leave this world.

verses.textZh: 但现在我写信告诉你们，如果有称为弟兄，却是行淫乱、贪心、拜偶像、辱骂人、醉酒或勒索的，这样的人，不可和他来往，连和他吃饭都不可。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现在我写信告诉你们，如果有称为弟兄，却是行淫乱、贪心、拜偶像、辱骂人、醉酒或勒索的，这样的人，不可和他来往，连和他吃饭都不可。
verses.textZhCuv: 但如今我写信给你们说，若有称为弟兄是行淫乱的，或贪婪的，或拜偶像的，或辱骂的，或醉酒的，或勒索的，这样的人不可与他相交，就是与他吃饭都不可。
verses.textEnNiv: But now I am writing to you that you must not associate with anyone who claims to be a brother or sister but is sexually immoral or greedy, an idolater or slanderer, a drunkard or swindler. Do not even eat with such people.
verses.textEnEsv: But now I am writing to you not to associate with anyone who bears the name of brother if he is guilty of sexual immorality or greed, or is an idolater, reviler, drunkard, or swindler—not even to eat with such a one.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now I have written to you not to keep company with anyone named a brother, who is sexually immoral, or covetous, or an idolater, or a reviler, or a drunkard, or an extortioner— not even to eat with such a person.
verses.textEnNlt: I meant that you are not to associate with anyone who claims to be a believer yet indulges in sexual sin, or is greedy, or worships idols, or is abusive, or is a drunkard, or cheats people. Don’t even eat with such people.
verses.textEnNasb: But actually, I wrote to you not to associate with any so-called brother if he is a sexually immoral person, or a greedy person, or an idolater, or is verbally abusive, or habitually drunk, or a swindler—not even to eat with such a person.
verses.textEn: But now I am writing to you that you must not associate with anyone who claims to be a brother or sister but is sexually immoral or greedy, an idolater or slanderer, a drunkard or swindler. Do not even eat with such people.

verses.textZh: 审判教外的人，跟我有甚么关系？教内的人不是你们审判的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 审判教外的人，跟我有甚么关系？教内的人不是你们审判的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 因为审判教外的人与我何干？教内的人岂不是你们审判的吗？
verses.textEnNiv: What business is it of mine to judge those outside the church? Are you not to judge those inside?
verses.textEnEsv: For what have I to do with judging outsiders? Is it not those inside the church whom you are to judge?
verses.textEnNkjv: For what have I todo with judging those also who are outside? Do you not judge those who are inside?
verses.textEnNlt: It isn’t my responsibility to judge outsiders, but it certainly is your responsibility to judge those inside the church who are sinning.
verses.textEnNasb: For what business of mine is it to judge outsiders? Do you not judge those who are within the church?
verses.textEn: What business is it of mine to judge those outside the church? Are you not to judge those inside?

verses.textZh: 至于教外的人，神会审判他们。你们要把那恶人从你们中间赶出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于教外的人，神会审判他们。你们要把那恶人从你们中间赶出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于外人有神审判他们。你们应当把那恶人从你们中间赶出去。
verses.textEnNiv: God will judge those outside. "Expel the wicked person from among you."
verses.textEnEsv: God judges those outside. "Purge the evil person from among you."
verses.textEnNkjv: But those who are outside God judges. Therefore "put away from yourselves the evil person."
verses.textEnNlt: God will judge those on the outside; but as the Scriptures say, "You must remove the evil person from among you."
verses.textEnNasb: But those who are outside, God judges. Remove the evil person from among yourselves.
verses.textEn: God will judge those outside. "Expel the wicked person from among you."

verses.textZh: 你们中间有人和弟兄起了争执，怎敢告到不义的人面前，却不告在圣徒面前呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们中间有人和弟兄起了争执，怎敢告到不义的人面前，却不告在圣徒面前呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们中间有彼此相争的事，怎敢在不义的人面前求审，不在圣徒面前求审呢？
verses.textEnNiv: If any of you has a dispute with another, do you dare to take it before the ungodly for judgment instead of before the Lord’s people?
verses.textEnEsv: When one of you has a grievance against another, does he dare go to law before the unrighteous instead of the saints?
verses.textEnNkjv: Dare any of you, having a matter against another, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?
verses.textEnNlt: When one of you has a dispute with another believer, how dare you file a lawsuit and ask a secular court to decide the matter instead of taking it to other believers !
verses.textEnNasb: Does any one of you, when he has a case against his neighbor, dare to go to law before the unrighteous and not before the saints?
verses.textEn: If any of you has a dispute with another, do you dare to take it before the ungodly for judgment instead of before the Lord’s people?

verses.textZh: 你们不知道圣徒要审判世界吗？既然世界要由你们来审判，难道你们不配审判这些最小的事吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不知道圣徒要审判世界吗？既然世界要由你们来审判，难道你们不配审判这些最小的事吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 岂不知圣徒要审判世界吗？若世界为你们所审，难道你们不配审判这最小的事吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Or do you not know that the Lord’s people will judge the world? And if you are to judge the world, are you not competent to judge trivial cases?
verses.textEnEsv: Or do you not know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is to be judged by you, are you incompetent to try trivial cases?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you not know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world will be judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you realize that someday we believers will judge the world? And since you are going to judge the world, can’t you decide even these little things among yourselves?
verses.textEnNasb: Or do you not know that the saints will judge the world? If the world is judged by you, are you not competent to form the smallest law courts?
verses.textEn: Or do you not know that the Lord’s people will judge the world? And if you are to judge the world, are you not competent to judge trivial cases?

verses.textZh: 你们不知道我们要审判天使吗？何况今生的事呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不知道我们要审判天使吗？何况今生的事呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 岂不知我们要审判天使吗？何况今生的事呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Do you not know that we will judge angels? How much more the things of this life!
verses.textEnEsv: Do you not know that we are to judge angels? How much more, then, matters pertaining to this life!
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you not know that we shall judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you realize that we will judge angels? So you should surely be able to resolve ordinary disputes in this life.
verses.textEnNasb: Do you not know that we will judge angels? How much more matters of this life?
verses.textEn: Do you not know that we will judge angels? How much more the things of this life!

verses.textZh: 你们既然要审判今生的事，为甚么让教会不重视的人来审判呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们既然要审判今生的事，为甚么让教会不重视的人来审判呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 既是这样，你们若有今生的事当审判，是派教会所轻看的人审判吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, if you have disputes about such matters, do you ask for a ruling from those whose way of life is scorned in the church?
verses.textEnEsv: So if you have such cases, why do you lay them before those who have no standing in the church?
verses.textEnNkjv: If then you have judgments concerning things pertaining to this life, do you appoint those who are least esteemed by the church to judge?
verses.textEnNlt: If you have legal disputes about such matters, why go to outside judges who are not respected by the church?
verses.textEnNasb: So if you have law courts dealing with matters of this life, do you appoint them as judges who are of no account in the church?
verses.textEn: Therefore, if you have disputes about such matters, do you ask for a ruling from those whose way of life is scorned in the church?

verses.textZh: 我说这话，是要使你们羞愧。难道你们中间没有一个有智慧的人，能够审判弟兄之间的事吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说这话，是要使你们羞愧。难道你们中间没有一个有智慧的人，能够审判弟兄之间的事吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我说这话是要叫你们羞耻。难道你们中间没有一个智慧人能审断弟兄们的事吗？
verses.textEnNiv: I say this to shame you. Is it possible that there is nobody among you wise enough to judge a dispute between believers?
verses.textEnEsv: I say this to your shame. Can it be that there is no one among you wise enough to settle a dispute between the brothers,
verses.textEnNkjv: I say this to your shame. Is it so, that there is not a wise man among you, not even one, who will be able to judge between his brethren?
verses.textEnNlt: I am saying this to shame you. Isn’t there anyone in all the church who is wise enough to decide these issues?
verses.textEnNasb: I say this to your shame. Is it so, that there is not among you anyone wise who will be able to decide between his brothers and sisters,
verses.textEn: I say this to shame you. Is it possible that there is nobody among you wise enough to judge a dispute between believers?

verses.textZh: 你们竟然是弟兄告弟兄，而且告到不信的人面前去吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们竟然是弟兄告弟兄，而且告到不信的人面前去吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们竟是弟兄与弟兄告状，而且告在不信主的人面前。
verses.textEnNiv: But instead, one brother takes another to court—and this in front of unbelievers!
verses.textEnEsv: but brother goes to law against brother, and that before unbelievers?
verses.textEnNkjv: But brother goes to law against brother, and that before unbelievers!
verses.textEnNlt: But instead, one believer sues another—right in front of unbelievers!
verses.textEnNasb: but brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers?
verses.textEn: But instead, one brother takes another to court—and this in front of unbelievers!

verses.textZh: 你们彼此告状，已经是你们的失败了。为甚么不宁愿受委屈呢？为甚么不甘心吃亏呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们彼此告状，已经是你们的失败了。为甚么不宁愿受委屈呢？为甚么不甘心吃亏呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们彼此告状，这已经是你们的大错了。为什么不情愿受欺呢？为什么不情愿吃亏呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The very fact that you have lawsuits among you means you have been completely defeated already. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be cheated?
verses.textEnEsv: To have lawsuits at all with one another is already a defeat for you. Why not rather suffer wrong? Why not rather be defrauded?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, it is already an utter failure for you that you go to law against one another. Why do you not rather accept wrong? Why do you not rather letyourselves be cheated?
verses.textEnNlt: Even to have such lawsuits with one another is a defeat for you. Why not just accept the injustice and leave it at that? Why not let yourselves be cheated?
verses.textEnNasb: Actually, then, it is already a defeat for you, that you have lawsuits with one another. Why not rather suffer the wrong? Why not rather be defrauded?
verses.textEn: The very fact that you have lawsuits among you means you have been completely defeated already. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be cheated?

verses.textZh: 但你们反倒使人受委屈，叫人吃亏，而且他们就是你们的弟兄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你们反倒使人受委屈，叫人吃亏，而且他们就是你们的弟兄。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们倒是欺压人、亏负人，况且所欺压所亏负的就是弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead, you yourselves cheat and do wrong, and you do this to your brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnEsv: But you yourselves wrong and defraud—even your own brothers!
verses.textEnNkjv: No, you yourselves do wrong and cheat, and youdo these things toyour brethren!
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, you yourselves are the ones who do wrong and cheat even your fellow believers.
verses.textEnNasb: On the contrary, you yourselves do wrong and defraud. And this to your brothers and sisters!
verses.textEn: Instead, you yourselves cheat and do wrong, and you do this to your brothers and sisters.

verses.textZh: 你们不知道不义的人不能承受神的国吗？不要自欺，无论是行淫乱的、拜偶像的、奸淫的、作娈童的、亲男色的、
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不知道不义的人不能承受神的国吗？不要自欺，无论是行淫乱的、拜偶像的、奸淫的、作娈童的、亲男色的、
verses.textZhCuv: 你们岂不知不义的人不能承受神的国吗？不要自欺！无论是淫乱的、拜偶像的、奸淫的、作娈童的、亲男色的、
verses.textEnNiv: Or do you not know that wrongdoers will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral nor idolaters nor adulterers nor men who have sex with men
verses.textEnEsv: Or do you not know that the unrighteous will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived: neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who practice homosexuality,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you not know that the unrighteous will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived. Neither fornicators, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor homosexuals, nor sodomites,
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you realize that those who do wrong will not inherit the Kingdom of God? Don’t fool yourselves. Those who indulge in sexual sin, or who worship idols, or commit adultery, or are male prostitutes, or practice homosexuality,
verses.textEnNasb: Or do you not know that the unrighteous will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived; neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor homosexuals,
verses.textEn: Or do you not know that wrongdoers will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral nor idolaters nor adulterers nor men who have sex with men

verses.textZh: 偷窃的、贪心的、醉酒的、辱骂人的或勒索的，都不能承受神的国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 偷窃的、贪心的、醉酒的、辱骂人的或勒索的，都不能承受神的国。
verses.textZhCuv: 偷窃的、贪婪的、醉酒的、辱骂的、勒索的，都不能承受神的国。
verses.textEnNiv: nor thieves nor the greedy nor drunkards nor slanderers nor swindlers will inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnEsv: nor thieves, nor the greedy, nor drunkards, nor revilers, nor swindlers will inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor revilers, nor extortioners will inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNlt: or are thieves, or greedy people, or drunkards, or are abusive, or cheat people—none of these will inherit the Kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNasb: nor thieves, nor the greedy, nor those habitually drunk, nor verbal abusers, nor swindlers, will inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.textEn: nor thieves nor the greedy nor drunkards nor slanderers nor swindlers will inherit the kingdom of God.

verses.textZh: 你们有些人从前也是这样的，但现在借着我们主耶稣基督的名，靠着我们神的灵，都已经洗净了，圣洁了，称义了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们有些人从前也是这样的，但现在借着我们主耶稣基督的名，靠着我们神的灵，都已经洗净了，圣洁了，称义了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们中间也有人从前是这样；但如今你们奉主耶稣基督的名，并藉着我们神的灵，已经洗净，成圣，称义了。
verses.textEnNiv: And that is what some of you were. But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
verses.textEnEsv: And such were some of you. But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And such were some of you. But you were washed, but you were sanctified, but you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus and by the Spirit of our God.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of you were once like that. But you were cleansed; you were made holy; you were made right with God by calling on the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
verses.textEnNasb: Such were some of you; but you were washed, but you were sanctified, but you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and in the Spirit of our God.
verses.textEn: And that is what some of you were. But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.

verses.textZh: 甚么事我都可以作，但不是都有益处。甚么事我都可以作，但我不要受任何事的辖制。
verses.textZhCnvs: 甚么事我都可以作，但不是都有益处。甚么事我都可以作，但我不要受任何事的辖制。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡事我都可行，但不都有益处。凡事我都可行，但无论哪一件，我总不受它的辖制。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have the right to do anything," you say—but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything"—but I will not be mastered by anything.
verses.textEnEsv: "All things are lawful for me," but not all things are helpful. "All things are lawful for me," but I will not be dominated by anything.
verses.textEnNkjv: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not helpful. All things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of any.
verses.textEnNlt: You say, "I am allowed to do anything"—but not everything is good for you. And even though "I am allowed to do anything," I must not become a slave to anything.
verses.textEnNasb: All things are permitted for me, but not all things are of benefit. All things are permitted for me, but I will not be mastered by anything.
verses.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say—but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything"—but I will not be mastered by anything.

verses.textZh: 食物是为了肚腹，肚腹是为了食物；但神却要把这两样都废掉。身体不是为了淫乱，而是为了主，主也是为了身体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 食物是为了肚腹，肚腹是为了食物；但神却要把这两样都废掉。身体不是为了淫乱，而是为了主，主也是为了身体。
verses.textZhCuv: 食物是为肚腹，肚腹是为食物；但神要叫这两样都废坏。身子不是为淫乱，乃是为主；主也是为身子。
verses.textEnNiv: You say, "Food for the stomach and the stomach for food, and God will destroy them both." The body, however, is not meant for sexual immorality but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
verses.textEnEsv: "Food is meant for the stomach and the stomach for food"—and God will destroy both one and the other. The body is not meant for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
verses.textEnNkjv: Foods for the stomach and the stomach for foods, but God will destroy both it and them. Now the body is not for sexual immorality but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
verses.textEnNlt: You say, "Food was made for the stomach, and the stomach for food." (This is true, though someday God will do away with both of them.) But you can’t say that our bodies were made for sexual immorality. They were made for the Lord, and the Lord cares about our bodies.
verses.textEnNasb: Food is for the stomach and the stomach is for food, however God will do away with both of them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord is for the body.
verses.textEn: You say, "Food for the stomach and the stomach for food, and God will destroy them both." The body, however, is not meant for sexual immorality but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

verses.textZh: 神不但使主复活了，也要用他的能力使我们复活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神不但使主复活了，也要用他的能力使我们复活。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且神已经叫主复活，也要用自己的能力叫我们复活。
verses.textEnNiv: By his power God raised the Lord from the dead, and he will raise us also.
verses.textEnEsv: And God raised the Lord and will also raise us up by his power.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God both raised up the Lord and will also raise us up by His power.
verses.textEnNlt: And God will raise us from the dead by his power, just as he raised our Lord from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: Now God has not only raised the Lord, but will also raise us up through His power.
verses.textEn: By his power God raised the Lord from the dead, and he will raise us also.

verses.textZh: 你们不知道你们的身体就是基督的肢体吗？这样，我们可以把基督的肢体当作娼妓的肢体吗？当然不可以！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不知道你们的身体就是基督的肢体吗？这样，我们可以把基督的肢体当作娼妓的肢体吗？当然不可以！
verses.textZhCuv: 岂不知你们的身子是基督的肢体吗？我可以将基督的肢体作为娼妓的肢体吗？断乎不可！
verses.textEnNiv: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ himself? Shall I then take the members of Christ and unite them with a prostitute? Never!
verses.textEnEsv: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? Never!
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a harlot? Certainly not!
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you realize that your bodies are actually parts of Christ? Should a man take his body, which is part of Christ, and join it to a prostitute? Never!
verses.textEnNasb: Do you not know that your bodies are parts of Christ? Shall I then take away the parts of Christ and make them parts of a prostitute? Far from it!
verses.textEn: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ himself? Shall I then take the members of Christ and unite them with a prostitute? Never!

verses.textZh: 你们不知道那跟娼妓苟合的，就是与她成为一体了吗？因为经上说："二人要成为一体。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不知道那跟娼妓苟合的，就是与她成为一体了吗？因为经上说："二人要成为一体。"
verses.textZhCuv: 岂不知与娼妓联合的，便是与她成为一体吗？因为主说：「二人要成为一体。」
verses.textEnNiv: Do you not know that he who unites himself with a prostitute is one with her in body? For it is said, "The two will become one flesh."
verses.textEnEsv: Or do you not know that he who is joined to a prostitute becomes one body with her? For, as it is written, "The two will become one flesh."
verses.textEnNkjv: Or do you not know that he who is joined to a harlot is one body withher? For "the two," He says, "shall become one flesh."
verses.textEnNlt: And don’t you realize that if a man joins himself to a prostitute, he becomes one body with her? For the Scriptures say, "The two are united into one."
verses.textEnNasb: Or do you not know that the one who joins himself to a prostitute is one body with her? For He says, "The two shall become one flesh."
verses.textEn: Do you not know that he who unites himself with a prostitute is one with her in body? For it is said, "The two will become one flesh."

verses.textZh: 但那与主联合的，就是与他成为一灵了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那与主联合的，就是与他成为一灵了。
verses.textZhCuv: 但与主联合的，便是与主成为一灵。
verses.textEnNiv: But whoever is united with the Lord is one with him in spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: But he who is joined to the Lord becomes one spirit with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit withHim.
verses.textEnNlt: But the person who is joined to the Lord is one spirit with him.
verses.textEnNasb: But the one who joins himself to the Lord is one spirit with Him.
verses.textEn: But whoever is united with the Lord is one with him in spirit.

verses.textZh: 你们要逃避淫乱的事。人所犯的，无论是甚么罪，都是在身体以外，唯有行淫乱的，是触犯自己的身体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要逃避淫乱的事。人所犯的，无论是甚么罪，都是在身体以外，唯有行淫乱的，是触犯自己的身体。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要逃避淫行。人所犯的，无论什么罪，都在身子以外，惟有行淫的，是得罪自己的身子。
verses.textEnNiv: Flee from sexual immorality. All other sins a person commits are outside the body, but whoever sins sexually, sins against their own body.
verses.textEnEsv: Flee from sexual immorality. Every other sin a person commits is outside the body, but the sexually immoral person sins against his own body.
verses.textEnNkjv: Flee sexual immorality. Every sin that a man does is outside the body, but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.
verses.textEnNlt: Run from sexual sin! No other sin so clearly affects the body as this one does. For sexual immorality is a sin against your own body.
verses.textEnNasb: Flee sexual immorality. Every other sin that a person commits is outside the body, but the sexually immoral person sins against his own body.
verses.textEn: Flee from sexual immorality. All other sins a person commits are outside the body, but whoever sins sexually, sins against their own body.

verses.textZh: 你们不知道你们的身体就是那位住在你们里面的圣灵的殿吗？这圣灵是你们从神那里领受的。你们不是属于自己的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不知道你们的身体就是那位住在你们里面的圣灵的殿吗？这圣灵是你们从神那里领受的。你们不是属于自己的，
verses.textZhCuv: 岂不知你们的身子就是圣灵的殿吗？这圣灵是从神而来，住在你们里头的；并且你们不是自己的人，
verses.textEnNiv: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own;
verses.textEnEsv: Or do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit within you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,
verses.textEnNkjv: Or do you not know that your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit whois in you, whom you have from God, and you are not your own?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you realize that your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit, who lives in you and was given to you by God? You do not belong to yourself,
verses.textEnNasb: Or do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit within you, whom you have from God, and that you are not your own?
verses.textEn: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own;

verses.textZh: 因为你们是用重价买来的。所以你们务要用自己的身体荣耀神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们是用重价买来的。所以你们务要用自己的身体荣耀神。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你们是重价买来的。所以，要在你们的身子上荣耀神。
verses.textEnNiv: you were bought at a price. Therefore honor God with your bodies.
verses.textEnEsv: for you were bought with a price. So glorify God in your body.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you were bought at a price; therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
verses.textEnNlt: for God bought you with a high price. So you must honor God with your body.
verses.textEnNasb: For you have been bought for a price: therefore glorify God in your body.
verses.textEn: you were bought at a price. Therefore honor God with your bodies.

verses.textZh: 关于你们信上所提的事:"男人不亲近女人倒好。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于你们信上所提的事:"男人不亲近女人倒好。"
verses.textZhCuv: 论到你们信上所提的事，我说男不近女倒好。
verses.textEnNiv: Now for the matters you wrote about: "It is good for a man not to have sexual relations with a woman."
verses.textEnEsv: Now concerning the matters about which you wrote: "It is good for a man not to have sexual relations with a woman."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now concerning the things of which you wrote to me: Itis good for a man not to touch a woman.
verses.textEnNlt: Now regarding the questions you asked in your letter. Yes, it is good to abstain from sexual relations.
verses.textEnNasb: Now concerning the things about which you wrote, it is good for a man not to touch a woman.
verses.textEn: Now for the matters you wrote about: "It is good for a man not to have sexual relations with a woman."

verses.textZh: 但为了避免淫乱的事，男人应当各有自己的妻子，女人也应当各有自己的丈夫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但为了避免淫乱的事，男人应当各有自己的妻子，女人也应当各有自己的丈夫。
verses.textZhCuv: 但要免淫乱的事，男子当各有自己的妻子；女子也当各有自己的丈夫。
verses.textEnNiv: But since sexual immorality is occurring, each man should have sexual relations with his own wife, and each woman with her own husband.
verses.textEnEsv: But because of the temptation to sexual immorality, each man should have his own wife and each woman her own husband.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless, because of sexual immorality, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.
verses.textEnNlt: But because there is so much sexual immorality, each man should have his own wife, and each woman should have her own husband.
verses.textEnNasb: But because of sexual immoralities, each man is to have his own wife, and each woman is to have her own husband.
verses.textEn: But since sexual immorality is occurring, each man should have sexual relations with his own wife, and each woman with her own husband.

verses.textZh: 丈夫对妻子应该尽他的本分，妻子对丈夫也应当这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 丈夫对妻子应该尽他的本分，妻子对丈夫也应当这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 丈夫当用合宜之分待妻子；妻子待丈夫也要如此。
verses.textEnNiv: The husband should fulfill his marital duty to his wife, and likewise the wife to her husband.
verses.textEnEsv: The husband should give to his wife her conjugal rights, and likewise the wife to her husband.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the husband render to his wife the affection due her, and likewise also the wife to her husband.
verses.textEnNlt: The husband should fulfill his wife’s sexual needs, and the wife should fulfill her husband’s needs.
verses.textEnNasb: The husband must fulfill his duty to his wife, and likewise the wife also to her husband.
verses.textEn: The husband should fulfill his marital duty to his wife, and likewise the wife to her husband.

verses.textZh: 妻子对自己的身体没有主权，权在丈夫；照样，丈夫对自己的身体也没有主权，权在妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 妻子对自己的身体没有主权，权在丈夫；照样，丈夫对自己的身体也没有主权，权在妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 妻子没有权柄主张自己的身子，乃在丈夫；丈夫也没有权柄主张自己的身子，乃在妻子。
verses.textEnNiv: The wife does not have authority over her own body but yields it to her husband. In the same way, the husband does not have authority over his own body but yields it to his wife.
verses.textEnEsv: For the wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the wife does.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband does. And likewise the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the wife does.
verses.textEnNlt: The wife gives authority over her body to her husband, and the husband gives authority over his body to his wife.
verses.textEnNasb: The wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband does; and likewise the husband also does not have authority over his own body, but the wife does.
verses.textEn: The wife does not have authority over her own body but yields it to her husband. In the same way, the husband does not have authority over his own body but yields it to his wife.

verses.textZh: 夫妻不可彼此亏负，除非为了要专心祷告，双方才可以同意暂时分房。以后仍要同房，免得撒但趁着你们情不自禁的时候诱惑你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 夫妻不可彼此亏负，除非为了要专心祷告，双方才可以同意暂时分房。以后仍要同房，免得撒但趁着你们情不自禁的时候诱惑你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 夫妻不可彼此亏负，除非两相情愿，暂时分房，为要专心祷告方可；以后仍要同房，免得撒但趁着你们情不自禁，引诱你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not deprive each other except perhaps by mutual consent and for a time, so that you may devote yourselves to prayer. Then come together again so that Satan will not tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not deprive one another, except perhaps by agreement for a limited time, that you may devote yourselves to prayer; but then come together again, so that Satan may not tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not deprive one another except with consent for a time, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again so that Satan does not tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not deprive each other of sexual relations, unless you both agree to refrain from sexual intimacy for a limited time so you can give yourselves more completely to prayer. Afterward, you should come together again so that Satan won’t be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
verses.textEnNasb: Stop depriving one another, except by agreement for a time so that you may devote yourselves to prayer, and come together again so that Satan will not tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
verses.textEn: Do not deprive each other except perhaps by mutual consent and for a time, so that you may devote yourselves to prayer. Then come together again so that Satan will not tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

verses.textZh: 我说这话是容许你们，并不是命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说这话是容许你们，并不是命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说这话，原是准你们的，不是命你们的。
verses.textEnNiv: I say this as a concession, not as a command.
verses.textEnEsv: Now as a concession, not a command, I say this.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I say this as a concession, not as a commandment.
verses.textEnNlt: I say this as a concession, not as a command.
verses.textEnNasb: But this I say by way of concession, not of command.
verses.textEn: I say this as a concession, not as a command.

verses.textZh: 我愿人人都像我一样；只是各人有各人从神得来的恩赐，有人是这样，有人是那样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我愿人人都像我一样；只是各人有各人从神得来的恩赐，有人是这样，有人是那样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我愿意众人像我一样；只是各人领受神的恩赐，一个是这样，一个是那样。
verses.textEnNiv: I wish that all of you were as I am. But each of you has your own gift from God; one has this gift, another has that.
verses.textEnEsv: I wish that all were as I myself am. But each has his own gift from God, one of one kind and one of another.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I wish that all men were even as I myself. But each one has his own gift from God, one in this manner and another in that.
verses.textEnNlt: But I wish everyone were single, just as I am. Yet each person has a special gift from God, of one kind or another.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet I wish that all men were even as I myself am. However, each has his own gift from God, one in this way, and another in that.
verses.textEn: I wish that all of you were as I am. But each of you has your own gift from God; one has this gift, another has that.

verses.textZh: 我现在要对未婚的人和寡妇说，他们若保持像我这样就好了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我现在要对未婚的人和寡妇说，他们若保持像我这样就好了；
verses.textZhCuv: 我对着没有嫁娶的和寡妇说，若他们常像我就好。
verses.textEnNiv: Now to the unmarried and the widows I say: It is good for them to stay unmarried, as I do.
verses.textEnEsv: To the unmarried and the widows I say that it is good for them to remain single, as I am.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I say to the unmarried and to the widows: It is good for them if they remain even as I am;
verses.textEnNlt: So I say to those who aren’t married and to widows—it’s better to stay unmarried, just as I am.
verses.textEnNasb: But I say to the unmarried and to widows that it is good for them if they remain even as I.
verses.textEn: Now to the unmarried and the widows I say: It is good for them to stay unmarried, as I do.

verses.textZh: 但如果不能自制，就应当结婚，因为结婚总比欲火焚身好。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但如果不能自制，就应当结婚，因为结婚总比欲火焚身好。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若自己禁止不住，就可以嫁娶。与其欲火攻心，倒不如嫁娶为妙。
verses.textEnNiv: But if they cannot control themselves, they should marry, for it is better to marry than to burn with passion.
verses.textEnEsv: But if they cannot exercise self-control, they should marry. For it is better to marry than to burn with passion.
verses.textEnNkjv: but if they cannot exercise self-control, let them marry. For it is better to marry than to burn withpassion.
verses.textEnNlt: But if they can’t control themselves, they should go ahead and marry. It’s better to marry than to burn with lust.
verses.textEnNasb: But if they do not have self-control, let them marry; for it is better to marry than to burn with passion.
verses.textEn: But if they cannot control themselves, they should marry, for it is better to marry than to burn with passion.

verses.textZh: 我要吩咐已婚的人 ，妻子不可离开丈夫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要吩咐已婚的人 ，妻子不可离开丈夫。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于那已经嫁娶的，我吩咐他们；其实不是我吩咐，乃是主吩咐说：妻子不可离开丈夫，
verses.textEnNiv: To the married I give this command (not I, but the Lord): A wife must not separate from her husband.
verses.textEnEsv: To the married I give this charge (not I, but the Lord): the wife should not separate from her husband
verses.textEnNkjv: Now to the married I command, yet not I but the Lord: A wife is not to depart from her husband.
verses.textEnNlt: But for those who are married, I have a command that comes not from me, but from the Lord. A wife must not leave her husband.
verses.textEnNasb: But to the married I give instructions, not I, but the Lord, that the wife is not to leave her husband
verses.textEn: To the married I give this command (not I, but the Lord): A wife must not separate from her husband.

verses.textZh: 如果离开了，就不可再嫁，不然，就要跟丈夫复合。丈夫也不可离弃妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果离开了，就不可再嫁，不然，就要跟丈夫复合。丈夫也不可离弃妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 若是离开了，不可再嫁，或是仍同丈夫和好。丈夫也不可离弃妻子。
verses.textEnNiv: But if she does, she must remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband. And a husband must not divorce his wife.
verses.textEnEsv: (but if she does, she should remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband), and the husband should not divorce his wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: But even if she does depart, let her remain unmarried or be reconciled to her husband. And a husband is not to divorce his wife.
verses.textEnNlt: But if she does leave him, let her remain single or else be reconciled to him. And the husband must not leave his wife.
verses.textEnNasb: (but if she does leave, she must remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband is not to divorce his wife.
verses.textEn: But if she does, she must remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband. And a husband must not divorce his wife.

verses.textZh: 我要对其余的人说 ，倘若某弟兄有不信的妻子，而她也情愿和他住在一起，他就不要离弃她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要对其余的人说 ，倘若某弟兄有不信的妻子，而她也情愿和他住在一起，他就不要离弃她。
verses.textZhCuv: 我对其余的人说（不是主说）：倘若某弟兄有不信的妻子，妻子也情愿和他同住，他就不要离弃妻子。
verses.textEnNiv: To the rest I say this (I, not the Lord): If any brother has a wife who is not a believer and she is willing to live with him, he must not divorce her.
verses.textEnEsv: To the rest I say (I, not the Lord) that if any brother has a wife who is an unbeliever, and she consents to live with him, he should not divorce her.
verses.textEnNkjv: But to the rest I, not the Lord, say: If any brother has a wife who does not believe, and she is willing to live with him, let him not divorce her.
verses.textEnNlt: Now, I will speak to the rest of you, though I do not have a direct command from the Lord. If a fellow believer has a wife who is not a believer and she is willing to continue living with him, he must not leave her.
verses.textEnNasb: But to the rest I say, not the Lord, that if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she consents to live with him, he must not divorce her.
verses.textEn: To the rest I say this (I, not the Lord): If any brother has a wife who is not a believer and she is willing to live with him, he must not divorce her.

verses.textZh: 如果妻子有不信的丈夫，而他也情愿和她住在一起，她也不要离弃丈夫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果妻子有不信的丈夫，而他也情愿和她住在一起，她也不要离弃丈夫。
verses.textZhCuv: 妻子有不信的丈夫，丈夫也情愿和她同住，她就不要离弃丈夫。
verses.textEnNiv: And if a woman has a husband who is not a believer and he is willing to live with her, she must not divorce him.
verses.textEnEsv: If any woman has a husband who is an unbeliever, and he consents to live with her, she should not divorce him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And a woman who has a husband who does not believe, if he is willing to live with her, let her not divorce him.
verses.textEnNlt: And if a believing woman has a husband who is not a believer and he is willing to continue living with her, she must not leave him.
verses.textEnNasb: And if any woman has an unbelieving husband, and he consents to live with her, she must not divorce her husband.
verses.textEn: And if a woman has a husband who is not a believer and he is willing to live with her, she must not divorce him.

verses.textZh: 因为不信的丈夫因着妻子成为圣洁，不信的妻子也因着那个弟兄成为圣洁了。不然，你们的儿女就是不洁净的，但现在他们都是圣洁的了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为不信的丈夫因着妻子成为圣洁，不信的妻子也因着那个弟兄成为圣洁了。不然，你们的儿女就是不洁净的，但现在他们都是圣洁的了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为不信的丈夫就因着妻子成了圣洁，并且不信的妻子就因着丈夫 成了圣洁。不然，你们的儿女就不洁净，但如今他们是圣洁的了。
verses.textEnNiv: For the unbelieving husband has been sanctified through his wife, and the unbelieving wife has been sanctified through her believing husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but as it is, they are holy.
verses.textEnEsv: For the unbelieving husband is made holy because of his wife, and the unbelieving wife is made holy because of her husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but as it is, they are holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband; otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
verses.textEnNlt: For the believing wife brings holiness to her marriage, and the believing husband brings holiness to his marriage. Otherwise, your children would not be holy, but now they are holy.
verses.textEnNasb: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified through his wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified through her believing husband; for otherwise your children are unclean, but now they are holy.
verses.textEn: For the unbelieving husband has been sanctified through his wife, and the unbelieving wife has been sanctified through her believing husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but as it is, they are holy.

verses.textZh: 如果那不信的要离去，就由他离去吧；在这种情形之下，信主的弟兄或姊妹都不必勉强。神呼召你们，是要你们和睦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果那不信的要离去，就由他离去吧；在这种情形之下，信主的弟兄或姊妹都不必勉强。神呼召你们，是要你们和睦。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若那不信的人要离去，就由他离去吧！无论是弟兄，是姊妹，遇着这样的事都不必拘束。神召我们原是要我们和睦。
verses.textEnNiv: But if the unbeliever leaves, let it be so. The brother or the sister is not bound in such circumstances; God has called us to live in peace.
verses.textEnEsv: But if the unbelieving partner separates, let it be so. In such cases the brother or sister is not enslaved. God has called you to peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the unbeliever departs, let him depart; a brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases. But God has called us to peace.
verses.textEnNlt: (But if the husband or wife who isn’t a believer insists on leaving, let them go. In such cases the believing husband or wife is no longer bound to the other, for God has called you to live in peace.)
verses.textEnNasb: Yet if the unbelieving one is leaving, let him leave; the brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.
verses.textEn: But if the unbeliever leaves, let it be so. The brother or the sister is not bound in such circumstances; God has called us to live in peace.

verses.textZh: 你这作妻子的，你怎么知道能否救你的丈夫呢？你这作丈夫的，你怎么知道能否救你的妻子呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这作妻子的，你怎么知道能否救你的丈夫呢？你这作丈夫的，你怎么知道能否救你的妻子呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你这作妻子的，怎么知道不能救你的丈夫呢？你这作丈夫的，怎么知道不能救你的妻子呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or, how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
verses.textEnEsv: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
verses.textEnNkjv: For how do you know, O wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, O husband, whether you will save your wife?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you wives realize that your husbands might be saved because of you? And don’t you husbands realize that your wives might be saved because of you?
verses.textEnNasb: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
verses.textEn: How do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or, how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

verses.textZh: 不过，主怎样分给各人，神怎样呼召各人，各人就要照着去行事为人。我也这样吩咐各教会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过，主怎样分给各人，神怎样呼召各人，各人就要照着去行事为人。我也这样吩咐各教会。
verses.textZhCuv: 只要照主所分给各人的，和神所召各人的而行。我吩咐各教会都是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, each person should live as a believer in whatever situation the Lord has assigned to them, just as God has called them. This is the rule I lay down in all the churches.
verses.textEnEsv: Only let each person lead the life that the Lord has assigned to him, and to which God has called him. This is my rule in all the churches.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as God has distributed to each one, as the Lord has called each one, so let him walk. And so I ordain in all the churches.
verses.textEnNlt: Each of you should continue to live in whatever situation the Lord has placed you, and remain as you were when God first called you. This is my rule for all the churches.
verses.textEnNasb: Only, as the Lord has assigned to each one, as God has called each, in this way let him walk. And so I direct in all the churches.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, each person should live as a believer in whatever situation the Lord has assigned to them, just as God has called them. This is the rule I lay down in all the churches.

verses.textZh: 有人受了割礼而蒙召的吗？他就不要遮掩割礼的记号。有人未受割礼而蒙召的吗？他就不要受割礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人受了割礼而蒙召的吗？他就不要遮掩割礼的记号。有人未受割礼而蒙召的吗？他就不要受割礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人已受割礼蒙召呢，就不要废割礼；有人未受割礼蒙召呢，就不要受割礼。
verses.textEnNiv: Was a man already circumcised when he was called? He should not become uncircumcised. Was a man uncircumcised when he was called? He should not be circumcised.
verses.textEnEsv: Was anyone at the time of his call already circumcised? Let him not seek to remove the marks of circumcision. Was anyone at the time of his call uncircumcised? Let him not seek circumcision.
verses.textEnNkjv: Was anyone called while circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Was anyone called while uncircumcised? Let him not be circumcised.
verses.textEnNlt: For instance, a man who was circumcised before he became a believer should not try to reverse it. And the man who was uncircumcised when he became a believer should not be circumcised now.
verses.textEnNasb: Was any man called when he was already circumcised? He is not to become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? He is not to be circumcised.
verses.textEn: Was a man already circumcised when he was called? He should not become uncircumcised. Was a man uncircumcised when he was called? He should not be circumcised.

verses.textZh: 割礼算不得甚么，没有割礼也算不得甚么，要紧的是遵守神的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 割礼算不得甚么，没有割礼也算不得甚么，要紧的是遵守神的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 受割礼算不得什么，不受割礼也算不得什么，只要守神的诫命就是了。
verses.textEnNiv: Circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing. Keeping God’s commands is what counts.
verses.textEnEsv: For neither circumcision counts for anything nor uncircumcision, but keeping the commandments of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing, but keeping the commandments of God iswhatmatters.
verses.textEnNlt: For it makes no difference whether or not a man has been circumcised. The important thing is to keep God’s commandments.
verses.textEnNasb: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is the keeping of the commandments of God.
verses.textEn: Circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing. Keeping God’s commands is what counts.

verses.textZh: 各人蒙召的时候怎样，他就应当保持原来的情况。
verses.textZhCnvs: 各人蒙召的时候怎样，他就应当保持原来的情况。
verses.textZhCuv: 各人蒙召的时候是什么身分，仍要守住这身分。
verses.textEnNiv: Each person should remain in the situation they were in when God called them.
verses.textEnEsv: Each one should remain in the condition in which he was called.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let each one remain in the same calling in which he was called.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, each of you should remain as you were when God called you.
verses.textEnNasb: Each person is to remain in that state in which he was called.
verses.textEn: Each person should remain in the situation they were in when God called them.

verses.textZh: 你蒙召的时候是作奴仆的吗？不要为此烦恼。但如果你能够得到自由，就要把握这机会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你蒙召的时候是作奴仆的吗？不要为此烦恼。但如果你能够得到自由，就要把握这机会。
verses.textZhCuv: 你是作奴隶蒙召的吗？不要因此忧虑；若能以自由，就求自由更好。
verses.textEnNiv: Were you a slave when you were called? Don’t let it trouble you—although if you can gain your freedom, do so.
verses.textEnEsv: Were you a bondservant when called? Do not be concerned about it. (But if you can gain your freedom, avail yourself of the opportunity.)
verses.textEnNkjv: Were you called while a slave? Do not be concerned about it; but if you can be made free, rather use it.
verses.textEnNlt: Are you a slave? Don’t let that worry you—but if you get a chance to be free, take it.
verses.textEnNasb: Were you called as a slave? Do not let it concern you. But if you are also able to become free, take advantage of that.
verses.textEn: Were you a slave when you were called? Don’t let it trouble you—although if you can gain your freedom, do so.

verses.textZh: 因为作奴仆的蒙了主的呼召，就是属于主的自由人了；照样，自由的人蒙了呼召，他就是基督的奴仆了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为作奴仆的蒙了主的呼召，就是属于主的自由人了；照样，自由的人蒙了呼召，他就是基督的奴仆了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为作奴仆蒙召于主的，就是主所释放的人；作自由之人蒙召的，就是基督的奴仆。
verses.textEnNiv: For the one who was a slave when called to faith in the Lord is the Lord’s freed person; similarly, the one who was free when called is Christ’s slave.
verses.textEnEsv: For he who was called in the Lord as a bondservant is a freedman of the Lord. Likewise he who was free when called is a bondservant of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he who is called in the Lord while a slave is the Lord’s freedman. Likewise he who is called while free is Christ’s slave.
verses.textEnNlt: And remember, if you were a slave when the Lord called you, you are now free in the Lord. And if you were free when the Lord called you, you are now a slave of Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For the one who was called in the Lord as a slave, is the Lord’s freed person; likewise the one who was called as free, is Christ’s slave.
verses.textEn: For the one who was a slave when called to faith in the Lord is the Lord’s freed person; similarly, the one who was free when called is Christ’s slave.

verses.textZh: 你们是用重价买来的，不要作人的奴仆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们是用重价买来的，不要作人的奴仆。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们是重价买来的，不要作人的奴仆。
verses.textEnNiv: You were bought at a price; do not become slaves of human beings.
verses.textEnEsv: You were bought with a price; do not become bondservants of men.
verses.textEnNkjv: You were bought at a price; do not become slaves of men.
verses.textEnNlt: God paid a high price for you, so don’t be enslaved by the world.
verses.textEnNasb: You were bought for a price; do not become slaves of people.
verses.textEn: You were bought at a price; do not become slaves of human beings.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，你们各人蒙召的时候怎样，就应当在神面前保持这原来的情况。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，你们各人蒙召的时候怎样，就应当在神面前保持这原来的情况。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，你们各人蒙召的时候是什么身分，仍要在神面前守住这身分。
verses.textEnNiv: Brothers and sisters, each person, as responsible to God, should remain in the situation they were in when God called them.
verses.textEnEsv: So, brothers, in whatever condition each was called, there let him remain with God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Brethren, let each one remain with God in that state in which he was called.
verses.textEnNlt: Each of you, dear brothers and sisters, should remain as you were when God first called you.
verses.textEnNasb: Brothers and sisters, each one is to remain with God in that condition in which he was called.
verses.textEn: Brothers and sisters, each person, as responsible to God, should remain in the situation they were in when God called them.

verses.textZh: 关于未婚的，我没有主的命令，但我既然蒙了主的怜悯，成为可信靠的人，就把我的意见提出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于未婚的，我没有主的命令，但我既然蒙了主的怜悯，成为可信靠的人，就把我的意见提出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到童身的人，我没有主的命令，但我既蒙主怜恤能作忠心的人，就把自己的意见告诉你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Now about virgins: I have no command from the Lord, but I give a judgment as one who by the Lord’s mercy is trustworthy.
verses.textEnEsv: Now concerning the betrothed, I have no command from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who by the Lord’s mercy is trustworthy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now concerning virgins: I have no commandment from the Lord; yet I give judgment as one whom the Lord in His mercy has made trustworthy.
verses.textEnNlt: Now regarding your question about the young women who are not yet married. I do not have a command from the Lord for them. But the Lord in his mercy has given me wisdom that can be trusted, and I will share it with you.
verses.textEnNasb: Now concerning virgins, I have no command of the Lord, but I am offering direction as one who by the mercy of the Lord is trustworthy.
verses.textEn: Now about virgins: I have no command from the Lord, but I give a judgment as one who by the Lord’s mercy is trustworthy.

verses.textZh: 为了目前的困难，我认为人最好能保持现状。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了目前的困难，我认为人最好能保持现状。
verses.textZhCuv: 因现今的艰难，据我看来，人不如守素安常才好。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of the present crisis, I think that it is good for a man to remain as he is.
verses.textEnEsv: I think that in view of the present distress it is good for a person to remain as he is.
verses.textEnNkjv: I suppose therefore that this is good because of the present distress— that itis good for a man to remain as he is:
verses.textEnNlt: Because of the present crisis, I think it is best to remain as you are.
verses.textEnNasb: I think, then, that this is good in view of the present distress, that it is good for a man to remain as he is.
verses.textEn: Because of the present crisis, I think that it is good for a man to remain as he is.

verses.textZh: 你已经有了妻子吗？就不要想摆脱。你还没有妻子吗？就不要去找妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你已经有了妻子吗？就不要想摆脱。你还没有妻子吗？就不要去找妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 你有妻子缠着呢，就不要求脱离；你没有妻子缠着呢，就不要求妻子。
verses.textEnNiv: Are you pledged to a woman? Do not seek to be released. Are you free from such a commitment? Do not look for a wife.
verses.textEnEsv: Are you bound to a wife? Do not seek to be free. Are you free from a wife? Do not seek a wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: Are you bound to a wife? Do not seek to be loosed. Are you loosed from a wife? Do not seek a wife.
verses.textEnNlt: If you have a wife, do not seek to end the marriage. If you do not have a wife, do not seek to get married.
verses.textEnNasb: Are you bound to a wife? Do not seek to be released. Are you released from a wife? Do not seek a wife.
verses.textEn: Are you pledged to a woman? Do not seek to be released. Are you free from such a commitment? Do not look for a wife.

verses.textZh: 如果你娶妻子，这不是犯罪；如果处女出嫁，也不是犯罪。不过，这样的人要受肉体上的苦难，我却不愿你们受这苦难。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你娶妻子，这不是犯罪；如果处女出嫁，也不是犯罪。不过，这样的人要受肉体上的苦难，我却不愿你们受这苦难。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若娶妻，并不是犯罪；处女若出嫁，也不是犯罪。然而这等人肉身必受苦难，我却愿意你们免这苦难。
verses.textEnNiv: But if you do marry, you have not sinned; and if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. But those who marry will face many troubles in this life, and I want to spare you this.
verses.textEnEsv: But if you do marry, you have not sinned, and if a betrothed woman marries, she has not sinned. Yet those who marry will have worldly troubles, and I would spare you that.
verses.textEnNkjv: But even if you do marry, you have not sinned; and if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Nevertheless such will have trouble in the flesh, but I would spare you.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you do get married, it is not a sin. And if a young woman gets married, it is not a sin. However, those who get married at this time will have troubles, and I am trying to spare you those problems.
verses.textEnNasb: But if you marry, you have not sinned; and if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such people as yourselves will have trouble in this life, and I am trying to spare you.
verses.textEn: But if you do marry, you have not sinned; and if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. But those who marry will face many troubles in this life, and I want to spare you this.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我是说时候不多了。从今以后，有妻子的要像没有妻子的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我是说时候不多了。从今以后，有妻子的要像没有妻子的，
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我对你们说：时候减少了。从此以后，那有妻子的，要像没有妻子；
verses.textEnNiv: What I mean, brothers and sisters, is that the time is short. From now on those who have wives should live as if they do not;
verses.textEnEsv: This is what I mean, brothers: the appointed time has grown very short. From now on, let those who have wives live as though they had none,
verses.textEnNkjv: But this I say, brethren, the time is short, so that from now on even those who have wives should be as though they had none,
verses.textEnNlt: But let me say this, dear brothers and sisters: The time that remains is very short. So from now on, those with wives should not focus only on their marriage.
verses.textEnNasb: But this I say, brothers, the time has been shortened, so that from now on those who have wives should be as though they had none;
verses.textEn: What I mean, brothers and sisters, is that the time is short. From now on those who have wives should live as if they do not;

verses.textZh: 哀哭的要像不哀哭的，快乐的要像不快乐的，买了东西的要像一无所得的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 哀哭的要像不哀哭的，快乐的要像不快乐的，买了东西的要像一无所得的，
verses.textZhCuv: 哀哭的，要像不哀哭；快乐的，要像不快乐；置买的，要像无有所得；
verses.textEnNiv: those who mourn, as if they did not; those who are happy, as if they were not; those who buy something, as if it were not theirs to keep;
verses.textEnEsv: and those who mourn as though they were not mourning, and those who rejoice as though they were not rejoicing, and those who buy as though they had no goods,
verses.textEnNkjv: those who weep as though they did not weep, those who rejoice as though they did not rejoice, those who buy as though they did not possess,
verses.textEnNlt: Those who weep or who rejoice or who buy things should not be absorbed by their weeping or their joy or their possessions.
verses.textEnNasb: and those who weep, as though they did not weep; and those who rejoice, as though they did not rejoice; and those who buy, as though they did not possess;
verses.textEn: those who mourn, as if they did not; those who are happy, as if they were not; those who buy something, as if it were not theirs to keep;

verses.textZh: 享用世上百物的要像没有享用的一样，因为这世上的情况都要过去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 享用世上百物的要像没有享用的一样，因为这世上的情况都要过去。
verses.textZhCuv: 用世物的，要像不用世物，因为这世界的样子将要过去了。
verses.textEnNiv: those who use the things of the world, as if not engrossed in them. For this world in its present form is passing away.
verses.textEnEsv: and those who deal with the world as though they had no dealings with it. For the present form of this world is passing away.
verses.textEnNkjv: and those who use this world as not misusing it. For the form of this world is passing away.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who use the things of the world should not become attached to them. For this world as we know it will soon pass away.
verses.textEnNasb: and those who use the world, as though they did not make full use of it; for the present form of this world is passing away.
verses.textEn: those who use the things of the world, as if not engrossed in them. For this world in its present form is passing away.

verses.textZh: 我愿你们无所挂虑。没有娶妻子的人，挂念的是主的事，想怎样去得主喜悦；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我愿你们无所挂虑。没有娶妻子的人，挂念的是主的事，想怎样去得主喜悦；
verses.textZhCuv: 我愿你们无所挂虑。没有娶妻的，是为主的事挂虑，想怎样叫主喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: I would like you to be free from concern. An unmarried man is concerned about the Lord’s affairs—how he can please the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: I want you to be free from anxieties. The unmarried man is anxious about the things of the Lord, how to please the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I want you to be without care. He who is unmarried cares for the things of the Lord—how he may please the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I want you to be free from the concerns of this life. An unmarried man can spend his time doing the Lord’s work and thinking how to please him.
verses.textEnNasb: But I want you to be free from concern. One who is unmarried is concerned about the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;
verses.textEn: I would like you to be free from concern. An unmarried man is concerned about the Lord’s affairs—how he can please the Lord.

verses.textZh: 但娶了妻子的人是为世上的事挂虑，想怎样去讨妻子的欢心，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但娶了妻子的人是为世上的事挂虑，想怎样去讨妻子的欢心，
verses.textZhCuv: 娶了妻的，是为世上的事挂虑，想怎样叫妻子喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: But a married man is concerned about the affairs of this world—how he can please his wife—
verses.textEnEsv: But the married man is anxious about worldly things, how to please his wife,
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who is married cares about the things of the world—how he may please his wife.
verses.textEnNlt: But a married man has to think about his earthly responsibilities and how to please his wife.
verses.textEnNasb: but one who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife,
verses.textEn: But a married man is concerned about the affairs of this world—how he can please his wife—

verses.textZh: 这样他就分心了。没有结婚的妇女和守独身的女子，挂念的是主的事，好让身体和心灵都成为圣洁；但结了婚的妇女是为世上的事挂虑，想怎样去讨丈夫的欢心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样他就分心了。没有结婚的妇女和守独身的女子，挂念的是主的事，好让身体和心灵都成为圣洁；但结了婚的妇女是为世上的事挂虑，想怎样去讨丈夫的欢心。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人和处女也有分别。没有出嫁的，是为主的事挂虑，要身体、灵魂都圣洁；已经出嫁的，是为世上的事挂虑，想怎样叫丈夫喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: and his interests are divided. An unmarried woman or virgin is concerned about the Lord’s affairs: Her aim is to be devoted to the Lord in both body and spirit. But a married woman is concerned about the affairs of this world—how she can please her husband.
verses.textEnEsv: and his interests are divided. And the unmarried or betrothed woman is anxious about the things of the Lord, how to be holy in body and spirit. But the married woman is anxious about worldly things, how to please her husband.
verses.textEnNkjv: There is a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.
verses.textEnNlt: His interests are divided. In the same way, a woman who is no longer married or has never been married can be devoted to the Lord and holy in body and in spirit. But a married woman has to think about her earthly responsibilities and how to please her husband.
verses.textEnNasb: and his interests are divided. The woman who is unmarried, and the virgin, is concerned about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and spirit; but one who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how she may please her husband.
verses.textEn: and his interests are divided. An unmarried woman or virgin is concerned about the Lord’s affairs: Her aim is to be devoted to the Lord in both body and spirit. But a married woman is concerned about the affairs of this world—how she can please her husband.

verses.textZh: 我说这话，是为了你们自己的益处；我不是要限制你们，而是要你们作合宜的事，一心一意地对主忠诚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说这话，是为了你们自己的益处；我不是要限制你们，而是要你们作合宜的事，一心一意地对主忠诚。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说这话是为你们的益处，不是要牢笼你们，乃是要叫你们行合宜的事，得以殷勤服事主，没有分心的事。
verses.textEnNiv: I am saying this for your own good, not to restrict you, but that you may live in a right way in undivided devotion to the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: I say this for your own benefit, not to lay any restraint upon you, but to promote good order and to secure your undivided devotion to the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this I say for your own profit, not that I may put a leash on you, but for what is proper, and that you may serve the Lord without distraction.
verses.textEnNlt: I am saying this for your benefit, not to place restrictions on you. I want you to do whatever will help you serve the Lord best, with as few distractions as possible.
verses.textEnNasb: I say this for your own benefit, not to put a restraint on you, but to promote what is appropriate and to secure undistracted devotion to the Lord.
verses.textEn: I am saying this for your own good, not to restrict you, but that you may live in a right way in undivided devotion to the Lord.

verses.textZh: 如果有人认为是亏待了自己的女朋友，她也过了结婚的年龄，而他觉得应当结婚，他就可以照着自己的意思去作，这不是犯罪；他们应该结婚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人认为是亏待了自己的女朋友，她也过了结婚的年龄，而他觉得应当结婚，他就可以照着自己的意思去作，这不是犯罪；他们应该结婚。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人以为自己待他的女儿不合宜，女儿也过了年岁，事又当行，他就可随意办理，不算有罪，叫二人成亲就是了。
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone is worried that he might not be acting honorably toward the virgin he is engaged to, and if his passions are too strong and he feels he ought to marry, he should do as he wants. He is not sinning. They should get married.
