verses.textEnEsv: If anyone thinks that he is not behaving properly toward his betrothed, if his passions are strong, and it has to be, let him do as he wishes: let them marry—it is no sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if any man thinks he is behaving improperly toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of youth, and thus it must be, let him do what he wishes. He does not sin; let them marry.
verses.textEnNlt: But if a man thinks that he’s treating his fiancée improperly and will inevitably give in to his passion, let him marry her as he wishes. It is not a sin.
verses.textEnNasb: But if anyone thinks that he is acting dishonorably toward his virgin, if she is past her youth and it ought to be so, let him do what he wishes, he is not sinning; let them marry.
verses.textEn: If anyone is worried that he might not be acting honorably toward the virgin he is engaged to, and if his passions are too strong and he feels he ought to marry, he should do as he wants. He is not sinning. They should get married.

verses.textZh: 但如果他心里坚决，没有甚么不得已的原因，又可以控制自己的意志，决心让女朋友持守独身；这样作也是好的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但如果他心里坚决，没有甚么不得已的原因，又可以控制自己的意志，决心让女朋友持守独身；这样作也是好的。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若人心里坚定，没有不得已的事，并且由得自己作主，心里又决定了留下女儿不出嫁，如此行也好。
verses.textEnNiv: But the man who has settled the matter in his own mind, who is under no compulsion but has control over his own will, and who has made up his mind not to marry the virgin—this man also does the right thing.
verses.textEnEsv: But whoever is firmly established in his heart, being under no necessity but having his desire under control, and has determined this in his heart, to keep her as his betrothed, he will do well.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no necessity, but has power over his own will, and has so determined in his heart that he will keep his virgin, does well.
verses.textEnNlt: But if he has decided firmly not to marry and there is no urgency and he can control his passion, he does well not to marry.
verses.textEnNasb: But the one who stands firm in his heart, if he is not under constraint, but has authority over his own will, and has decided this in his own heart, to keep his own virgin, he will do well.
verses.textEn: But the man who has settled the matter in his own mind, who is under no compulsion but has control over his own will, and who has made up his mind not to marry the virgin—this man also does the right thing.

verses.textZh: 所以，那跟自己的女朋友结婚的，作得好，那不结婚的，作得更好。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，那跟自己的女朋友结婚的，作得好，那不结婚的，作得更好。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样看来，叫自己的女儿出嫁是好，不叫她出嫁更是好。
verses.textEnNiv: So then, he who marries the virgin does right, but he who does not marry her does better.
verses.textEnEsv: So then he who marries his betrothed does well, and he who refrains from marriage will do even better.
verses.textEnNkjv: So then he who gives her in marriage does well, but he who does not give her in marriage does better.
verses.textEnNlt: So the person who marries his fiancée does well, and the person who doesn’t marry does even better.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, both the one who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and the one who does not give her in marriage will do better.
verses.textEn: So then, he who marries the virgin does right, but he who does not marry her does better.

verses.textZh: 丈夫活着的时候，妻子是受约束的；丈夫若死了，她就可以自由地嫁给她愿意嫁的人，只是要嫁给主里的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 丈夫活着的时候，妻子是受约束的；丈夫若死了，她就可以自由地嫁给她愿意嫁的人，只是要嫁给主里的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 丈夫活着的时候，妻子是被约束的；丈夫若死了，妻子就可以自由，随意再嫁，只是要嫁这在主里面的人。
verses.textEnNiv: A woman is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, but he must belong to the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: A wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to be married to whom she wishes, only in the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: A wife is bound by law as long as her husband lives; but if her husband dies, she is at liberty to be married to whom she wishes, only in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: A wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives. If her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, but only if he loves the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: A wife is bound as long as her husband lives; but if her husband dies, she is free to be married to whom she wishes, only in the Lord.
verses.textEn: A woman is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, but he must belong to the Lord.

verses.textZh: 然而照我的意见，倘若她能守节，就更有福了。我想我这话也是神的灵感动的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而照我的意见，倘若她能守节，就更有福了。我想我这话也是神的灵感动的。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而按我的意见，若常守节更有福气。我也想自己是被神的灵感动了。
verses.textEnNiv: In my judgment, she is happier if she stays as she is—and I think that I too have the Spirit of God.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet in my judgment she is happier if she remains as she is. And I think that I too have the Spirit of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But she is happier if she remains as she is, according to my judgment—and I think I also have the Spirit of God.
verses.textEnNlt: But in my opinion it would be better for her to stay single, and I think I am giving you counsel from God’s Spirit when I say this.
verses.textEnNasb: But in my opinion she is happier if she remains as she is; and I think that I also have the Spirit of God.
verses.textEn: In my judgment, she is happier if she stays as she is—and I think that I too have the Spirit of God.

verses.textZh: 关于祭过偶像的食物，我们晓得我们都有知识。但知识会使人自高自大，唯有爱心能造就人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于祭过偶像的食物，我们晓得我们都有知识。但知识会使人自高自大，唯有爱心能造就人。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到祭偶像之物，我们晓得我们都有知识。但知识是叫人自高自大，惟有爱心能造就人。
verses.textEnNiv: Now about food sacrificed to idols: We know that "We all possess knowledge." But knowledge puffs up while love builds up.
verses.textEnEsv: Now concerning food offered to idols: we know that "all of us possess knowledge." This "knowledge" puffs up, but love builds up.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now concerning things offered to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love edifies.
verses.textEnNlt: Now regarding your question about food that has been offered to idols. Yes, we know that "we all have knowledge" about this issue. But while knowledge makes us feel important, it is love that strengthens the church.
verses.textEnNasb: Now concerning food sacrificed to idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge makes one conceited, but love edifies people.
verses.textEn: Now about food sacrificed to idols: We know that "We all possess knowledge." But knowledge puffs up while love builds up.

verses.textZh: 如果有人自以为知道些甚么，那么，他应该知道的，他还是不知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人自以为知道些甚么，那么，他应该知道的，他还是不知道。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人以为自己知道什么，按他所当知道的，他仍是不知道。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who think they know something do not yet know as they ought to know.
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone imagines that he knows something, he does not yet know as he ought to know.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he knows nothing yet as he ought to know.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who claims to know all the answers doesn’t really know very much.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone thinks that he knows anything, he has not yet known as he ought to know;
verses.textEn: Those who think they know something do not yet know as they ought to know.

verses.textZh: 如果有人爱神，这人是神所知道的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人爱神，这人是神所知道的。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人爱神，这人乃是神所知道的。
verses.textEnNiv: But whoever loves God is known by God.
verses.textEnEsv: But if anyone loves God, he is known by God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if anyone loves God, this one is known by Him.
verses.textEnNlt: But the person who loves God is the one whom God recognizes.
verses.textEnNasb: but if anyone loves God, he is known by Him.
verses.textEn: But whoever loves God is known by God.

verses.textZh: 关于吃祭过偶像的食物，我们知道世上的偶像算不得甚么，也知道神只有一位，没有别的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于吃祭过偶像的食物，我们知道世上的偶像算不得甚么，也知道神只有一位，没有别的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到吃祭偶像之物，我们知道偶像在世上算不得什么，也知道神只有一位，再没有别的神。
verses.textEnNiv: So then, about eating food sacrificed to idols: We know that "An idol is nothing at all in the world" and that "There is no God but one."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, as to the eating of food offered to idols, we know that "an idol has no real existence," and that "there is no God but one."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore concerning the eating of things offered to idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that thereis no other God but one.
verses.textEnNlt: So, what about eating meat that has been offered to idols? Well, we all know that an idol is not really a god and that there is only one God.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, concerning the eating of food sacrificed to idols, we know that an idol is nothing at all in the world, and that there is no God but one.
verses.textEn: So then, about eating food sacrificed to idols: We know that "An idol is nothing at all in the world" and that "There is no God but one."

verses.textZh: 虽然有被称为神的，无论在天上或在地上 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然有被称为神的，无论在天上或在地上 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 虽有称为神的，或在天，或在地，就如那许多的神，许多的主；
verses.textEnNiv: For even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth (as indeed there are many "gods" and many "lords"),
verses.textEnEsv: For although there may be so-called gods in heaven or on earth—as indeed there are many "gods" and many "lords"—
verses.textEnNkjv: For even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth (as there are many gods and many lords),
verses.textEnNlt: There may be so-called gods both in heaven and on earth, and some people actually worship many gods and many lords.
verses.textEnNasb: For even if there are so-called gods whether in heaven or on earth, as indeed there are many gods and many lords,
verses.textEn: For even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth (as indeed there are many "gods" and many "lords"),

verses.textZh: 然而我们只有一位神，就是父；万物都是从他而来，我们也为了他而活。我们也只有一位主，就是耶稣基督；万物都是借着他而有的，我们也是借着他而有的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而我们只有一位神，就是父；万物都是从他而来，我们也为了他而活。我们也只有一位主，就是耶稣基督；万物都是借着他而有的，我们也是借着他而有的。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而我们只有一位神，就是父－万物都本于他；我们也归于他－并有一位主，就是耶稣基督－万物都是藉着他有的；我们也是藉着他有的。
verses.textEnNiv: yet for us there is but one God, the Father, from whom all things came and for whom we live; and there is but one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom all things came and through whom we live.
verses.textEnEsv: yet for us there is one God, the Father, from whom are all things and for whom we exist, and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things and through whom we exist.
verses.textEnNkjv: yet for us thereis one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for Him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and through whom we live.
verses.textEnNlt: But for us, There is one God, the Father, by whom all things were created, and for whom we live. And there is one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom all things were created, and through whom we live.
verses.textEnNasb: yet for us there is only one God, the Father, from whom are all things, and we exist for Him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we exist through Him.
verses.textEn: yet for us there is but one God, the Father, from whom all things came and for whom we live; and there is but one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom all things came and through whom we live.

verses.textZh: 不过，这种知识不是人人都有的。有些人直到现在习惯了拜偶像的事，因此他们吃的时候，就把这些食物看作是真的献过给偶像的；他们的良心既然软弱，就被污秽了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过，这种知识不是人人都有的。有些人直到现在习惯了拜偶像的事，因此他们吃的时候，就把这些食物看作是真的献过给偶像的；他们的良心既然软弱，就被污秽了。
verses.textZhCuv: 但人不都有这等知识。有人到如今因拜惯了偶像，就以为所吃的是祭偶像之物。他们的良心既然软弱，也就污秽了。
verses.textEnNiv: But not everyone possesses this knowledge. Some people are still so accustomed to idols that when they eat sacrificial food they think of it as having been sacrificed to a god, and since their conscience is weak, it is defiled.
verses.textEnEsv: However, not all possess this knowledge. But some, through former association with idols, eat food as really offered to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, thereis not in everyone that knowledge; for some, with consciousness of the idol, until now eat it as a thing offered to an idol; and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.
verses.textEnNlt: However, not all believers know this. Some are accustomed to thinking of idols as being real, so when they eat food that has been offered to idols, they think of it as the worship of real gods, and their weak consciences are violated.
verses.textEnNasb: However, not all people have this knowledge; but some, being accustomed to the idol until now, eat food as if it were sacrificed to an idol; and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.
verses.textEn: But not everyone possesses this knowledge. Some people are still so accustomed to idols that when they eat sacrificial food they think of it as having been sacrificed to a god, and since their conscience is weak, it is defiled.

verses.textZh: 其实食物不能使我们亲近神，我们不吃也无损，吃也无益。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实食物不能使我们亲近神，我们不吃也无损，吃也无益。
verses.textZhCuv: 其实食物不能叫神看中我们，因为我们不吃也无损，吃也无益。
verses.textEnNiv: But food does not bring us near to God; we are no worse if we do not eat, and no better if we do.
verses.textEnEsv: Food will not commend us to God. We are no worse off if we do not eat, and no better off if we do.
verses.textEnNkjv: But food does not commend us to God; for neither if we eat are we the better, nor if we do not eat are we the worse.
verses.textEnNlt: It’s true that we can’t win God’s approval by what we eat. We don’t lose anything if we don’t eat it, and we don’t gain anything if we do.
verses.textEnNasb: Now food will not bring us close to God; we are neither the worse if we do not eat, nor the better if we do eat.
verses.textEn: But food does not bring us near to God; we are no worse if we do not eat, and no better if we do.

verses.textZh: 然而你们要谨慎，免得你们这自由成了软弱的人的绊脚石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而你们要谨慎，免得你们这自由成了软弱的人的绊脚石。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是你们要谨慎，恐怕你们这自由竟成了那软弱人的绊脚石。
verses.textEnNiv: Be careful, however, that the exercise of your rights does not become a stumbling block to the weak.
verses.textEnEsv: But take care that this right of yours does not somehow become a stumbling block to the weak.
verses.textEnNkjv: But beware lest somehow this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to those who are weak.
verses.textEnNlt: But you must be careful so that your freedom does not cause others with a weaker conscience to stumble.
verses.textEnNasb: But take care that this freedom of yours does not somehow become a stumbling block to the weak.
verses.textEn: Be careful, however, that the exercise of your rights does not become a stumbling block to the weak.

verses.textZh: 因为如果有人看见你这有知识的人，在偶像的庙里吃喝，他的良心若是软弱，他不就放胆去吃那祭过偶像的食物吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为如果有人看见你这有知识的人，在偶像的庙里吃喝，他的良心若是软弱，他不就放胆去吃那祭过偶像的食物吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人见你这有知识的，在偶像的庙里坐席，这人的良心若是软弱，岂不放胆去吃那祭偶像之物吗？
verses.textEnNiv: For if someone with a weak conscience sees you, with all your knowledge, eating in an idol’s temple, won’t that person be emboldened to eat what is sacrificed to idols?
verses.textEnEsv: For if anyone sees you who have knowledge eating in an idol’s temple, will he not be encouraged, if his conscience is weak, to eat food offered to idols?
verses.textEnNkjv: For if anyone sees you who have knowledge eating in an idol’s temple, will not the conscience of him who is weak be emboldened to eat those things offered to idols?
verses.textEnNlt: For if others see you—with your "superior knowledge"—eating in the temple of an idol, won’t they be encouraged to violate their conscience by eating food that has been offered to an idol?
verses.textEnNasb: For if someone sees you, the one who has knowledge, dining in an idol’s temple, will his conscience, if he is weak, not be strengthened to eat things sacrificed to idols?
verses.textEn: For if someone with a weak conscience sees you, with all your knowledge, eating in an idol’s temple, won’t that person be emboldened to eat what is sacrificed to idols?

verses.textZh: 因此，基督已经为他死了的那软弱的弟兄，就因你的知识而灭亡了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，基督已经为他死了的那软弱的弟兄，就因你的知识而灭亡了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，基督为他死的那软弱弟兄，也就因你的知识沉沦了。
verses.textEnNiv: So this weak brother or sister, for whom Christ died, is destroyed by your knowledge.
verses.textEnEsv: And so by your knowledge this weak person is destroyed, the brother for whom Christ died.
verses.textEnNkjv: And because of your knowledge shall the weak brother perish, for whom Christ died?
verses.textEnNlt: So because of your superior knowledge, a weak believer for whom Christ died will be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: For through your knowledge the one who is weak is ruined, the brother or sister for whose sake Christ died.
verses.textEn: So this weak brother or sister, for whom Christ died, is destroyed by your knowledge.

verses.textZh: 你们这样得罪弟兄，伤了他们软弱的良心，就是得罪基督了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们这样得罪弟兄，伤了他们软弱的良心，就是得罪基督了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这样得罪弟兄们，伤了他们软弱的良心，就是得罪基督。
verses.textEnNiv: When you sin against them in this way and wound their weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus, sinning against your brothers and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when you thus sin against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: And when you sin against other believers by encouraging them to do something they believe is wrong, you are sinning against Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: And so, by sinning against the brothers and sisters and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.
verses.textEn: When you sin against them in this way and wound their weak conscience, you sin against Christ.

verses.textZh: 所以，如果食物使我的弟兄跌倒，我就永远不再吃肉，免得使我的弟兄跌倒了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，如果食物使我的弟兄跌倒，我就永远不再吃肉，免得使我的弟兄跌倒了。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，食物若叫我弟兄跌倒，我就永远不吃肉，免得叫我弟兄跌倒了。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, if what I eat causes my brother or sister to fall into sin, I will never eat meat again, so that I will not cause them to fall.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, if food makes my brother stumble, I will never eat meat, lest I make my brother stumble.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, if food makes my brother stumble, I will never again eat meat, lest I make my brother stumble.
verses.textEnNlt: So if what I eat causes another believer to sin, I will never eat meat again as long as I live—for I don’t want to cause another believer to stumble.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, if food causes my brother to sin, I will never eat meat again, so that I will not cause my brother to sin.
verses.textEn: Therefore, if what I eat causes my brother or sister to fall into sin, I will never eat meat again, so that I will not cause them to fall.

verses.textZh: 我不是自由的吗？我不是使徒吗？我不是见过我们的主耶稣吗？你们不是我在主里面的工作吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不是自由的吗？我不是使徒吗？我不是见过我们的主耶稣吗？你们不是我在主里面的工作吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我不是自由的吗？我不是使徒吗？我不是见过我们的主耶稣吗？你们不是我在主里面所做之工吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you not the result of my work in the Lord?
verses.textEnEsv: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are not you my workmanship in the Lord?
verses.textEnNkjv: Am I not an apostle? Am I not free? Have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? Are you not my work in the Lord?
verses.textEnNlt: Am I not as free as anyone else? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus our Lord with my own eyes? Isn’t it because of my work that you belong to the Lord?
verses.textEnNasb: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you not my work in the Lord?
verses.textEn: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you not the result of my work in the Lord?

verses.textZh: 对别人来说，我或许不是使徒，但对你们来说，我总是使徒，因为你们就是我在主里作使徒的印记。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对别人来说，我或许不是使徒，但对你们来说，我总是使徒，因为你们就是我在主里作使徒的印记。
verses.textZhCuv: 假若在别人，我不是使徒，在你们，我总是使徒，因为你们在主里正是我作使徒的印证。
verses.textEnNiv: Even though I may not be an apostle to others, surely I am to you! For you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: If to others I am not an apostle, at least I am to you, for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: If I am not an apostle to others, yet doubtless I am to you. For you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Even if others think I am not an apostle, I certainly am to you. You yourselves are proof that I am the Lord’s apostle.
verses.textEnNasb: If I am not an apostle to others, at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
verses.textEn: Even though I may not be an apostle to others, surely I am to you! For you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

verses.textZh: 对那些盘问我的人，这就是我的答辩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对那些盘问我的人，这就是我的答辩。
verses.textZhCuv: 我对那盘问我的人就是这样分诉：
verses.textEnNiv: This is my defense to those who sit in judgment on me.
verses.textEnEsv: This is my defense to those who would examine me.
verses.textEnNkjv: My defense to those who examine me is this:
verses.textEnNlt: This is my answer to those who question my authority.
verses.textEnNasb: My defense to those who examine me is this:
verses.textEn: This is my defense to those who sit in judgment on me.

verses.textZh: 难道我们没有权利吃喝吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道我们没有权利吃喝吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 难道我们没有权柄靠福音吃喝吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Don’t we have the right to food and drink?
verses.textEnEsv: Do we not have the right to eat and drink?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do we have no right to eat and drink?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t we have the right to live in your homes and share your meals?
verses.textEnNasb: Do we not have a right to eat and drink?
verses.textEn: Don’t we have the right to food and drink?

verses.textZh: 难道我们没有权利，像其余的使徒、主的弟兄和矶法一样，带着信主的妻子往来吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道我们没有权利，像其余的使徒、主的弟兄和矶法一样，带着信主的妻子往来吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 难道我们没有权柄娶信主的姊妹为妻，带着一同往来，仿佛其余的使徒和主的弟兄并矶法一样吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Don’t we have the right to take a believing wife along with us, as do the other apostles and the Lord’s brothers and Cephas ?
verses.textEnEsv: Do we not have the right to take along a believing wife, as do the other apostles and the brothers of the Lord and Cephas?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do we have no right to take along a believing wife, as do also the other apostles, the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t we have the right to bring a believing wife with us as the other apostles and the Lord’s brothers do, and as Peter does?
verses.textEnNasb: Do we not have a right to take along a believing wife, even as the rest of the apostles and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?
verses.textEn: Don’t we have the right to take a believing wife along with us, as do the other apostles and the Lord’s brothers and Cephas ?

verses.textZh: 难道只有我和巴拿巴没有权利不作工吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道只有我和巴拿巴没有权利不作工吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 独有我与巴拿巴没有权柄不做工吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Or is it only I and Barnabas who lack the right to not work for a living?
verses.textEnEsv: Or is it only Barnabas and I who have no right to refrain from working for a living?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or isit only Barnabas and I who have no right to refrain from working?
verses.textEnNlt: Or is it only Barnabas and I who have to work to support ourselves?
verses.textEnNasb: Or do only Barnabas and I have no right to refrain from working?
verses.textEn: Or is it only I and Barnabas who lack the right to not work for a living?

verses.textZh: 有谁当兵要自备粮饷呢？有谁栽种葡萄园，不吃园里的果子呢？有谁牧养羊群，不喝羊的奶呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 有谁当兵要自备粮饷呢？有谁栽种葡萄园，不吃园里的果子呢？有谁牧养羊群，不喝羊的奶呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 有谁当兵自备粮饷呢？有谁栽葡萄园不吃园里的果子呢？有谁牧养牛羊不吃牛羊的奶呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who serves as a soldier at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat its grapes? Who tends a flock and does not drink the milk?
verses.textEnEsv: Who serves as a soldier at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard without eating any of its fruit? Or who tends a flock without getting some of the milk?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who ever goes to war at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat of its fruit? Or who tends a flock and does not drink of the milk of the flock?
verses.textEnNlt: What soldier has to pay his own expenses? What farmer plants a vineyard and doesn’t have the right to eat some of its fruit? What shepherd cares for a flock of sheep and isn’t allowed to drink some of the milk?
verses.textEnNasb: Who at any time serves as a soldier at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat its fruit? Or who tends a flock and does not consume some of the milk of the flock?
verses.textEn: Who serves as a soldier at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat its grapes? Who tends a flock and does not drink the milk?

verses.textZh: 我说这话，不是照着人的意见，律法不也是这样说吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说这话，不是照着人的意见，律法不也是这样说吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我说这话，岂是照人的意见；律法不也是这样说吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do I say this merely on human authority? Doesn’t the Law say the same thing?
verses.textEnEsv: Do I say these things on human authority? Does not the Law say the same?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do I say these things as a mere man? Or does not the law say the same also?
verses.textEnNlt: Am I expressing merely a human opinion, or does the law say the same thing?
verses.textEnNasb: I am not just asserting these things according to human judgment, am I? Or does the Law not say these things as well?
verses.textEn: Do I say this merely on human authority? Doesn’t the Law say the same thing?

verses.textZh: 就在摩西的律法上记着说："牛踹谷的时候，不可笼住牠的嘴。"难道神关心的只是牛吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在摩西的律法上记着说："牛踹谷的时候，不可笼住牠的嘴。"难道神关心的只是牛吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 就如摩西的律法记着说：「牛在场上踹谷的时候，不可笼住它的嘴。」难道神所挂念的是牛吗？
verses.textEnNiv: For it is written in the Law of Moses: "Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain." Is it about oxen that God is concerned?
verses.textEnEsv: For it is written in the Law of Moses, "You shall not muzzle an ox when it treads out the grain." Is it for oxen that God is concerned?
verses.textEnNkjv: For it is written in the law of Moses, "You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain." Is it oxen God is concerned about?
verses.textEnNlt: For the law of Moses says, "You must not muzzle an ox to keep it from eating as it treads out the grain." Was God thinking only about oxen when he said this?
verses.textEnNasb: For it is written in the Law of Moses: "You shall not muzzle the ox while it is threshing." God is not concerned about oxen, is He?
verses.textEn: For it is written in the Law of Moses: "Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain." Is it about oxen that God is concerned?

verses.textZh: 这不全是为我们说的吗？当然是为我们说的，因为耕种的应当存着希望去耕种，收割的也应当存着希望去分享收获。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这不全是为我们说的吗？当然是为我们说的，因为耕种的应当存着希望去耕种，收割的也应当存着希望去分享收获。
verses.textZhCuv: 不全是为我们说的吗？分明是为我们说的。因为耕种的当存着指望去耕种；打场的也当存得粮的指望去打场。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely he says this for us, doesn’t he? Yes, this was written for us, because whoever plows and threshes should be able to do so in the hope of sharing in the harvest.
verses.textEnEsv: Does he not certainly speak for our sake? It was written for our sake, because the plowman should plow in hope and the thresher thresh in hope of sharing in the crop.
verses.textEnNkjv: Or does He say it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written, that he who plows should plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should be partaker of his hope.
verses.textEnNlt: Wasn’t he actually speaking to us? Yes, it was written for us, so that the one who plows and the one who threshes the grain might both expect a share of the harvest.
verses.textEnNasb: Or is He speaking entirely for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because the plowman ought to plow in hope, and the thresher to thresh in hope of sharing in the crops.
verses.textEn: Surely he says this for us, doesn’t he? Yes, this was written for us, because whoever plows and threshes should be able to do so in the hope of sharing in the harvest.

verses.textZh: 我们既然在你们中间撒了属灵的种子，如果要从你们那里收获一些物质的供应，这算是过分吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们既然在你们中间撒了属灵的种子，如果要从你们那里收获一些物质的供应，这算是过分吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若把属灵的种子撒在你们中间，就是从你们收割奉养肉身之物，这还算大事吗？
verses.textEnNiv: If we have sown spiritual seed among you, is it too much if we reap a material harvest from you?
verses.textEnEsv: If we have sown spiritual things among you, is it too much if we reap material things from you?
verses.textEnNkjv: If we have sown spiritual things for you, isit a great thing if we reap your material things?
verses.textEnNlt: Since we have planted spiritual seed among you, aren’t we entitled to a harvest of physical food and drink?
verses.textEnNasb: If we sowed spiritual things in you, is it too much if we reap material things from you?
verses.textEn: If we have sown spiritual seed among you, is it too much if we reap a material harvest from you?

verses.textZh: 如果别人在你们身上享有这种权利，我们不是更可以享有吗？ 然而我们没有用过这种权利，反而凡事容忍，免得我们拦阻了基督的福音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果别人在你们身上享有这种权利，我们不是更可以享有吗？ 然而我们没有用过这种权利，反而凡事容忍，免得我们拦阻了基督的福音。
verses.textZhCuv: 若别人在你们身上有这权柄，何况我们呢？ 然而，我们没有用过这权柄，倒凡事忍受，免得基督的福音被阻隔。
verses.textEnNiv: If others have this right of support from you, shouldn’t we have it all the more? But we did not use this right. On the contrary, we put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel of Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: If others share this rightful claim on you, do not we even more? Nevertheless, we have not made use of this right, but we endure anything rather than put an obstacle in the way of the gospel of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: If others are partakers of this right over you, are we not even more? Nevertheless we have not used this right, but endure all things lest we hinder the gospel of Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: If you support others who preach to you, shouldn’t we have an even greater right to be supported? But we have never used this right. We would rather put up with anything than be an obstacle to the Good News about Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: If others share the right over you, do we not more? Nevertheless, we did not use this right, but we endure all things so that we will cause no hindrance to the gospel of Christ.
verses.textEn: If others have this right of support from you, shouldn’t we have it all the more? But we did not use this right. On the contrary, we put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel of Christ.

verses.textZh: 难道你们不知道，在圣殿供职的，就吃殿中的供物；侍候祭坛的，就分领坛上的祭物吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道你们不知道，在圣殿供职的，就吃殿中的供物；侍候祭坛的，就分领坛上的祭物吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们岂不知为圣事劳碌的就吃殿中的物吗？伺候祭坛的就分领坛上的物吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Don’t you know that those who serve in the temple get their food from the temple, and that those who serve at the altar share in what is offered on the altar?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you not know that those who are employed in the temple service get their food from the temple, and those who serve at the altar share in the sacrificial offerings?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you not know that those who minister the holy things eat ofthethings of the temple, and those who serve at the altar partake of theofferingsof the altar?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you realize that those who work in the temple get their meals from the offerings brought to the temple? And those who serve at the altar get a share of the sacrificial offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: Do you not know that those who perform sacred services eat the food of the temple, and those who attend regularly to the altar have their share from the altar?
verses.textEn: Don’t you know that those who serve in the temple get their food from the temple, and that those who serve at the altar share in what is offered on the altar?

verses.textZh: 主也曾这样吩咐，叫传福音的人靠福音为生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主也曾这样吩咐，叫传福音的人靠福音为生。
verses.textZhCuv: 主也是这样命定，叫传福音的靠着福音养生。
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way, the Lord has commanded that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel.
verses.textEnEsv: In the same way, the Lord commanded that those who proclaim the gospel should get their living by the gospel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even so the Lord has commanded that those who preach the gospel should live from the gospel.
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, the Lord ordered that those who preach the Good News should be supported by those who benefit from it.
verses.textEnNasb: So also the Lord directed those who proclaim the gospel to get their living from the gospel.
verses.textEn: In the same way, the Lord has commanded that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel.

verses.textZh: 但这种权利，我一点也没有用过。我写这些话，并不是想叫人这样待我，因为我宁可死，也不让人使我所夸耀的落了空。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但这种权利，我一点也没有用过。我写这些话，并不是想叫人这样待我，因为我宁可死，也不让人使我所夸耀的落了空。
verses.textZhCuv: 但这权柄我全没有用过。我写这话，并非要你们这样待我，因为我宁可死也不叫人使我所夸的落了空。
verses.textEnNiv: But I have not used any of these rights. And I am not writing this in the hope that you will do such things for me, for I would rather die than allow anyone to deprive me of this boast.
verses.textEnEsv: But I have made no use of any of these rights, nor am I writing these things to secure any such provision. For I would rather die than have anyone deprive me of my ground for boasting.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I have used none of these things, nor have I written these things that it should be done so to me; for it wouldbe better for me to die than that anyone should make my boasting void.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet I have never used any of these rights. And I am not writing this to suggest that I want to start now. In fact, I would rather die than lose my right to boast about preaching without charge.
verses.textEnNasb: But I have used none of these things. And I have not written these things so that it will be done so in my case; for it would be better for me to die than that. No one shall make my boast an empty one!
verses.textEn: But I have not used any of these rights. And I am not writing this in the hope that you will do such things for me, for I would rather die than allow anyone to deprive me of this boast.

verses.textZh: 我传福音原是没有可夸的，因我不能不传。如果不传福音，我就有祸了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我传福音原是没有可夸的，因我不能不传。如果不传福音，我就有祸了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我传福音原没有可夸的，因为我是不得已的。若不传福音，我便有祸了。
verses.textEnNiv: For when I preach the gospel, I cannot boast, since I am compelled to preach. Woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!
verses.textEnEsv: For if I preach the gospel, that gives me no ground for boasting. For necessity is laid upon me. Woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!
verses.textEnNkjv: For if I preach the gospel, I have nothing to boast of, for necessity is laid upon me; yes, woe is me if I do not preach the gospel!
verses.textEnNlt: Yet preaching the Good News is not something I can boast about. I am compelled by God to do it. How terrible for me if I didn’t preach the Good News!
verses.textEnNasb: For if I preach the gospel, I have nothing to boast about, for I am under compulsion; for woe to me if I do not preach the gospel.
verses.textEn: For when I preach the gospel, I cannot boast, since I am compelled to preach. Woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!

verses.textZh: 如果我甘心作这事，就有赏赐；即使不甘心，这职责还是托付我了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我甘心作这事，就有赏赐；即使不甘心，这职责还是托付我了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若甘心做这事，就有赏赐；若不甘心，责任却已经托付我了。
verses.textEnNiv: If I preach voluntarily, I have a reward; if not voluntarily, I am simply discharging the trust committed to me.
verses.textEnEsv: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward, but if not of my own will, I am still entrusted with a stewardship.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if I do this willingly, I have a reward; but if against my will, I have been entrusted with a stewardship.
verses.textEnNlt: If I were doing this on my own initiative, I would deserve payment. But I have no choice, for God has given me this sacred trust.
verses.textEnNasb: For if I do this voluntarily, I have a reward; but if against my will, I have been entrusted with a commission nonetheless.
verses.textEn: If I preach voluntarily, I have a reward; if not voluntarily, I am simply discharging the trust committed to me.

verses.textZh: 那么，我的赏赐是甚么呢？就是我传福音时，叫人免费得着福音。这样，我就没有用过传福音可以享有的权利了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，我的赏赐是甚么呢？就是我传福音时，叫人免费得着福音。这样，我就没有用过传福音可以享有的权利了。
verses.textZhCuv: 既是这样，我的赏赐是什么呢？就是我传福音的时候叫人不花钱得福音，免得用尽我传福音的权柄。
verses.textEnNiv: What then is my reward? Just this: that in preaching the gospel I may offer it free of charge, and so not make full use of my rights as a preacher of the gospel.
verses.textEnEsv: What then is my reward? That in my preaching I may present the gospel free of charge, so as not to make full use of my right in the gospel.
verses.textEnNkjv: What is my reward then? That when I preach the gospel, I may present the gospel of Christ without charge, that I may not abuse my authority in the gospel.
verses.textEnNlt: What then is my pay? It is the opportunity to preach the Good News without charging anyone. That’s why I never demand my rights when I preach the Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: What, then, is my reward? That, when I preach the gospel, I may offer the gospel without charge, so as not to make full use of my right in the gospel.
verses.textEn: What then is my reward? Just this: that in preaching the gospel I may offer it free of charge, and so not make full use of my rights as a preacher of the gospel.

verses.textZh: 我虽然自由，不受任何人管辖，但我自愿成为众人的奴仆，为的是要多得一些人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我虽然自由，不受任何人管辖，但我自愿成为众人的奴仆，为的是要多得一些人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我虽是自由的，无人辖管；然而我甘心作了众人的仆人，为要多得人。
verses.textEnNiv: Though I am free and belong to no one, I have made myself a slave to everyone, to win as many as possible.
verses.textEnEsv: For though I am free from all, I have made myself a servant to all, that I might win more of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: For though I am free from all men, I have made myself a servant to all, that I might win the more;
verses.textEnNlt: Even though I am a free man with no master, I have become a slave to all people to bring many to Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For though I am free from all people, I have made myself a slave to all, so that I may gain more.
verses.textEn: Though I am free and belong to no one, I have made myself a slave to everyone, to win as many as possible.

verses.textZh: 对犹太人，我就作犹太人，为了要得着犹太人；对律法以下的人，虽然我自己不在律法之下，还是作了律法以下的人，为了要得着律法以下的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对犹太人，我就作犹太人，为了要得着犹太人；对律法以下的人，虽然我自己不在律法之下，还是作了律法以下的人，为了要得着律法以下的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 向犹太人，我就作犹太人，为要得犹太人；向律法以下的人，我虽不在律法以下，还是作律法以下的人，为要得律法以下的人。
verses.textEnNiv: To the Jews I became like a Jew, to win the Jews. To those under the law I became like one under the law (though I myself am not under the law), so as to win those under the law.
verses.textEnEsv: To the Jews I became as a Jew, in order to win Jews. To those under the law I became as one under the law (though not being myself under the law) that I might win those under the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: and to the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might win Jews; to those whoare under the law, as under the law, that I might win those whoare under the law;
verses.textEnNlt: When I was with the Jews, I lived like a Jew to bring the Jews to Christ. When I was with those who follow the Jewish law, I too lived under that law. Even though I am not subject to the law, I did this so I could bring to Christ those who are under the law.
verses.textEnNasb: To the Jews I became as a Jew, so that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the Law, I became as one under the Law, though not being under the Law myself, so that I might gain those who are under the Law;
verses.textEn: To the Jews I became like a Jew, to win the Jews. To those under the law I became like one under the law (though I myself am not under the law), so as to win those under the law.

verses.textZh: 对没有律法的人，我就作了没有律法的人，其实我不是在神的律法以外，而是在基督的律法之下，为了要得着没有律法的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对没有律法的人，我就作了没有律法的人，其实我不是在神的律法以外，而是在基督的律法之下，为了要得着没有律法的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 向没有律法的人，我就作没有律法的人，为要得没有律法的人；其实我在神面前，不是没有律法；在基督面前，正在律法之下。
verses.textEnNiv: To those not having the law I became like one not having the law (though I am not free from God’s law but am under Christ’s law), so as to win those not having the law.
verses.textEnEsv: To those outside the law I became as one outside the law (not being outside the law of God but under the law of Christ) that I might win those outside the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: to those whoare without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those whoare without law;
verses.textEnNlt: When I am with the Gentiles who do not follow the Jewish law, I too live apart from that law so I can bring them to Christ. But I do not ignore the law of God; I obey the law of Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: to those who are without the Law, I became as one without the Law, though not being without the law of God but under the law of Christ, so that I might gain those who are without the Law.
verses.textEn: To those not having the law I became like one not having the law (though I am not free from God’s law but am under Christ’s law), so as to win those not having the law.

verses.textZh: 对软弱的人，我就成了软弱的人，为了要得着软弱的人。对怎么样的人，我就作怎么样的人；无论如何，总要救一些人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对软弱的人，我就成了软弱的人，为了要得着软弱的人。对怎么样的人，我就作怎么样的人；无论如何，总要救一些人。
verses.textZhCuv: 向软弱的人，我就作软弱的人，为要得软弱的人。向什么样的人，我就作什么样的人。无论如何，总要救些人。
verses.textEnNiv: To the weak I became weak, to win the weak. I have become all things to all people so that by all possible means I might save some.
verses.textEnEsv: To the weak I became weak, that I might win the weak. I have become all things to all people, that by all means I might save some.
verses.textEnNkjv: to the weak I became as weak, that I might win the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I might by all means save some.
verses.textEnNlt: When I am with those who are weak, I share their weakness, for I want to bring the weak to Christ. Yes, I try to find common ground with everyone, doing everything I can to save some.
verses.textEnNasb: To the weak I became weak, that I might gain the weak; I have become all things to all people, so that I may by all means save some.
verses.textEn: To the weak I became weak, to win the weak. I have become all things to all people so that by all possible means I might save some.

verses.textZh: 我所作的一切，都是为了福音的缘故，好让我与别人同享福音的好处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我所作的一切，都是为了福音的缘故，好让我与别人同享福音的好处。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡我所行的，都是为福音的缘故，为要与人同得这福音的好处。
verses.textEnNiv: I do all this for the sake of the gospel, that I may share in its blessings.
verses.textEnEsv: I do it all for the sake of the gospel, that I may share with them in its blessings.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this I do for the gospel’s sake, that I may be partaker of it with you.
verses.textEnNlt: I do everything to spread the Good News and share in its blessings.
verses.textEnNasb: I do all things for the sake of the gospel, so that I may become a fellow partaker of it.
verses.textEn: I do all this for the sake of the gospel, that I may share in its blessings.

verses.textZh: 难道你们不知道，在场上赛跑的人，虽然大家都跑，但得奖的只有一个人吗？你们都应当这样跑，好叫你们可以得奖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道你们不知道，在场上赛跑的人，虽然大家都跑，但得奖的只有一个人吗？你们都应当这样跑，好叫你们可以得奖。
verses.textZhCuv: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。
verses.textEnNiv: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verses.textEnEsv: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one receives the prize? So run that you may obtain it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you not know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run in such a way that you may obtain it.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you realize that in a race everyone runs, but only one person gets the prize? So run to win!
verses.textEnNasb: Do you not know that those who run in a race all run, but only one receives the prize? Run in such a way that you may win.
verses.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.

verses.textZh: 凡参加运动比赛的，在一切事上都有节制；他们这样作，不过要得到能坏的冠冕，我们却是要得不朽的冠冕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡参加运动比赛的，在一切事上都有节制；他们这样作，不过要得到能坏的冠冕，我们却是要得不朽的冠冕。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Every athlete exercises self-control in all things. They do it to receive a perishable wreath, but we an imperishable.
verses.textEnNkjv: And everyone who competes fortheprize is temperate in all things. Now they doit to obtain a perishable crown, but we for an imperishable crown.
verses.textEnNlt: All athletes are disciplined in their training. They do it to win a prize that will fade away, but we do it for an eternal prize.
verses.textEnNasb: Everyone who competes in the games exercises self-control in all things. So they do it to obtain a perishable wreath, but we an imperishable.
verses.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.

verses.textZh: 所以我奔跑，不是没有目标的；我斗拳，不是打空气的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我奔跑，不是没有目标的；我斗拳，不是打空气的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我奔跑不像无定向的；我斗拳不像打空气的。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I do not run like someone running aimlessly; I do not fight like a boxer beating the air.
verses.textEnEsv: So I do not run aimlessly; I do not box as one beating the air.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I run thus: not with uncertainty. Thus I fight: not as onewho beats the air.
verses.textEnNlt: So I run with purpose in every step. I am not just shadowboxing.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I run in such a way as not to run aimlessly; I box in such a way, as to avoid hitting air;
verses.textEn: Therefore I do not run like someone running aimlessly; I do not fight like a boxer beating the air.

verses.textZh: 我要克制自己的身体，叫身体服我，免得我传了给别人，自己反而落选了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要克制自己的身体，叫身体服我，免得我传了给别人，自己反而落选了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是攻克己身，叫身服我，恐怕我传福音给别人，自己反被弃绝了。
verses.textEnNiv: No, I strike a blow to my body and make it my slave so that after I have preached to others, I myself will not be disqualified for the prize.
verses.textEnEsv: But I discipline my body and keep it under control, lest after preaching to others I myself should be disqualified.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I discipline my body and bring it into subjection, lest, when I have preached to others, I myself should become disqualified.
verses.textEnNlt: I discipline my body like an athlete, training it to do what it should. Otherwise, I fear that after preaching to others I myself might be disqualified.
verses.textEnNasb: but I strictly discipline my body and make it my slave, so that, after I have preached to others, I myself will not be disqualified.
verses.textEn: No, I strike a blow to my body and make it my slave so that after I have preached to others, I myself will not be disqualified for the prize.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我不愿意你们不知道，我们的祖宗都曾经在云下，都曾经从海中经过，
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我不愿意你们不知道，我们的祖宗都曾经在云下，都曾经从海中经过，
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我不愿意你们不晓得，我们的祖宗从前都在云下，都从海中经过，
verses.textEnNiv: For I do not want you to be ignorant of the fact, brothers and sisters, that our ancestors were all under the cloud and that they all passed through the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: For I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea,
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover, brethren, I do not want you to be unaware that all our fathers were under the cloud, all passed through the sea,
verses.textEnNlt: I don’t want you to forget, dear brothers and sisters, about our ancestors in the wilderness long ago. All of them were guided by a cloud that moved ahead of them, and all of them walked through the sea on dry ground.
verses.textEnNasb: For I do not want you to be unaware, brothers and sisters, that our fathers were all under the cloud and they all passed through the sea;
verses.textEn: For I do not want you to be ignorant of the fact, brothers and sisters, that our ancestors were all under the cloud and that they all passed through the sea.

verses.textZh: 都曾经在云里在海里受洗归于摩西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 都曾经在云里在海里受洗归于摩西。
verses.textZhCuv: 都在云里、海里受洗归了摩西；
verses.textEnNiv: They were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: and all were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea,
verses.textEnNkjv: all were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea,
verses.textEnNlt: In the cloud and in the sea, all of them were baptized as followers of Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: and they all were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
verses.textEn: They were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea.

verses.textZh: 他们都吃了一样的灵粮，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们都吃了一样的灵粮，
verses.textZhCuv: 并且都吃了一样的灵食，
verses.textEnNiv: They all ate the same spiritual food
verses.textEnEsv: and all ate the same spiritual food,
verses.textEnNkjv: all ate the same spiritual food,
verses.textEnNlt: All of them ate the same spiritual food,
verses.textEnNasb: and they all ate the same spiritual food,
verses.textEn: They all ate the same spiritual food

verses.textZh: 都喝了一样的灵水；他们所喝的，是从那随着他们的灵盘石那里来的，这盘石就是基督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 都喝了一样的灵水；他们所喝的，是从那随着他们的灵盘石那里来的，这盘石就是基督。
verses.textZhCuv: 也都喝了一样的灵水。所喝的，是出于随着他们的灵磐石；那磐石就是基督。
verses.textEnNiv: and drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank from the spiritual Rock that followed them, and the Rock was Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them, and that Rock was Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: and all of them drank the same spiritual water. For they drank from the spiritual rock that traveled with them, and that rock was Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: and all drank the same spiritual drink, for they were drinking from a spiritual rock which followed them; and the rock was Christ.
verses.textEn: and drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ.

verses.textZh: 但他们大多数的人，都得不到神的喜悦，因此他们都死在旷野。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们大多数的人，都得不到神的喜悦，因此他们都死在旷野。
verses.textZhCuv: 但他们中间多半是神不喜欢的人，所以在旷野倒毙。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, God was not pleased with most of them; their bodies were scattered in the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, with most of them God was not pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: But with most of them God was not well pleased, for theirbodies were scattered in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet God was not pleased with most of them, and their bodies were scattered in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, with most of them God was not pleased; for their dead bodies were spread out in the wilderness.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, God was not pleased with most of them; their bodies were scattered in the wilderness.

verses.textZh: 这些事都是我们的鉴戒，叫我们不要贪恋恶事，像他们那样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事都是我们的鉴戒，叫我们不要贪恋恶事，像他们那样。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事都是我们的鉴戒，叫我们不要贪恋恶事，像他们那样贪恋的；
verses.textEnNiv: Now these things occurred as examples to keep us from setting our hearts on evil things as they did.
verses.textEnEsv: Now these things took place as examples for us, that we might not desire evil as they did.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these things became our examples, to the intent that we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.
verses.textEnNlt: These things happened as a warning to us, so that we would not crave evil things as they did,
verses.textEnNasb: Now these things happened as examples for us, so that we would not crave evil things as they indeed craved them.
verses.textEn: Now these things occurred as examples to keep us from setting our hearts on evil things as they did.

verses.textZh: 你们也不可拜偶像，像他们有些人那样；正如经上所记："人民坐下吃喝，起来玩乐。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也不可拜偶像，像他们有些人那样；正如经上所记："人民坐下吃喝，起来玩乐。"
verses.textZhCuv: 也不要拜偶像，像他们有人拜的。如经上所记：「百姓坐下吃喝，起来玩耍。」
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be idolaters, as some of them were; as it is written: "The people sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry."
verses.textEnEsv: Do not be idolaters as some of them were; as it is written, "The people sat down to eat and drink and rose up to play."
verses.textEnNkjv: And do not become idolaters as were some of them. As it is written, "The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play."
verses.textEnNlt: or worship idols as some of them did. As the Scriptures say, "The people celebrated with feasting and drinking, and they indulged in pagan revelry."
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be idolaters, as some of them were; as it is written: "The people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play."
verses.textEn: Do not be idolaters, as some of them were; as it is written: "The people sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry."

verses.textZh: 我们也不可淫乱，像他们有些人那样，一天就死了二万三千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们也不可淫乱，像他们有些人那样，一天就死了二万三千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们也不要行奸淫，像他们有人行的，一天就倒毙了二万三千人；
verses.textEnNiv: We should not commit sexual immorality, as some of them did—and in one day twenty-three thousand of them died.
verses.textEnEsv: We must not indulge in sexual immorality as some of them did, and twenty-three thousand fell in a single day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor let us commit sexual immorality, as some of them did, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell;
verses.textEnNlt: And we must not engage in sexual immorality as some of them did, causing 23,000 of them to die in one day.
verses.textEnNasb: Nor are we to commit sexual immorality, as some of them did, and twenty-three thousand fell in one day.
verses.textEn: We should not commit sexual immorality, as some of them did—and in one day twenty-three thousand of them died.

verses.textZh: 我们也不可试探主，像他们有些人那样，结果就被蛇咬死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们也不可试探主，像他们有些人那样，结果就被蛇咬死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不要试探主 ，像他们有人试探的，就被蛇所灭。
verses.textEnNiv: We should not test Christ, as some of them did—and were killed by snakes.
verses.textEnEsv: We must not put Christ to the test, as some of them did and were destroyed by serpents,
verses.textEnNkjv: nor let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed by serpents;
verses.textEnNlt: Nor should we put Christ to the test, as some of them did and then died from snakebites.
verses.textEnNasb: Nor are we to put the Lord to the test, as some of them did, and were killed by the snakes.
verses.textEn: We should not test Christ, as some of them did—and were killed by snakes.

verses.textZh: 你们也不可发怨言，像他们有些人那样，就被那毁灭者所灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也不可发怨言，像他们有些人那样，就被那毁灭者所灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们也不要发怨言，像他们有发怨言的，就被灭命的所灭。
verses.textEnNiv: And do not grumble, as some of them did—and were killed by the destroying angel.
verses.textEnEsv: nor grumble, as some of them did and were destroyed by the Destroyer.
verses.textEnNkjv: nor complain, as some of them also complained, and were destroyed by the destroyer.
verses.textEnNlt: And don’t grumble as some of them did, and then were destroyed by the angel of death.
verses.textEnNasb: Nor grumble, as some of them did, and were killed by the destroyer.
verses.textEn: And do not grumble, as some of them did—and were killed by the destroying angel.

verses.textZh: 这些事发生在他们身上，作为鉴戒，并且记下来，为了要警戒我们这些末世的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事发生在他们身上，作为鉴戒，并且记下来，为了要警戒我们这些末世的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们遭遇这些事都要作为鉴戒，并且写在经上，正是警戒我们这末世的人。
verses.textEnNiv: These things happened to them as examples and were written down as warnings for us, on whom the culmination of the ages has come.
verses.textEnEsv: Now these things happened to them as an example, but they were written down for our instruction, on whom the end of the ages has come.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now all these things happened to them as examples, and they were written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the ages have come.
verses.textEnNlt: These things happened to them as examples for us. They were written down to warn us who live at the end of the age.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these things happened to them as an example, and they were written for our instruction, upon whom the ends of the ages have come.
verses.textEn: These things happened to them as examples and were written down as warnings for us, on whom the culmination of the ages has come.

verses.textZh: 所以，那自以为站得稳的，应当谨慎，免得跌倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，那自以为站得稳的，应当谨慎，免得跌倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，自己以为站得稳的，须要谨慎，免得跌倒。
verses.textEnNiv: So, if you think you are standing firm, be careful that you don’t fall!
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore let anyone who thinks that he stands take heed lest he fall.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore let him who thinks he stands take heed lest he fall.
verses.textEnNlt: If you think you are standing strong, be careful not to fall.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore let the one who thinks he stands watch out that he does not fall.
verses.textEn: So, if you think you are standing firm, be careful that you don’t fall!

verses.textZh: 你们所受的试探，无非是人受得起的；神是信实的，他必不容许你们受试探过于你们承受得起的，而且在受试探的时候，必定给你们开一条出路，使你们能忍受得住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们所受的试探，无非是人受得起的；神是信实的，他必不容许你们受试探过于你们承受得起的，而且在受试探的时候，必定给你们开一条出路，使你们能忍受得住。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们所遇见的试探，无非是人所能受的。神是信实的，必不叫你们受试探过于所能受的；在受试探的时候，总要给你们开一条出路，叫你们能忍受得住。
verses.textEnNiv: No temptation has overtaken you except what is common to mankind. And God is faithful; he will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, he will also provide a way out so that you can endure it.
verses.textEnEsv: No temptation has overtaken you that is not common to man. God is faithful, and he will not let you be tempted beyond your ability, but with the temptation he will also provide the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
verses.textEnNkjv: No temptation has overtaken you except such as is common to man; but God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted beyond what you are able, but with the temptation will also make the way of escape, that you may be able to bear it.
verses.textEnNlt: The temptations in your life are no different from what others experience. And God is faithful. He will not allow the temptation to be more than you can stand. When you are tempted, he will show you a way out so that you can endure.
verses.textEnNasb: No temptation has overtaken you except something common to mankind; and God is faithful, so He will not allow you to be tempted beyond what you are able, but with the temptation will provide the way of escape also, so that you will be able to endure it.
verses.textEn: No temptation has overtaken you except what is common to mankind. And God is faithful; he will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, he will also provide a way out so that you can endure it.

verses.textZh: 所以，我所亲爱的，你们要远避拜偶像的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我所亲爱的，你们要远避拜偶像的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我所亲爱的弟兄啊，你们要逃避拜偶像的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, my dear friends, flee from idolatry.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
verses.textEnNlt: So, my dear friends, flee from the worship of idols.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
verses.textEn: Therefore, my dear friends, flee from idolatry.

verses.textZh: 我是对明白事理的人说的，我所说的你们要自己判断。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是对明白事理的人说的，我所说的你们要自己判断。
verses.textZhCuv: 我好像对明白人说的，你们要审察我的话。
verses.textEnNiv: I speak to sensible people; judge for yourselves what I say.
verses.textEnEsv: I speak as to sensible people; judge for yourselves what I say.
verses.textEnNkjv: I speak as to wise men; judge for yourselves what I say.
verses.textEnNlt: You are reasonable people. Decide for yourselves if what I am saying is true.
verses.textEnNasb: I speak as to wise people; you then, judge what I say.
verses.textEn: I speak to sensible people; judge for yourselves what I say.

verses.textZh: 我们为福杯祝祷的时候，难道不是共享基督的血吗？我们擘饼的时候，难道不是共享基督的身体吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们为福杯祝祷的时候，难道不是共享基督的血吗？我们擘饼的时候，难道不是共享基督的身体吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我们所祝福的杯，岂不是同领基督的血吗？我们所擘开的饼，岂不是同领基督的身体吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Is not the cup of thanksgiving for which we give thanks a participation in the blood of Christ? And is not the bread that we break a participation in the body of Christ?
verses.textEnEsv: The cup of blessing that we bless, is it not a participation in the blood of Christ? The bread that we break, is it not a participation in the body of Christ?
verses.textEnNkjv: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
verses.textEnNlt: When we bless the cup at the Lord’s Table, aren’t we sharing in the blood of Christ? And when we break the bread, aren’t we sharing in the body of Christ?
verses.textEnNasb: Is the cup of blessing which we bless not a sharing in the blood of Christ? Is the bread which we break not a sharing in the body of Christ?
verses.textEn: Is not the cup of thanksgiving for which we give thanks a participation in the blood of Christ? And is not the bread that we break a participation in the body of Christ?

verses.textZh: 因为事实上只有一个饼，我们人数虽多，还是一个身体，因为我们都是分享同一个饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为事实上只有一个饼，我们人数虽多，还是一个身体，因为我们都是分享同一个饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们虽多，仍是一个饼，一个身体，因为我们都是分受这一个饼。
verses.textEnNiv: Because there is one loaf, we, who are many, are one body, for we all share the one loaf.
verses.textEnEsv: Because there is one bread, we who are many are one body, for we all partake of the one bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we, though many, are one bread and one body; for we all partake of that one bread.
verses.textEnNlt: And though we are many, we all eat from one loaf of bread, showing that we are one body.
verses.textEnNasb: Since there is one loaf, we who are many are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf.
verses.textEn: Because there is one loaf, we, who are many, are one body, for we all share the one loaf.

verses.textZh: 你们看看按肉身是以色列人，那些吃祭物的不就是与祭坛有分吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们看看按肉身是以色列人，那些吃祭物的不就是与祭坛有分吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们看属肉体的以色列人，那吃祭物的岂不是在祭坛上有分吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Consider the people of Israel: Do not those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?
verses.textEnEsv: Consider the people of Israel: are not those who eat the sacrifices participants in the altar?
verses.textEnNkjv: Observe Israel after the flesh: Are not those who eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?
verses.textEnNlt: Think about the people of Israel. Weren’t they united by eating the sacrifices at the altar?
verses.textEnNasb: Look at the people of Israel; are those who eat the sacrifices not partners in the altar?
verses.textEn: Consider the people of Israel: Do not those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

verses.textZh: 我说的是甚么意思呢？偶像算得甚么，还是祭过偶像的食物算得甚么？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说的是甚么意思呢？偶像算得甚么，还是祭过偶像的食物算得甚么？
verses.textZhCuv: 我是怎么说呢？岂是说祭偶像之物算得什么呢？或说偶像算得什么呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Do I mean then that food sacrificed to an idol is anything, or that an idol is anything?
verses.textEnEsv: What do I imply then? That food offered to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?
verses.textEnNkjv: What am I saying then? That an idol is anything, or what is offered to idols is anything?
verses.textEnNlt: What am I trying to say? Am I saying that food offered to idols has some significance, or that idols are real gods?
verses.textEnNasb: What do I mean then? That food sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?
verses.textEn: Do I mean then that food sacrificed to an idol is anything, or that an idol is anything?

verses.textZh: 我是说，教外人所祭的是鬼，不是献给神；我却不愿意你们与鬼来往。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是说，教外人所祭的是鬼，不是献给神；我却不愿意你们与鬼来往。
verses.textZhCuv: 我乃是说，外邦人所献的祭是祭鬼，不是祭神。我不愿意你们与鬼相交。
verses.textEnNiv: No, but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons, not to God, and I do not want you to be participants with demons.
verses.textEnEsv: No, I imply that what pagans sacrifice they offer to demons and not to God. I do not want you to be participants with demons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Rather, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I do not want you to have fellowship with demons.
verses.textEnNlt: No, not at all. I am saying that these sacrifices are offered to demons, not to God. And I don’t want you to participate with demons.
verses.textEnNasb: No, but I say that things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God; and I do not want you to become partners with demons.
verses.textEn: No, but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons, not to God, and I do not want you to be participants with demons.

verses.textZh: 你们不能喝主的杯又喝鬼的杯，你们不能参加主的筵席又参加鬼的筵席。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不能喝主的杯又喝鬼的杯，你们不能参加主的筵席又参加鬼的筵席。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不能喝主的杯又喝鬼的杯，不能吃主的筵席又吃鬼的筵席。
verses.textEnNiv: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons too; you cannot have a part in both the Lord’s table and the table of demons.
verses.textEnEsv: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You cannot partake of the table of the Lord and the table of demons.
verses.textEnNkjv: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons; you cannot partake of the Lord’s table and of the table of demons.
verses.textEnNlt: You cannot drink from the cup of the Lord and from the cup of demons, too. You cannot eat at the Lord’s Table and at the table of demons, too.
verses.textEnNasb: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons; you cannot partake of the table of the Lord and the table of demons.
verses.textEn: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons too; you cannot have a part in both the Lord’s table and the table of demons.

verses.textZh: 难道我们要激起主的忿怒吗？我们比他更强吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道我们要激起主的忿怒吗？我们比他更强吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我们可惹主的愤恨吗？我们比他还有能力吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Are we trying to arouse the Lord’s jealousy? Are we stronger than he?
verses.textEnEsv: Shall we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than He?
verses.textEnNlt: What? Do we dare to rouse the Lord’s jealousy? Do you think we are stronger than he is?
verses.textEnNasb: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? We are not stronger than He, are we?
verses.textEn: Are we trying to arouse the Lord’s jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

verses.textZh: 甚么事情都可以作，但不是都有益处。甚么事情都可以作，但不是都能造就人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 甚么事情都可以作，但不是都有益处。甚么事情都可以作，但不是都能造就人。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处。凡事都可行，但不都造就人。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have the right to do anything," you say—but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything"—but not everything is constructive.
verses.textEnEsv: "All things are lawful," but not all things are helpful. "All things are lawful," but not all things build up.
verses.textEnNkjv: All things are lawful for me, but not all things are helpful; all things are lawful for me, but not all things edify.
verses.textEnNlt: You say, "I am allowed to do anything" —but not everything is good for you. You say, "I am allowed to do anything"—but not everything is beneficial.
verses.textEnNasb: All things are permitted, but not all things are of benefit. All things are permitted, but not all things build people up.
verses.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say—but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything"—but not everything is constructive.

verses.textZh: 人不要求自己的好处，却要求别人的好处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人不要求自己的好处，却要求别人的好处。
verses.textZhCuv: 无论何人，不要求自己的益处，乃要求别人的益处。
verses.textEnNiv: No one should seek their own good, but the good of others.
verses.textEnEsv: Let no one seek his own good, but the good of his neighbor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let no one seek his own, but each one the other’s well-being.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be concerned for your own good but for the good of others.
verses.textEnNasb: No one is to seek his own advantage, but rather that of his neighbor.
verses.textEn: No one should seek their own good, but the good of others.

verses.textZh: 肉食市场所卖的一切，你们只管吃，不要为了良心的缘故问甚么，
verses.textZhCnvs: 肉食市场所卖的一切，你们只管吃，不要为了良心的缘故问甚么，
verses.textZhCuv: 凡市上所卖的，你们只管吃，不要为良心的缘故问什么话，
verses.textEnNiv: Eat anything sold in the meat market without raising questions of conscience,
verses.textEnEsv: Eat whatever is sold in the meat market without raising any question on the ground of conscience.
verses.textEnNkjv: Eat whatever is sold in the meat market, asking no questions for conscience’ sake;
verses.textEnNlt: So you may eat any meat that is sold in the marketplace without raising questions of conscience.
verses.textEnNasb: Eat anything that is sold in the meat market without asking questions, for the sake of conscience;
verses.textEn: Eat anything sold in the meat market without raising questions of conscience,

verses.textZh: 因为地和地上所充满的都是属于主的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为地和地上所充满的都是属于主的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为地和其中所充满的都属乎主。
verses.textEnNiv: for, "The earth is the Lord’s, and everything in it."
verses.textEnEsv: For "the earth is the Lord’s, and the fullness thereof."
verses.textEnNkjv: for "the earth is the Lord’s, and all its fullness."
verses.textEnNlt: For "the earth is the Lord ’s, and everything in it."
verses.textEnNasb: for the earth is the Lord’s, and all it contains.
verses.textEn: for, "The earth is the Lord’s, and everything in it."

verses.textZh: 如果有不信的人邀请你们吃饭，你们也愿意去，凡摆在你们面前的，都可以吃，不要为了良心的缘故问甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有不信的人邀请你们吃饭，你们也愿意去，凡摆在你们面前的，都可以吃，不要为了良心的缘故问甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘有一个不信的人请你们赴席，你们若愿意去，凡摆在你们面前的，只管吃，不要为良心的缘故问什么话。
verses.textEnNiv: If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you want to go, eat whatever is put before you without raising questions of conscience.
verses.textEnEsv: If one of the unbelievers invites you to dinner and you are disposed to go, eat whatever is set before you without raising any question on the ground of conscience.
verses.textEnNkjv: If any of those who do not believe invites you todinner, and you desire to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no question for conscience’ sake.
verses.textEnNlt: If someone who isn’t a believer asks you home for dinner, accept the invitation if you want to. Eat whatever is offered to you without raising questions of conscience.
verses.textEnNasb: If one of the unbelievers invites you and you want to go, eat anything that is set before you without asking questions, for the sake of conscience.
verses.textEn: If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you want to go, eat whatever is put before you without raising questions of conscience.

verses.textZh: 但是如果有人告诉你们："这是献过祭的食物。"那么，为了那告诉你们的人，也为了良心的缘故，就不要吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是如果有人告诉你们："这是献过祭的食物。"那么，为了那告诉你们的人，也为了良心的缘故，就不要吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人对你们说：「这是献过祭的物」，就要为那告诉你们的人，并为良心的缘故不吃。
verses.textEnNiv: But if someone says to you, "This has been offered in sacrifice," then do not eat it, both for the sake of the one who told you and for the sake of conscience.
verses.textEnEsv: But if someone says to you, "This has been offered in sacrifice," then do not eat it, for the sake of the one who informed you, and for the sake of conscience—
verses.textEnNkjv: But if anyone says to you, "This was offered to idols," do not eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for conscience’ sake; for "the earth is the Lord’s, and all its fullness."
verses.textEnNlt: (But suppose someone tells you, "This meat was offered to an idol." Don’t eat it, out of consideration for the conscience of the one who told you.
verses.textEnNasb: But if anyone says to you, "This is meat sacrificed to idols," do not eat it, for the sake of that one who informed you and for the sake of conscience.
verses.textEn: But if someone says to you, "This has been offered in sacrifice," then do not eat it, both for the sake of the one who told you and for the sake of conscience.

verses.textZh: 我说的良心，不是你的，而是他的。为甚么我的自由要受别人的良心论断呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说的良心，不是你的，而是他的。为甚么我的自由要受别人的良心论断呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我说的良心不是你的，乃是他的。我这自由为什么被别人的良心论断呢？
verses.textEnNiv: I am referring to the other person’s conscience, not yours. For why is my freedom being judged by another’s conscience?
verses.textEnEsv: I do not mean your conscience, but his. For why should my liberty be determined by someone else’s conscience?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Conscience," I say, not your own, but that of the other. For why is my liberty judged by another man’s conscience?
verses.textEnNlt: It might not be a matter of conscience for you, but it is for the other person.) For why should my freedom be limited by what someone else thinks?
verses.textEnNasb: Now by "conscience" I do not mean your own, but the other person’s; for why is my freedom judged by another’s conscience?
verses.textEn: I am referring to the other person’s conscience, not yours. For why is my freedom being judged by another’s conscience?

verses.textZh: 我若存着感恩的心吃了，为甚么我因着我所感恩的食物被人毁谤呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若存着感恩的心吃了，为甚么我因着我所感恩的食物被人毁谤呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我若谢恩而吃，为什么因我谢恩的物被人毁谤呢？
verses.textEnNiv: If I take part in the meal with thankfulness, why am I denounced because of something I thank God for?
verses.textEnEsv: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced because of that for which I give thanks?
verses.textEnNkjv: But if I partake with thanks, why am I evil spoken of for thefood over which I give thanks?
verses.textEnNlt: If I can thank God for the food and enjoy it, why should I be condemned for eating it?
verses.textEnNasb: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I slandered about that for which I give thanks?
verses.textEn: If I take part in the meal with thankfulness, why am I denounced because of something I thank God for?

verses.textZh: 所以，你们或吃喝，或作甚么，一切都要为神的荣耀而行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你们或吃喝，或作甚么，一切都要为神的荣耀而行。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们或吃或喝，无论做什么，都要为荣耀神而行。
verses.textEnNiv: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God.
verses.textEnEsv: So, whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
verses.textEnNlt: So whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all things for the glory of God.
verses.textEn: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God.

verses.textZh: 无论是犹太人，是希腊人，是神的教会，你们总不可使他们跌倒；
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论是犹太人，是希腊人，是神的教会，你们总不可使他们跌倒；
verses.textZhCuv: 不拘是犹太人，是希腊人，是神的教会，你们都不要使他跌倒；
verses.textEnNiv: Do not cause anyone to stumble, whether Jews, Greeks or the church of God—
verses.textEnEsv: Give no offense to Jews or to Greeks or to the church of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: Give no offense, either to the Jews or to the Greeks or to the church of God,
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t give offense to Jews or Gentiles or the church of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not offend Jews or Greeks, or the church of God;
verses.textEn: Do not cause anyone to stumble, whether Jews, Greeks or the church of God—

verses.textZh: 就好象我所作的一切，都是要使大家喜悦，不是要求自己的好处，而是要求别人的好处，为了要使他们得救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就好象我所作的一切，都是要使大家喜悦，不是要求自己的好处，而是要求别人的好处，为了要使他们得救。
verses.textZhCuv: 就好像我凡事都叫众人喜欢，不求自己的益处，只求众人的益处，叫他们得救。
verses.textEnNiv: even as I try to please everyone in every way. For I am not seeking my own good but the good of many, so that they may be saved.
verses.textEnEsv: just as I try to please everyone in everything I do, not seeking my own advantage, but that of many, that they may be saved.
verses.textEnNkjv: just as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.
verses.textEnNlt: I, too, try to please everyone in everything I do. I don’t just do what is best for me; I do what is best for others so that many may be saved.
verses.textEnNasb: just as I also please everyone in all things, not seeking my own benefit but the benefit of the many, so that they may be saved.
verses.textEn: even as I try to please everyone in every way. For I am not seeking my own good but the good of many, so that they may be saved.

verses.textZh: 你们应该效法我，好象我效法基督一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们应该效法我，好象我效法基督一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们该效法我，像我效法基督一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: Be imitators of me, as I am of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Imitate me, just as I also imitate Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: And you should imitate me, just as I imitate Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: Be imitators of me, just as I also am of Christ.
verses.textEn: Follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ.

verses.textZh: 我称赞你们，因为你们在一切事上都记念我，又持守我传交给你们的教训。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我称赞你们，因为你们在一切事上都记念我，又持守我传交给你们的教训。
verses.textZhCuv: 我称赞你们，因你们凡事记念我，又坚守我所传给你们的。
verses.textEnNiv: I praise you for remembering me in everything and for holding to the traditions just as I passed them on to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Now I commend you because you remember me in everything and maintain the traditions even as I delivered them to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I praise you, brethren, that you remember me in all things and keep the traditions just as I delivered them to you.
verses.textEnNlt: I am so glad that you always keep me in your thoughts, and that you are following the teachings I passed on to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I praise you because you remember me in everything and hold firmly to the traditions, just as I handed them down to you.
verses.textEn: I praise you for remembering me in everything and for holding to the traditions just as I passed them on to you.

verses.textZh: 但是我愿意你们知道，基督是男人的头，男人是女人的头 ，神是基督的头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是我愿意你们知道，基督是男人的头，男人是女人的头 ，神是基督的头。
verses.textZhCuv: 我愿意你们知道，基督是各人的头；男人是女人的头；神是基督的头。
verses.textEnNiv: But I want you to realize that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
verses.textEnEsv: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ, the head of a wife is her husband, and the head of Christ is God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I want you to know that the head of every man is Christ, the head of woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
verses.textEnNlt: But there is one thing I want you to know: The head of every man is Christ, the head of woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
verses.textEnNasb: But I want you to understand that Christ is the head of every man, and the man is the head of a woman, and God is the head of Christ.
verses.textEn: But I want you to realize that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

verses.textZh: 男人祷告或讲道的时候，如果蒙着头，就是羞辱自己的头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 男人祷告或讲道的时候，如果蒙着头，就是羞辱自己的头。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡男人祷告或是讲道 ，若蒙着头，就羞辱自己的头。
verses.textEnNiv: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.
verses.textEnEsv: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head,
verses.textEnNkjv: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.
verses.textEnNlt: A man dishonors his head if he covers his head while praying or prophesying.
verses.textEnNasb: Every man who has something on his head while praying or prophesying disgraces his head.
verses.textEn: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.

verses.textZh: 女人祷告或讲道的时候，如果不蒙着头，就是羞辱自己的头，因为这就好象剃了头发一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 女人祷告或讲道的时候，如果不蒙着头，就是羞辱自己的头，因为这就好象剃了头发一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡女人祷告或是讲道，若不蒙着头，就羞辱自己的头，因为这就如同剃了头发一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head—it is the same as having her head shaved.
verses.textEnEsv: but every wife who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, since it is the same as if her head were shaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: But every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, for that is one and the same as if her head were shaved.
verses.textEnNlt: But a woman dishonors her head if she prays or prophesies without a covering on her head, for this is the same as shaving her head.
verses.textEnNasb: But every woman who has her head uncovered while praying or prophesying disgraces her head, for it is one and the same as the woman whose head is shaved.
verses.textEn: But every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head—it is the same as having her head shaved.
