verses.textZh: 女人要不蒙着头，她就应当把头发剪了；如果女人以为剪发或剃头是羞耻的事，她就应当蒙着头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 女人要不蒙着头，她就应当把头发剪了；如果女人以为剪发或剃头是羞耻的事，她就应当蒙着头。
verses.textZhCuv: 女人若不蒙着头，就该剪了头发；女人若以剪发、剃发为羞愧，就该蒙着头。
verses.textEnNiv: For if a woman does not cover her head, she might as well have her hair cut off; but if it is a disgrace for a woman to have her hair cut off or her head shaved, then she should cover her head.
verses.textEnEsv: For if a wife will not cover her head, then she should cut her hair short. But since it is disgraceful for a wife to cut off her hair or shave her head, let her cover her head.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if a woman is not covered, let her also be shorn. But if it is shameful for a woman to be shorn or shaved, let her be covered.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, if she refuses to wear a head covering, she should cut off all her hair! But since it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut or her head shaved, she should wear a covering.
verses.textEnNasb: For if a woman does not cover her head, have her also cut her hair off; however, if it is disgraceful for a woman to have her hair cut off or her head shaved, have her cover her head.
verses.textEn: For if a woman does not cover her head, she might as well have her hair cut off; but if it is a disgrace for a woman to have her hair cut off or her head shaved, then she should cover her head.

verses.textZh: 男人不应蒙着头，因为他是神的形象和荣耀，而女人是男人的荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 男人不应蒙着头，因为他是神的形象和荣耀，而女人是男人的荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 男人本不该蒙着头，因为他是神的形象和荣耀；但女人是男人的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: A man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God; but woman is the glory of man.
verses.textEnEsv: For a man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God, but woman is the glory of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God; but woman is the glory of man.
verses.textEnNlt: A man should not wear anything on his head when worshiping, for man is made in God’s image and reflects God’s glory. And woman reflects man’s glory.
verses.textEnNasb: For a man should not have his head covered, since he is the image and glory of God; but the woman is the glory of man.
verses.textEn: A man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God; but woman is the glory of man.

verses.textZh: 因为男人不是由女人而出，女人却是由男人而出，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为男人不是由女人而出，女人却是由男人而出，
verses.textZhCuv: 起初，男人不是由女人而出，女人乃是由男人而出；
verses.textEnNiv: For man did not come from woman, but woman from man;
verses.textEnEsv: For man was not made from woman, but woman from man.
verses.textEnNkjv: For man is not from woman, but woman from man.
verses.textEnNlt: For the first man didn’t come from woman, but the first woman came from man.
verses.textEnNasb: For man does not originate from woman, but woman from man;
verses.textEn: For man did not come from woman, but woman from man;

verses.textZh: 并且男人不是为了女人而造的，女人却是为了男人而造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且男人不是为了女人而造的，女人却是为了男人而造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且男人不是为女人造的，女人乃是为男人造的。
verses.textEnNiv: neither was man created for woman, but woman for man.
verses.textEnEsv: Neither was man created for woman, but woman for man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor was man created for the woman, but woman for the man.
verses.textEnNlt: And man was not made for woman, but woman was made for man.
verses.textEnNasb: for indeed man was not created for the woman’s sake, but woman for the man’s sake.
verses.textEn: neither was man created for woman, but woman for man.

verses.textZh: 因此，为天使的缘故，女人应当在头上有服权柄的记号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，为天使的缘故，女人应当在头上有服权柄的记号。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，女人为天使的缘故，应当在头上有服权柄的记号。
verses.textEnNiv: It is for this reason that a woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.
verses.textEnEsv: That is why a wife ought to have a symbol of authority on her head, because of the angels.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this reason the woman ought to have asymbolof authority on her head, because of the angels.
verses.textEnNlt: For this reason, and because the angels are watching, a woman should wear a covering on her head to show she is under authority.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the woman should have a symbol of authority on her head, because of the angels.
verses.textEn: It is for this reason that a woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.

verses.textZh: 然而在主里面，女人不可以没有男人，男人也不可以没有女人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而在主里面，女人不可以没有男人，男人也不可以没有女人。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而照主的安排，女也不是无男，男也不是无女。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, in the Lord woman is not independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, in the Lord woman is not independent of man nor man of woman;
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless, neither is man independent of woman, nor woman independent of man, in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But among the Lord’s people, women are not independent of men, and men are not independent of women.
verses.textEnNasb: However, in the Lord, neither is woman independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, in the Lord woman is not independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.

verses.textZh: 因为正如女人是由男人而出，照样，男人是借着女人而生；万有都是出于神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为正如女人是由男人而出，照样，男人是借着女人而生；万有都是出于神。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为女人原是由男人而出，男人也是由女人而出；但万有都是出乎神。
verses.textEnNiv: For as woman came from man, so also man is born of woman. But everything comes from God.
verses.textEnEsv: for as woman was made from man, so man is now born of woman. And all things are from God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as woman came from man, even so man also comes through woman; but all things are from God.
verses.textEnNlt: For although the first woman came from man, every other man was born from a woman, and everything comes from God.
verses.textEnNasb: For as the woman originated from the man, so also the man has his birth through the woman; and all things originate from God.
verses.textEn: For as woman came from man, so also man is born of woman. But everything comes from God.

verses.textZh: 你们自己判断一下，女人向神祷告的时候不蒙头，是合适的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们自己判断一下，女人向神祷告的时候不蒙头，是合适的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们自己审察，女人祷告神，不蒙着头是合宜的吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?
verses.textEnEsv: Judge for yourselves: is it proper for a wife to pray to God with her head uncovered?
verses.textEnNkjv: Judge among yourselves. Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?
verses.textEnNlt: Judge for yourselves. Is it right for a woman to pray to God in public without covering her head?
verses.textEnNasb: Judge for yourselves: is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?
verses.textEn: Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?

verses.textZh: 人的本性不是也教导你们，如果男人有长头发，就是他的羞耻吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 人的本性不是也教导你们，如果男人有长头发，就是他的羞耻吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的本性不也指示你们，男人若有长头发，便是他的羞辱吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Does not the very nature of things teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him,
verses.textEnEsv: Does not nature itself teach you that if a man wears long hair it is a disgrace for him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Does not even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?
verses.textEnNlt: Isn’t it obvious that it’s disgraceful for a man to have long hair?
verses.textEnNasb: Does even nature itself not teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him,
verses.textEn: Does not the very nature of things teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him,

verses.textZh: 如果女人有长头发，不就是她的荣耀吗？因为头发是给她作盖头的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果女人有长头发，不就是她的荣耀吗？因为头发是给她作盖头的。
verses.textZhCuv: 但女人有长头发，乃是她的荣耀，因为这头发是给她作盖头的。
verses.textEnNiv: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.
verses.textEnEsv: but if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For her hair is given to her for a covering.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her; for her hair is given to her for a covering.
verses.textEnNlt: And isn’t long hair a woman’s pride and joy? For it has been given to her as a covering.
verses.textEnNasb: but if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her? For her hair is given to her as a covering.
verses.textEn: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.

verses.textZh: 如果有人想要强辩，我们却没有这种习惯，神的众教会也没有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人想要强辩，我们却没有这种习惯，神的众教会也没有。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人想要辩驳，我们却没有这样的规矩，神的众教会也是没有的。
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone wants to be contentious about this, we have no other practice—nor do the churches of God.
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone is inclined to be contentious, we have no such practice, nor do the churches of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if anyone seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, nor do the churches of God.
verses.textEnNlt: But if anyone wants to argue about this, I simply say that we have no other custom than this, and neither do God’s other churches.
verses.textEnNasb: But if anyone is inclined to be contentious, we have no such practice, nor have the churches of God.
verses.textEn: If anyone wants to be contentious about this, we have no other practice—nor do the churches of God.

verses.textZh: 我现在要吩咐你们，不是要称赞你们，因为你们聚集在一起，并没有得到益处，反而有害处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我现在要吩咐你们，不是要称赞你们，因为你们聚集在一起，并没有得到益处，反而有害处。
verses.textZhCuv: 我现今吩咐你们的话，不是称赞你们；因为你们聚会不是受益，乃是招损。
verses.textEnNiv: In the following directives I have no praise for you, for your meetings do more harm than good.
verses.textEnEsv: But in the following instructions I do not commend you, because when you come together it is not for the better but for the worse.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in giving these instructions I do not praise you, since you come together not for the better but for the worse.
verses.textEnNlt: But in the following instructions, I cannot praise you. For it sounds as if more harm than good is done when you meet together.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in giving this next instruction I do not praise you, because you come together not for the better, but for the worse.
verses.textEn: In the following directives I have no praise for you, for your meetings do more harm than good.

verses.textZh: 首先，我听说你们在聚会的时候，你们中间起了分裂，这话我也稍微相信。
verses.textZhCnvs: 首先，我听说你们在聚会的时候，你们中间起了分裂，这话我也稍微相信。
verses.textZhCuv: 第一，我听说，你们聚会的时候彼此分门别类，我也稍微地信这话。
verses.textEnNiv: In the first place, I hear that when you come together as a church, there are divisions among you, and to some extent I believe it.
verses.textEnEsv: For, in the first place, when you come together as a church, I hear that there are divisions among you. And I believe it in part,
verses.textEnNkjv: For first of all, when you come together as a church, I hear that there are divisions among you, and in part I believe it.
verses.textEnNlt: First, I hear that there are divisions among you when you meet as a church, and to some extent I believe it.
verses.textEnNasb: For, in the first place, when you come together as a church, I hear that divisions exist among you; and in part I believe it.
verses.textEn: In the first place, I hear that when you come together as a church, there are divisions among you, and to some extent I believe it.

verses.textZh: 你们中间会有分党结派的事，这是必然的，为的是要使那些经得起考验的人显明出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们中间会有分党结派的事，这是必然的，为的是要使那些经得起考验的人显明出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你们中间不免有分门结党的事，好叫那些有经验的人显明出来。
verses.textEnNiv: No doubt there have to be differences among you to show which of you have God’s approval.
verses.textEnEsv: for there must be factions among you in order that those who are genuine among you may be recognized.
verses.textEnNkjv: For there must also be factions among you, that those who are approved may be recognized among you.
verses.textEnNlt: But, of course, there must be divisions among you so that you who have God’s approval will be recognized!
verses.textEnNasb: For there also have to be factions among you, so that those who are approved may become evident among you.
verses.textEn: No doubt there have to be differences among you to show which of you have God’s approval.

verses.textZh: 你们聚集在一起，不是吃主的晚餐，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们聚集在一起，不是吃主的晚餐，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们聚会的时候，算不得吃主的晚餐；
verses.textEnNiv: So then, when you come together, it is not the Lord’s Supper you eat,
verses.textEnEsv: When you come together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore when you come together in one place, it is not to eat the Lord’s Supper.
verses.textEnNlt: When you meet together, you are not really interested in the Lord’s Supper.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore when you come together it is not to eat the Lord’s Supper,
verses.textEn: So then, when you come together, it is not the Lord’s Supper you eat,

verses.textZh: 因为吃的时候，各人都先吃自己的晚餐，结果有人饥饿，有人醉了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为吃的时候，各人都先吃自己的晚餐，结果有人饥饿，有人醉了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为吃的时候，各人先吃自己的饭，甚至这个饥饿，那个酒醉。
verses.textEnNiv: for when you are eating, some of you go ahead with your own private suppers. As a result, one person remains hungry and another gets drunk.
verses.textEnEsv: For in eating, each one goes ahead with his own meal. One goes hungry, another gets drunk.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in eating, each one takes his own supper ahead of others; and one is hungry and another is drunk.
verses.textEnNlt: For some of you hurry to eat your own meal without sharing with others. As a result, some go hungry while others get drunk.
verses.textEnNasb: for when you eat, each one takes his own supper first; and one goes hungry while another gets drunk.
verses.textEn: for when you are eating, some of you go ahead with your own private suppers. As a result, one person remains hungry and another gets drunk.

verses.textZh: 难道你们没有家可以吃喝吗？还是你们藐视神的教会，使那些没有的羞愧呢？我向你们可以说甚么呢？称赞你们吗？在这事上我不能称赞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道你们没有家可以吃喝吗？还是你们藐视神的教会，使那些没有的羞愧呢？我向你们可以说甚么呢？称赞你们吗？在这事上我不能称赞。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要吃喝，难道没有家吗？还是藐视神的教会，叫那没有的羞愧呢？我向你们可怎么说呢？可因此称赞你们吗？我不称赞！
verses.textEnNiv: Don’t you have homes to eat and drink in? Or do you despise the church of God by humiliating those who have nothing? What shall I say to you? Shall I praise you? Certainly not in this matter!
verses.textEnEsv: What! Do you not have houses to eat and drink in? Or do you despise the church of God and humiliate those who have nothing? What shall I say to you? Shall I commend you in this? No, I will not.
verses.textEnNkjv: What! Do you not have houses to eat and drink in? Or do you despise the church of God and shame those who have nothing? What shall I say to you? Shall I praise you in this? I do not praise you.
verses.textEnNlt: What? Don’t you have your own homes for eating and drinking? Or do you really want to disgrace God’s church and shame the poor? What am I supposed to say? Do you want me to praise you? Well, I certainly will not praise you for this!
verses.textEnNasb: What! Do you not have houses in which to eat and drink? Or do you despise the church of God and shame those who have nothing? What am I to say to you? Shall I praise you? In this I do not praise you.
verses.textEn: Don’t you have homes to eat and drink in? Or do you despise the church of God by humiliating those who have nothing? What shall I say to you? Shall I praise you? Certainly not in this matter!

verses.textZh: 我当日传交给你们的，原是从主领受的，就是主耶稣被出卖的那一夜，他拿起饼来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我当日传交给你们的，原是从主领受的，就是主耶稣被出卖的那一夜，他拿起饼来，
verses.textZhCuv: 我当日传给你们的，原是从主领受的，就是主耶稣被卖的那一夜，拿起饼来，
verses.textEnNiv: For I received from the Lord what I also passed on to you: The Lord Jesus, on the night he was betrayed, took bread,
verses.textEnEsv: For I received from the Lord what I also delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night when he was betrayed took bread,
verses.textEnNkjv: For I received from the Lord that which I also delivered to you: that the Lord Jesus on the same night in which He was betrayed took bread;
verses.textEnNlt: For I pass on to you what I received from the Lord himself. On the night when he was betrayed, the Lord Jesus took some bread
verses.textEnNasb: For I received from the Lord that which I also delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus, on the night when He was betrayed, took bread;
verses.textEn: For I received from the Lord what I also passed on to you: The Lord Jesus, on the night he was betrayed, took bread,

verses.textZh: 祝谢了，就擘开，说："<red>这是我的身体，为你们擘开的；你们应当这样行，为的是记念我。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 祝谢了，就擘开，说："<red>这是我的身体，为你们擘开的；你们应当这样行，为的是记念我。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 祝谢了，就擘开，说：「<red>这是我的身体，为你们舍 的，你们应当如此行，为的是记念我。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: and when he had given thanks, he broke it and said, <red>“This is my body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and when he had given thanks, he broke it, and said, "This is my body, which is for you. Do this in remembrance of me."
verses.textEnNkjv: and when He had given thanks, He broke it and said, "Take, eat; this is My body which is broken for you; do this in remembrance of Me."
verses.textEnNlt: and gave thanks to God for it. Then he broke it in pieces and said, "This is my body, which is given for you. Do this in remembrance of me."
verses.textEnNasb: and when He had given thanks, He broke it and said, "This is My body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of Me."
verses.textEn: and when he had given thanks, he broke it and said, <red>“This is my body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 饭后，照样拿起杯来，说："<red>这杯是用我的血所立的新约，你们每逢喝的时候，应当这样行，为的是记念我。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 饭后，照样拿起杯来，说："<red>这杯是用我的血所立的新约，你们每逢喝的时候，应当这样行，为的是记念我。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 饭后，也照样拿起杯来，说：「<red>这杯是用我的血所立的新约，你们每逢喝的时候，要如此行，为的是记念我。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way, after supper he took the cup, saying, <red>“This cup is the new covenant in my blood; do this, whenever you drink it, in remembrance of me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: In the same way also he took the cup, after supper, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of me."
verses.textEnNkjv: In the same manner He also took the cup after supper, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in My blood. This do, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me."
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, he took the cup of wine after supper, saying, "This cup is the new covenant between God and his people—an agreement confirmed with my blood. Do this in remembrance of me as often as you drink it."
verses.textEnNasb: In the same way He also took the cup after supper, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in My blood; do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me."
verses.textEn: In the same way, after supper he took the cup, saying, <red>“This cup is the new covenant in my blood; do this, whenever you drink it, in remembrance of me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 你们每逢吃这饼，喝这杯，就是宣扬主的死，直等到他来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们每逢吃这饼，喝这杯，就是宣扬主的死，直等到他来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们每逢吃这饼，喝这杯，是表明主的死，直等到他来。
verses.textEnNiv: For whenever you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.
verses.textEnEsv: For as often as you eat this bread and drink the cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death till He comes.
verses.textEnNlt: For every time you eat this bread and drink this cup, you are announcing the Lord’s death until he comes again.
verses.textEnNasb: For as often as you eat this bread and drink the cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until He comes.
verses.textEn: For whenever you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

verses.textZh: 因此，无论甚么人若用不合适的态度吃主的饼，喝主的杯，就是得罪主的身体、主的血了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，无论甚么人若用不合适的态度吃主的饼，喝主的杯，就是得罪主的身体、主的血了。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，无论何人，不按理吃主的饼，喝主的杯，就是干犯主的身、主的血了。
verses.textEnNiv: So then, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever, therefore, eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty concerning the body and blood of the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks this cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So anyone who eats this bread or drinks this cup of the Lord unworthily is guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy way, shall be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.
verses.textEn: So then, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.

verses.textZh: 所以人应当省察自己，然后才吃这饼，喝这杯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以人应当省察自己，然后才吃这饼，喝这杯。
verses.textZhCuv: 人应当自己省察，然后吃这饼、喝这杯。
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone ought to examine themselves before they eat of the bread and drink from the cup.
verses.textEnEsv: Let a person examine himself, then, and so eat of the bread and drink of the cup.
verses.textEnNkjv: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why you should examine yourself before eating the bread and drinking the cup.
verses.textEnNasb: But a person must examine himself, and in so doing he is to eat of the bread and drink of the cup.
verses.textEn: Everyone ought to examine themselves before they eat of the bread and drink from the cup.

verses.textZh: 因为那吃喝的人，如果不辨明是主的身体，就是吃喝定在自己的身上的罪了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为那吃喝的人，如果不辨明是主的身体，就是吃喝定在自己的身上的罪了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为人吃喝，若不分辨是主的身体，就是吃喝自己的罪了。
verses.textEnNiv: For those who eat and drink without discerning the body of Christ eat and drink judgment on themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: For anyone who eats and drinks without discerning the body eats and drinks judgment on himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy manner eats and drinks judgment to himself, not discerning the Lord’s body.
verses.textEnNlt: For if you eat the bread or drink the cup without honoring the body of Christ, you are eating and drinking God’s judgment upon yourself.
verses.textEnNasb: For the one who eats and drinks, eats and drinks judgment to himself if he does not properly recognize the body.
verses.textEn: For those who eat and drink without discerning the body of Christ eat and drink judgment on themselves.

verses.textZh: 因此，你们中间有许多人是软弱的，患病的，而且死了 的也不少。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你们中间有许多人是软弱的，患病的，而且死了 的也不少。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，在你们中间有好些软弱的与患病的，死 的也不少。
verses.textEnNiv: That is why many among you are weak and sick, and a number of you have fallen asleep.
verses.textEnEsv: That is why many of you are weak and ill, and some have died.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this reason many are weak and sick among you, and many sleep.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why many of you are weak and sick and some have even died.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason many among you are weak and sick, and a number are asleep.
verses.textEn: That is why many among you are weak and sick, and a number of you have fallen asleep.

verses.textZh: 我们若仔细省察自己，就不会受审判了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们若仔细省察自己，就不会受审判了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若是先分辨自己，就不至于受审。
verses.textEnNiv: But if we were more discerning with regard to ourselves, we would not come under such judgment.
verses.textEnEsv: But if we judged ourselves truly, we would not be judged.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if we would judge ourselves, we would not be judged.
verses.textEnNlt: But if we would examine ourselves, we would not be judged by God in this way.
verses.textEnNasb: But if we judged ourselves rightly, we would not be judged.
verses.textEn: But if we were more discerning with regard to ourselves, we would not come under such judgment.

verses.textZh: 然而我们被主审判的时候，是受他的管教，免得和世人一同被定罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而我们被主审判的时候，是受他的管教，免得和世人一同被定罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们受审的时候，乃是被主惩治，免得我们和世人一同定罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, when we are judged in this way by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be finally condemned with the world.
verses.textEnEsv: But when we are judged by the Lord, we are disciplined so that we may not be condemned along with the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when we are judged, we are chastened by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet when we are judged by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned along with the world.
verses.textEnNasb: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord so that we will not be condemned along with the world.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, when we are judged in this way by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be finally condemned with the world.

verses.textZh: 所以，我的弟兄们，你们聚集在一起吃的时候，要彼此等待。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我的弟兄们，你们聚集在一起吃的时候，要彼此等待。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我弟兄们，你们聚会吃的时候，要彼此等待。
verses.textEnNiv: So then, my brothers and sisters, when you gather to eat, you should all eat together.
verses.textEnEsv: So then, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another—
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, my brethren, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
verses.textEnNlt: So, my dear brothers and sisters, when you gather for the Lord’s Supper, wait for each other.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, my brothers and sisters, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
verses.textEn: So then, my brothers and sisters, when you gather to eat, you should all eat together.

verses.textZh: 如果有人饿了，就应当在家里先吃，免得你们聚集在一起的时候受到审判。其余的事，我来的时候再作安排。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人饿了，就应当在家里先吃，免得你们聚集在一起的时候受到审判。其余的事，我来的时候再作安排。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人饥饿，可以在家里先吃，免得你们聚会，自己取罪。其余的事，我来的时候再安排。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who is hungry should eat something at home, so that when you meet together it may not result in judgment. And when I come I will give further directions.
verses.textEnEsv: if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home—so that when you come together it will not be for judgment. About the other things I will give directions when I come.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest you come together for judgment. And the rest I will set in order when I come.
verses.textEnNlt: If you are really hungry, eat at home so you won’t bring judgment upon yourselves when you meet together. I’ll give you instructions about the other matters after I arrive.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone is hungry, have him eat at home, so that you do not come together for judgment. As to the remaining matters, I will give instructions when I come.
verses.textEn: Anyone who is hungry should eat something at home, so that when you meet together it may not result in judgment. And when I come I will give further directions.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，关于属灵的恩赐，我不愿意你们不明白。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，关于属灵的恩赐，我不愿意你们不明白。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，论到属灵的恩赐，我不愿意你们不明白。
verses.textEnNiv: Now about the gifts of the Spirit, brothers and sisters, I do not want you to be uninformed.
verses.textEnEsv: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brothers, I do not want you to be uninformed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I do not want you to be ignorant:
verses.textEnNlt: Now, dear brothers and sisters, regarding your question about the special abilities the Spirit gives us. I don’t want you to misunderstand this.
verses.textEnNasb: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brothers and sisters, I do not want you to be unaware.
verses.textEn: Now about the gifts of the Spirit, brothers and sisters, I do not want you to be uninformed.

verses.textZh: 你们知道，你们还是教外人的时候，总是受迷惑被引诱，去拜那不能说话的偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们知道，你们还是教外人的时候，总是受迷惑被引诱，去拜那不能说话的偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作外邦人的时候，随事被牵引，受迷惑，去服事那哑巴偶像，这是你们知道的。
verses.textEnNiv: You know that when you were pagans, somehow or other you were influenced and led astray to mute idols.
verses.textEnEsv: You know that when you were pagans you were led astray to mute idols, however you were led.
verses.textEnNkjv: You know that you were Gentiles, carried away to these dumb idols, however you were led.
verses.textEnNlt: You know that when you were still pagans, you were led astray and swept along in worshiping speechless idols.
verses.textEnNasb: You know that when you were pagans, you were led astray to the mute idols, however you were led.
verses.textEn: You know that when you were pagans, somehow or other you were influenced and led astray to mute idols.

verses.textZh: 所以我要你们知道，被神的灵感动而说话的人，没有一个会说"耶稣是可咒诅的"；除非是被圣灵感动，也没有人能说"耶稣是主"。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我要你们知道，被神的灵感动而说话的人，没有一个会说"耶稣是可咒诅的"；除非是被圣灵感动，也没有人能说"耶稣是主"。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我告诉你们，被神的灵感动的，没有说「耶稣是可咒诅」的；若不是被圣灵感动的，也没有能说「耶稣是主」的。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I want you to know that no one who is speaking by the Spirit of God says, "Jesus be cursed," and no one can say, "Jesus is Lord," except by the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I want you to understand that no one speaking in the Spirit of God ever says "Jesus is accursed!" and no one can say "Jesus is Lord" except in the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I make known to you that no one speaking by the Spirit of God calls Jesus accursed, and no one can say that Jesus is Lord except by the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: So I want you to know that no one speaking by the Spirit of God will curse Jesus, and no one can say Jesus is Lord, except by the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I make known to you that no one speaking by the Spirit of God says, "Jesus is accursed"; and no one can say, "Jesus is Lord," except by the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEn: Therefore I want you to know that no one who is speaking by the Spirit of God says, "Jesus be cursed," and no one can say, "Jesus is Lord," except by the Holy Spirit.

verses.textZh: 恩赐有许多种，却是同一位圣灵所赐的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 恩赐有许多种，却是同一位圣灵所赐的；
verses.textZhCuv: 恩赐原有分别，圣灵却是一位。
verses.textEnNiv: There are different kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit distributes them.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there are varieties of gifts, but the same Spirit;
verses.textEnNkjv: There are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but the same Spirit is the source of them all.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there are varieties of gifts, but the same Spirit.
verses.textEn: There are different kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit distributes them.

verses.textZh: 服事的职分有许多种，但是同一位主；
verses.textZhCnvs: 服事的职分有许多种，但是同一位主；
verses.textZhCuv: 职事也有分别，主却是一位。
verses.textEnNiv: There are different kinds of service, but the same Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: and there are varieties of service, but the same Lord;
verses.textEnNkjv: There are differences of ministries, but the same Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: There are different kinds of service, but we serve the same Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: And there are varieties of ministries, and the same Lord.
verses.textEn: There are different kinds of service, but the same Lord.

verses.textZh: 工作的方式也有许多种，但仍是一位神，是他在众人里面作成一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 工作的方式也有许多种，但仍是一位神，是他在众人里面作成一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 功用也有分别，神却是一位，在众人里面运行一切的事。
verses.textEnNiv: There are different kinds of working, but in all of them and in everyone it is the same God at work.
verses.textEnEsv: and there are varieties of activities, but it is the same God who empowers them all in everyone.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there are diversities of activities, but it is the same God who works all in all.
verses.textEnNlt: God works in different ways, but it is the same God who does the work in all of us.
verses.textEnNasb: There are varieties of effects, but the same God who works all things in all persons.
verses.textEn: There are different kinds of working, but in all of them and in everyone it is the same God at work.

verses.textZh: 圣灵显现在各人的身上，为的是要使人得着益处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣灵显现在各人的身上，为的是要使人得着益处。
verses.textZhCuv: 圣灵显在各人身上，是叫人得益处。
verses.textEnNiv: Now to each one the manifestation of the Spirit is given for the common good.
verses.textEnEsv: To each is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the common good.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to each one for the profit ofall:
verses.textEnNlt: A spiritual gift is given to each of us so we can help each other.
verses.textEnNasb: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the common good.
verses.textEn: Now to each one the manifestation of the Spirit is given for the common good.

verses.textZh: 有人借着圣灵领受了智慧的言语，又有人靠着同一位圣灵领受了知识的言语，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人借着圣灵领受了智慧的言语，又有人靠着同一位圣灵领受了知识的言语，
verses.textZhCuv: 这人蒙圣灵赐他智慧的言语，那人也蒙这位圣灵赐他知识的言语，
verses.textEnNiv: To one there is given through the Spirit a message of wisdom, to another a message of knowledge by means of the same Spirit,
verses.textEnEsv: For to one is given through the Spirit the utterance of wisdom, and to another the utterance of knowledge according to the same Spirit,
verses.textEnNkjv: for to one is given the word of wisdom through the Spirit, to another the word of knowledge through the same Spirit,
verses.textEnNlt: To one person the Spirit gives the ability to give wise advice ; to another the same Spirit gives a message of special knowledge.
verses.textEnNasb: For to one is given the word of wisdom through the Spirit, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit;
verses.textEn: To one there is given through the Spirit a message of wisdom, to another a message of knowledge by means of the same Spirit,

verses.textZh: 又有人因着同一位圣灵领受了信心，还有人因着这位圣灵领受了医病的恩赐，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有人因着同一位圣灵领受了信心，还有人因着这位圣灵领受了医病的恩赐，
verses.textZhCuv: 又有一人蒙这位圣灵赐他信心，还有一人蒙这位圣灵赐他医病的恩赐，
verses.textEnNiv: to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healing by that one Spirit,
verses.textEnEsv: to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healing by the one Spirit,
verses.textEnNkjv: to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,
verses.textEnNlt: The same Spirit gives great faith to another, and to someone else the one Spirit gives the gift of healing.
verses.textEnNasb: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healing by the one Spirit,
verses.textEn: to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healing by that one Spirit,

verses.textZh: 另有人可以行神迹，另有人可以讲道，另有人可以辨别诸灵，也有人能说各种的方言，也有人能翻译方言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 另有人可以行神迹，另有人可以讲道，另有人可以辨别诸灵，也有人能说各种的方言，也有人能翻译方言。
verses.textZhCuv: 又叫一人能行异能，又叫一人能作先知，又叫一人能辨别诸灵，又叫一人能说方言，又叫一人能翻方言。
verses.textEnNiv: to another miraculous powers, to another prophecy, to another distinguishing between spirits, to another speaking in different kinds of tongues, and to still another the interpretation of tongues.
verses.textEnEsv: to another the working of miracles, to another prophecy, to another the ability to distinguish between spirits, to another various kinds of tongues, to another the interpretation of tongues.
verses.textEnNkjv: to another the working of miracles, to another prophecy, to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of tongues, to another the interpretation of tongues.
verses.textEnNlt: He gives one person the power to perform miracles, and another the ability to prophesy. He gives someone else the ability to discern whether a message is from the Spirit of God or from another spirit. Still another person is given the ability to speak in unknown languages, while another is given the ability to interpret what is being said.
verses.textEnNasb: and to another the effecting of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another the distinguishing of spirits, to another various kinds of tongues, and to another the interpretation of tongues.
verses.textEn: to another miraculous powers, to another prophecy, to another distinguishing between spirits, to another speaking in different kinds of tongues, and to still another the interpretation of tongues.

verses.textZh: 这一切都是这同一位圣灵所作的，他按照自己的意思个别地分给各人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一切都是这同一位圣灵所作的，他按照自己的意思个别地分给各人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这一切都是这位圣灵所运行、随己意分给各人的。
verses.textEnNiv: All these are the work of one and the same Spirit, and he distributes them to each one, just as he determines.
verses.textEnEsv: All these are empowered by one and the same Spirit, who apportions to each one individually as he wills.
verses.textEnNkjv: But one and the same Spirit works all these things, distributing to each one individually as He wills.
verses.textEnNlt: It is the one and only Spirit who distributes all these gifts. He alone decides which gift each person should have.
verses.textEnNasb: But one and the same Spirit works all these things, distributing to each one individually just as He wills.
verses.textEn: All these are the work of one and the same Spirit, and he distributes them to each one, just as he determines.

verses.textZh: 正如身体是一个，却有许多肢体，而且肢体虽然很多，身体仍是一个；基督也是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如身体是一个，却有许多肢体，而且肢体虽然很多，身体仍是一个；基督也是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 就如身子是一个，却有许多肢体；而且肢体虽多，仍是一个身子；基督也是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: Just as a body, though one, has many parts, but all its many parts form one body, so it is with Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: For just as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, though many, are one body, so it is with Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as the body is one and has many members, but all the members of that one body, being many, are one body, so also is Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: The human body has many parts, but the many parts make up one whole body. So it is with the body of Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For just as the body is one and yet has many parts, and all the parts of the body, though they are many, are one body, so also is Christ.
verses.textEn: Just as a body, though one, has many parts, but all its many parts form one body, so it is with Christ.

verses.textZh: 我们无论是犹太人，是希腊人，是作奴隶的，是自由的，都在那一位圣灵里受了洗，成为一个身体，都饮了那一位圣灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们无论是犹太人，是希腊人，是作奴隶的，是自由的，都在那一位圣灵里受了洗，成为一个身体，都饮了那一位圣灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们不拘是犹太人，是希腊人，是为奴的，是自主的，都从一位圣灵受洗，成了一个身体，饮于一位圣灵。
verses.textEnNiv: For we were all baptized by one Spirit so as to form one body—whether Jews or Gentiles, slave or free—and we were all given the one Spirit to drink.
verses.textEnEsv: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body— Jews or Greeks, slaves or free—and all were made to drink of one Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: For by one Spirit we were all baptized into one body— whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free—and have all been made to drink into one Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of us are Jews, some are Gentiles, some are slaves, and some are free. But we have all been baptized into one body by one Spirit, and we all share the same Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: For by one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free, and we were all made to drink of one Spirit.
verses.textEn: For we were all baptized by one Spirit so as to form one body—whether Jews or Gentiles, slave or free—and we were all given the one Spirit to drink.

verses.textZh: 原来身体有许多肢体，并不是只有一个肢体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来身体有许多肢体，并不是只有一个肢体。
verses.textZhCuv: 身子原不是一个肢体，乃是许多肢体。
verses.textEnNiv: Even so the body is not made up of one part but of many.
verses.textEnEsv: For the body does not consist of one member but of many.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in fact the body is not one member but many.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, the body has many different parts, not just one part.
verses.textEnNasb: For the body is not one part, but many.
verses.textEn: Even so the body is not made up of one part but of many.

verses.textZh: 假如脚说："我不是手，所以我不属于身体。"它不能因此就不属于身体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 假如脚说："我不是手，所以我不属于身体。"它不能因此就不属于身体。
verses.textZhCuv: 设若脚说：「我不是手，所以不属乎身子，」它不能因此就不属乎身子。
verses.textEnNiv: Now if the foot should say, "Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body," it would not for that reason stop being part of the body.
verses.textEnEsv: If the foot should say, "Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body," that would not make it any less a part of the body.
verses.textEnNkjv: If the foot should say, "Because I am not a hand, I am not of the body," is it therefore not of the body?
verses.textEnNlt: If the foot says, "I am not a part of the body because I am not a hand," that does not make it any less a part of the body.
verses.textEnNasb: If the foot says, "Because I am not a hand, I am not a part of the body," it is not for this reason any less a part of the body.
verses.textEn: Now if the foot should say, "Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body," it would not for that reason stop being part of the body.

verses.textZh: 假如耳朵说："我不是眼睛，所以我不属于身体。"它也不能因此就不属于身体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 假如耳朵说："我不是眼睛，所以我不属于身体。"它也不能因此就不属于身体。
verses.textZhCuv: 设若耳说：「我不是眼，所以不属乎身子，」它也不能因此就不属乎身子。
verses.textEnNiv: And if the ear should say, "Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body," it would not for that reason stop being part of the body.
verses.textEnEsv: And if the ear should say, "Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body," that would not make it any less a part of the body.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if the ear should say, "Because I am not an eye, I am not of the body," is it therefore not of the body?
verses.textEnNlt: And if the ear says, "I am not part of the body because I am not an eye," would that make it any less a part of the body?
verses.textEnNasb: And if the ear says, "Because I am not an eye, I am not a part of the body," it is not for this reason any less a part of the body.
verses.textEn: And if the ear should say, "Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body," it would not for that reason stop being part of the body.

verses.textZh: 假如整个身体只是眼睛，怎样听呢？假如整个身体只是耳朵，怎样闻味呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 假如整个身体只是眼睛，怎样听呢？假如整个身体只是耳朵，怎样闻味呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 若全身是眼，从哪里听声呢？若全身是耳，从哪里闻味呢？
verses.textEnNiv: If the whole body were an eye, where would the sense of hearing be? If the whole body were an ear, where would the sense of smell be?
verses.textEnEsv: If the whole body were an eye, where would be the sense of hearing? If the whole body were an ear, where would be the sense of smell?
verses.textEnNkjv: If the whole body were an eye, where wouldbe the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where wouldbe the smelling?
verses.textEnNlt: If the whole body were an eye, how would you hear? Or if your whole body were an ear, how would you smell anything?
verses.textEnNasb: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole body were hearing, where would the sense of smell be?
verses.textEn: If the whole body were an eye, where would the sense of hearing be? If the whole body were an ear, where would the sense of smell be?

verses.textZh: 但现在神按照自己的意思，把肢体一一放在身体上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现在神按照自己的意思，把肢体一一放在身体上。
verses.textZhCuv: 但如今，神随自己的意思把肢体俱各安排在身上了。
verses.textEnNiv: But in fact God has placed the parts in the body, every one of them, just as he wanted them to be.
verses.textEnEsv: But as it is, God arranged the members in the body, each one of them, as he chose.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body just as He pleased.
verses.textEnNlt: But our bodies have many parts, and God has put each part just where he wants it.
verses.textEnNasb: But now God has arranged the parts, each one of them in the body, just as He desired.
verses.textEn: But in fact God has placed the parts in the body, every one of them, just as he wanted them to be.

verses.textZh: 假如所有的只是一个肢体，怎能算是身体呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 假如所有的只是一个肢体，怎能算是身体呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 若都是一个肢体，身子在哪里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: If they were all one part, where would the body be?
verses.textEnEsv: If all were a single member, where would the body be?
verses.textEnNkjv: And if they were all one member, where would the body be?
verses.textEnNlt: How strange a body would be if it had only one part!
verses.textEnNasb: If they were all one part, where would the body be?
verses.textEn: If they were all one part, where would the body be?

verses.textZh: 但现在肢体虽然很多，身体却只是一个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现在肢体虽然很多，身体却只是一个。
verses.textZhCuv: 但如今肢体是多的，身子却是一个。
verses.textEnNiv: As it is, there are many parts, but one body.
verses.textEnEsv: As it is, there are many parts, yet one body.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now indeed thereare many members, yet one body.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, there are many parts, but only one body.
verses.textEnNasb: But now there are many parts, but one body.
verses.textEn: As it is, there are many parts, but one body.

verses.textZh: 眼睛不能对手说："我不需要你。"头也不能对脚说："我不需要你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 眼睛不能对手说："我不需要你。"头也不能对脚说："我不需要你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 眼不能对手说：「我用不着你」；头也不能对脚说：「我用不着你。」
verses.textEnNiv: The eye cannot say to the hand, "I don’t need you!" And the head cannot say to the feet, "I don’t need you!"
verses.textEnEsv: The eye cannot say to the hand, "I have no need of you," nor again the head to the feet, "I have no need of you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the eye cannot say to the hand, "I have no need of you"; nor again the head to the feet, "I have no need of you."
verses.textEnNlt: The eye can never say to the hand, "I don’t need you." The head can’t say to the feet, "I don’t need you."
verses.textEnNasb: And the eye cannot say to the hand, "I have no need of you"; or again, the head to the feet, "I have no need of you."
verses.textEn: The eye cannot say to the hand, "I don’t need you!" And the head cannot say to the feet, "I don’t need you!"

verses.textZh: 相反地，身体上那些似乎比较软弱的肢体，更是不可缺少的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 相反地，身体上那些似乎比较软弱的肢体，更是不可缺少的。
verses.textZhCuv: 不但如此，身上肢体人以为软弱的，更是不可少的。
verses.textEnNiv: On the contrary, those parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,
verses.textEnEsv: On the contrary, the parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,
verses.textEnNkjv: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, some parts of the body that seem weakest and least important are actually the most necessary.
verses.textEnNasb: On the contrary, it is much truer that the parts of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary;
verses.textEn: On the contrary, those parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,

verses.textZh: 我们认为身体上不大体面的部分，就更加要把它装饰得体面；不大美观的部分，就更加要使它美观。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们认为身体上不大体面的部分，就更加要把它装饰得体面；不大美观的部分，就更加要使它美观。
verses.textZhCuv: 身上肢体，我们看为不体面的，越发给它加上体面；不俊美的，越发得着俊美。
verses.textEnNiv: and the parts that we think are less honorable we treat with special honor. And the parts that are unpresentable are treated with special modesty,
verses.textEnEsv: and on those parts of the body that we think less honorable we bestow the greater honor, and our unpresentable parts are treated with greater modesty,
verses.textEnNkjv: And those members of the body which we think to be less honorable, on these we bestow greater honor; and our unpresentable parts have greater modesty,
verses.textEnNlt: And the parts we regard as less honorable are those we clothe with the greatest care. So we carefully protect those parts that should not be seen,
verses.textEnNasb: and those parts of the body which we consider less honorable, on these we bestow greater honor, and our less presentable parts become much more presentable,
verses.textEn: and the parts that we think are less honorable we treat with special honor. And the parts that are unpresentable are treated with special modesty,

verses.textZh: 我们身体上美观的部分，就不需要这样了。但神却这样把身体组成了：格外地把体面加给比较有缺欠的肢体，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们身体上美观的部分，就不需要这样了。但神却这样把身体组成了：格外地把体面加给比较有缺欠的肢体，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们俊美的肢体，自然用不着装饰；但神配搭这身子，把加倍的体面给那有缺欠的肢体，
verses.textEnNiv: while our presentable parts need no special treatment. But God has put the body together, giving greater honor to the parts that lacked it,
verses.textEnEsv: which our more presentable parts do not require. But God has so composed the body, giving greater honor to the part that lacked it,
verses.textEnNkjv: but our presentable parts have no need. But God composed the body, having given greater honor to that part which lacks it,
verses.textEnNlt: while the more honorable parts do not require this special care. So God has put the body together such that extra honor and care are given to those parts that have less dignity.
verses.textEnNasb: whereas our more presentable parts have no need of it. But God has so composed the body, giving more abundant honor to that part which lacked,
verses.textEn: while our presentable parts need no special treatment. But God has put the body together, giving greater honor to the parts that lacked it,

verses.textZh: 好使肢体能够互相照顾，免得身体上有了分裂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好使肢体能够互相照顾，免得身体上有了分裂。
verses.textZhCuv: 免得身上分门别类，总要肢体彼此相顾。
verses.textEnNiv: so that there should be no division in the body, but that its parts should have equal concern for each other.
verses.textEnEsv: that there may be no division in the body, but that the members may have the same care for one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: that there should be no schism in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.
verses.textEnNlt: This makes for harmony among the members, so that all the members care for each other.
verses.textEnNasb: so that there may be no division in the body, but that the parts may have the same care for one another.
verses.textEn: so that there should be no division in the body, but that its parts should have equal concern for each other.

verses.textZh: 如果一个肢体受苦，所有的肢体就一同受苦；如果一个肢体得荣耀，所有的肢体就一同快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果一个肢体受苦，所有的肢体就一同受苦；如果一个肢体得荣耀，所有的肢体就一同快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 若一个肢体受苦，所有的肢体就一同受苦；若一个肢体得荣耀，所有的肢体就一同快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: If one part suffers, every part suffers with it; if one part is honored, every part rejoices with it.
verses.textEnEsv: If one member suffers, all suffer together; if one member is honored, all rejoice together.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if one member suffers, all the members suffer with it; or if one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
verses.textEnNlt: If one part suffers, all the parts suffer with it, and if one part is honored, all the parts are glad.
verses.textEnNasb: And if one part of the body suffers, all the parts suffer with it; if a part is honored, all the parts rejoice with it.
verses.textEn: If one part suffers, every part suffers with it; if one part is honored, every part rejoices with it.

verses.textZh: 你们就是基督的身体，并且每一个人都是作肢体的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们就是基督的身体，并且每一个人都是作肢体的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们就是基督的身子，并且各自作肢体。
verses.textEnNiv: Now you are the body of Christ, and each one of you is a part of it.
verses.textEnEsv: Now you are the body of Christ and individually members of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
verses.textEnNlt: All of you together are Christ’s body, and each of you is a part of it.
verses.textEnNasb: Now you are Christ’s body, and individually parts of it.
verses.textEn: Now you are the body of Christ, and each one of you is a part of it.

verses.textZh: 神在教会里所设立的，第一是使徒，第二是先知，第三是教师，其次是行神迹的，再其次是有医病恩赐的，帮助人的，治理事的，说各种方言的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神在教会里所设立的，第一是使徒，第二是先知，第三是教师，其次是行神迹的，再其次是有医病恩赐的，帮助人的，治理事的，说各种方言的。
verses.textZhCuv: 神在教会所设立的：第一是使徒，第二是先知，第三是教师，其次是行异能的，再次是得恩赐医病的，帮助人的，治理事的，说方言的。
verses.textEnNiv: And God has placed in the church first of all apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracles, then gifts of healing, of helping, of guidance, and of different kinds of tongues.
verses.textEnEsv: And God has appointed in the church first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracles, then gifts of healing, helping, administrating, and various kinds of tongues.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God has appointed these in the church: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, administrations, varieties of tongues.
verses.textEnNlt: Here are some of the parts God has appointed for the church: first are apostles, second are prophets, third are teachers, then those who do miracles, those who have the gift of healing, those who can help others, those who have the gift of leadership, those who speak in unknown languages.
verses.textEnNasb: And God has appointed in the church, first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, administrations, and various kinds of tongues.
verses.textEn: And God has placed in the church first of all apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracles, then gifts of healing, of helping, of guidance, and of different kinds of tongues.

verses.textZh: 难道都是使徒吗？都是先知吗？都是教师吗？都是行神迹的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道都是使徒吗？都是先知吗？都是教师吗？都是行神迹的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 岂都是使徒吗？岂都是先知吗？岂都是教师吗？岂都是行异能的吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?
verses.textEnEsv: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?
verses.textEnNkjv: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all workers of miracles?
verses.textEnNlt: Are we all apostles? Are we all prophets? Are we all teachers? Do we all have the power to do miracles?
verses.textEnNasb: All are not apostles, are they? All are not prophets, are they? All are not teachers, are they? All are not workers of miracles, are they?
verses.textEn: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?

verses.textZh: 都是有医病恩赐的吗？都是说方言的吗？都是翻译方言的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 都是有医病恩赐的吗？都是说方言的吗？都是翻译方言的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 岂都是得恩赐医病的吗？岂都是说方言的吗？岂都是翻方言的吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues ? Do all interpret?
verses.textEnEsv: Do all possess gifts of healing? Do all speak with tongues? Do all interpret?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with tongues? Do all interpret?
verses.textEnNlt: Do we all have the gift of healing? Do we all have the ability to speak in unknown languages? Do we all have the ability to interpret unknown languages? Of course not!
verses.textEnNasb: All do not have gifts of healings, do they? All do not speak with tongues, do they? All do not interpret, do they?
verses.textEn: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues ? Do all interpret?

verses.textZh: 你们却要热切地追求那些更大的恩赐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们却要热切地追求那些更大的恩赐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要切切地求那更大的恩赐。 我现今把最妙的道指示你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Now eagerly desire the greater gifts. And yet I will show you the most excellent way.
verses.textEnEsv: But earnestly desire the higher gifts. And I will show you a still more excellent way.
verses.textEnNkjv: But earnestly desire the best gifts. And yet I show you a more excellent way.
verses.textEnNlt: So you should earnestly desire the most helpful gifts. But now let me show you a way of life that is best of all.
verses.textEnNasb: But earnestly desire the greater gifts. And yet, I am going to show you a far better way.
verses.textEn: Now eagerly desire the greater gifts. And yet I will show you the most excellent way.

verses.textZh: 现在我要把更高的道路指示你们。 我若能说世人和天使的方言，却没有爱，我就成了鸣的锣、响的钹一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我要把更高的道路指示你们。 我若能说世人和天使的方言，却没有爱，我就成了鸣的锣、响的钹一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若能说万人的方言，并天使的话语，却没有爱，我就成了鸣的锣，响的钹一般。
verses.textEnNiv: If I speak in the tongues of men or of angels, but do not have love, I am only a resounding gong or a clanging cymbal.
verses.textEnEsv: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
verses.textEnNkjv: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.
verses.textEnNlt: If I could speak all the languages of earth and of angels, but didn’t love others, I would only be a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
verses.textEnNasb: If I speak with the tongues of mankind and of angels, but do not have love, I have become a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
verses.textEn: If I speak in the tongues of men or of angels, but do not have love, I am only a resounding gong or a clanging cymbal.

verses.textZh: 我若有先知讲道的恩赐，也明白各样的奥秘，各样的知识；并且有全备的信，叫我能够移山，却没有爱，我就算不得甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若有先知讲道的恩赐，也明白各样的奥秘，各样的知识；并且有全备的信，叫我能够移山，却没有爱，我就算不得甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若有先知讲道之能，也明白各样的奥秘，各样的知识，而且有全备的信，叫我能够移山，却没有爱，我就算不得什么。
verses.textEnNiv: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have a faith that can move mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: And if I have prophetic powers, and understand all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: And though I have thegiftof prophecy, and understand all mysteries and all knowledge, and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: If I had the gift of prophecy, and if I understood all of God’s secret plans and possessed all knowledge, and if I had such faith that I could move mountains, but didn’t love others, I would be nothing.
verses.textEnNasb: If I have the gift of prophecy and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith so as to remove mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.
verses.textEn: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have a faith that can move mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.

verses.textZh: 我若把一切所有的分给人，又舍己身被人焚烧，却没有爱，对我仍然毫无益处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若把一切所有的分给人，又舍己身被人焚烧，却没有爱，对我仍然毫无益处。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若将所有的周济穷人，又舍己身叫人焚烧，却没有爱，仍然与我无益。
verses.textEnNiv: If I give all I possess to the poor and give over my body to hardship that I may boast, but do not have love, I gain nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: If I give away all I have, and if I deliver up my body to be burned, but have not love, I gain nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: And though I bestow all my goods to feed thepoor, and though I give my body to be burned, but have not love, it profits me nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: If I gave everything I have to the poor and even sacrificed my body, I could boast about it; but if I didn’t love others, I would have gained nothing.
verses.textEnNasb: And if I give away all my possessions to charity, and if I surrender my body so that I may glory, but do not have love, it does me no good.
verses.textEn: If I give all I possess to the poor and give over my body to hardship that I may boast, but do not have love, I gain nothing.

verses.textZh: 爱是恒久忍耐，又有恩慈。爱是不嫉妒，不自夸，不张狂；
verses.textZhCnvs: 爱是恒久忍耐，又有恩慈。爱是不嫉妒，不自夸，不张狂；
verses.textZhCuv: 爱是恒久忍耐，又有恩慈；爱是不嫉妒；爱是不自夸，不张狂，
verses.textEnNiv: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.
verses.textEnEsv: Love is patient and kind; love does not envy or boast; it is not arrogant
verses.textEnNkjv: Love suffers long and is kind; love does not envy; love does not parade itself, is not puffed up;
verses.textEnNlt: Love is patient and kind. Love is not jealous or boastful or proud
verses.textEnNasb: Love is patient, love is kind, it is not jealous; love does not brag, it is not arrogant.
verses.textEn: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.

verses.textZh: 不作失礼的事，不求自己的益处，不轻易动怒，不计较人的过犯；
verses.textZhCnvs: 不作失礼的事，不求自己的益处，不轻易动怒，不计较人的过犯；
verses.textZhCuv: 不做害羞的事，不求自己的益处，不轻易发怒，不计算人的恶，
verses.textEnNiv: It does not dishonor others, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no record of wrongs.
verses.textEnEsv: or rude. It does not insist on its own way; it is not irritable or resentful;
verses.textEnNkjv: does not behave rudely, does not seek its own, is not provoked, thinks no evil;
verses.textEnNlt: or rude. It does not demand its own way. It is not irritable, and it keeps no record of being wronged.
verses.textEnNasb: It does not act disgracefully, it does not seek its own benefit; it is not provoked, does not keep an account of a wrong suffered,
verses.textEn: It does not dishonor others, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no record of wrongs.

verses.textZh: 不喜欢不义，只喜欢真理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不喜欢不义，只喜欢真理。
verses.textZhCuv: 不喜欢不义，只喜欢真理；
verses.textEnNiv: Love does not delight in evil but rejoices with the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: it does not rejoice at wrongdoing, but rejoices with the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: does not rejoice in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth;
verses.textEnNlt: It does not rejoice about injustice but rejoices whenever the truth wins out.
verses.textEnNasb: it does not rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;
verses.textEn: Love does not delight in evil but rejoices with the truth.

verses.textZh: 爱是凡事包容，凡事相信，凡事盼望，凡事忍耐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 爱是凡事包容，凡事相信，凡事盼望，凡事忍耐。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡事包容，凡事相信，凡事盼望，凡事忍耐。
verses.textEnNiv: It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres.
verses.textEnEsv: Love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
verses.textEnNkjv: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
verses.textEnNlt: Love never gives up, never loses faith, is always hopeful, and endures through every circumstance.
verses.textEnNasb: it keeps every confidence, it believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
verses.textEn: It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres.

verses.textZh: 爱是永存不息的。先知的讲道终必过去，方言终必停止，知识终必消失。
verses.textZhCnvs: 爱是永存不息的。先知的讲道终必过去，方言终必停止，知识终必消失。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱是永不止息。先知讲道之能终必归于无有；说方言之能终必停止；知识也终必归于无有。
verses.textEnNiv: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be stilled; where there is knowledge, it will pass away.
verses.textEnEsv: Love never ends. As for prophecies, they will pass away; as for tongues, they will cease; as for knowledge, it will pass away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Love never fails. But whether thereare prophecies, they will fail; whether thereare tongues, they will cease; whether thereis knowledge, it will vanish away.
verses.textEnNlt: Prophecy and speaking in unknown languages and special knowledge will become useless. But love will last forever!
verses.textEnNasb: Love never fails; but if there are gifts of prophecy, they will be done away with; if there are tongues, they will cease; if there is knowledge, it will be done away with.
verses.textEn: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be stilled; where there is knowledge, it will pass away.

verses.textZh: 因为我们现在所知道的，只是一部分；所讲的道也只是一部分；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们现在所知道的，只是一部分；所讲的道也只是一部分；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们现在所知道的有限，先知所讲的也有限，
verses.textEnNiv: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,
verses.textEnEsv: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,
verses.textEnNkjv: For we know in part and we prophesy in part.
verses.textEnNlt: Now our knowledge is partial and incomplete, and even the gift of prophecy reveals only part of the whole picture!
verses.textEnNasb: For we know in part and prophesy in part;
verses.textEn: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,

verses.textZh: 等那完全的来到，这部分的就要过去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 等那完全的来到，这部分的就要过去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 等那完全的来到，这有限的必归于无有了。
verses.textEnNiv: but when completeness comes, what is in part disappears.
verses.textEnEsv: but when the perfect comes, the partial will pass away.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when that which is perfect has come, then that which is in part will be done away.
verses.textEnNlt: But when the time of perfection comes, these partial things will become useless.
verses.textEnNasb: but when the perfect comes, the partial will be done away with.
verses.textEn: but when completeness comes, what is in part disappears.

verses.textZh: 我作孩子的时候，说话像孩子，心思像孩子，想法像孩子，既然长大了，就把孩子的事都丢弃了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我作孩子的时候，说话像孩子，心思像孩子，想法像孩子，既然长大了，就把孩子的事都丢弃了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我作孩子的时候，话语像孩子，心思像孩子，意念像孩子，既成了人，就把孩子的事丢弃了。
verses.textEnNiv: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I put the ways of childhood behind me.
verses.textEnEsv: When I was a child, I spoke like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I gave up childish ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child; but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
verses.textEnNlt: When I was a child, I spoke and thought and reasoned as a child. But when I grew up, I put away childish things.
verses.textEnNasb: When I was a child, I used to speak like a child, think like a child, reason like a child; when I became a man, I did away with childish things.
verses.textEn: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I put the ways of childhood behind me.

verses.textZh: 我们现在是对着镜子观看，模糊不清，到那时就要面对面了。我现在所知道的只是一部分，到那时就完全知道了，好象主完全知道我一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们现在是对着镜子观看，模糊不清，到那时就要面对面了。我现在所知道的只是一部分，到那时就完全知道了，好象主完全知道我一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们如今仿佛对着镜子观看，模糊不清 ，到那时就要面对面了。我如今所知道的有限，到那时就全知道，如同主知道我一样。
verses.textEnNiv: For now we see only a reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.
verses.textEnEsv: For now we see in a mirror dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I have been fully known.
verses.textEnNkjv: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I shall know just as I also am known.
verses.textEnNlt: Now we see things imperfectly, like puzzling reflections in a mirror, but then we will see everything with perfect clarity. All that I know now is partial and incomplete, but then I will know everything completely, just as God now knows me completely.
verses.textEnNasb: For now we see in a mirror dimly, but then face to face; now I know in part, but then I will know fully, just as I also have been fully known.
verses.textEn: For now we see only a reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.

verses.textZh: 现在常存的有信、望、爱这三样，其中最大的是爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在常存的有信、望、爱这三样，其中最大的是爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 如今常存的有信，有望，有爱这三样，其中最大的是爱。
verses.textEnNiv: And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.
verses.textEnEsv: So now faith, hope, and love abide, these three; but the greatest of these is love.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now abide faith, hope, love, these three; but the greatest of these is love.
verses.textEnNlt: Three things will last forever—faith, hope, and love—and the greatest of these is love.
verses.textEnNasb: But now faith, hope, and love remain, these three; but the greatest of these is love.
verses.textEn: And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.

verses.textZh: 你们要追求爱，也要热切地渴慕属灵的恩赐，特别是先知讲道的恩赐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要追求爱，也要热切地渴慕属灵的恩赐，特别是先知讲道的恩赐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要追求爱，也要切慕属灵的恩赐，其中更要羡慕的，是作先知讲道 。
verses.textEnNiv: Follow the way of love and eagerly desire gifts of the Spirit, especially prophecy.
verses.textEnEsv: Pursue love, and earnestly desire the spiritual gifts, especially that you may prophesy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pursue love, and desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.
verses.textEnNlt: Let love be your highest goal! But you should also desire the special abilities the Spirit gives—especially the ability to prophesy.
verses.textEnNasb: Pursue love, yet earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.
verses.textEn: Follow the way of love and eagerly desire gifts of the Spirit, especially prophecy.

verses.textZh: 原来那说方言的不是对人说，而是对神说，因为没有人能听得懂；他是在灵里讲奥秘的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来那说方言的不是对人说，而是对神说，因为没有人能听得懂；他是在灵里讲奥秘的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 那说方言的，原不是对人说，乃是对神说，因为没有人听出来。然而，他在心灵里却是讲说各样的奥秘。
verses.textEnNiv: For anyone who speaks in a tongue does not speak to people but to God. Indeed, no one understands them; they utter mysteries by the Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: For one who speaks in a tongue speaks not to men but to God; for no one understands him, but he utters mysteries in the Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he who speaks in a tongue does not speak to men but to God, for no one understands him; however, in the spirit he speaks mysteries.
verses.textEnNlt: For if you have the ability to speak in tongues, you will be talking only to God, since people won’t be able to understand you. You will be speaking by the power of the Spirit, but it will all be mysterious.
verses.textEnNasb: For the one who speaks in a tongue does not speak to people, but to God; for no one understands, but in his spirit he speaks mysteries.
verses.textEn: For anyone who speaks in a tongue does not speak to people but to God. Indeed, no one understands them; they utter mysteries by the Spirit.

verses.textZh: 但那讲道的是对人讲说，使他们得着造就、安慰和劝勉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那讲道的是对人讲说，使他们得着造就、安慰和劝勉。
verses.textZhCuv: 但作先知讲道的，是对人说，要造就、安慰、劝勉人。
verses.textEnNiv: But the one who prophesies speaks to people for their strengthening, encouraging and comfort.
verses.textEnEsv: On the other hand, the one who prophesies speaks to people for their upbuilding and encouragement and consolation.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who prophesies speaks edification and exhortation and comfort to men.
verses.textEnNlt: But one who prophesies strengthens others, encourages them, and comforts them.
verses.textEnNasb: But the one who prophesies speaks to people for edification, exhortation, and consolation.
verses.textEn: But the one who prophesies speaks to people for their strengthening, encouraging and comfort.

verses.textZh: 那说方言的是造就自己，但那讲道的是造就教会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那说方言的是造就自己，但那讲道的是造就教会。
verses.textZhCuv: 说方言的，是造就自己；作先知讲道的，乃是造就教会。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who speaks in a tongue edifies themselves, but the one who prophesies edifies the church.
verses.textEnEsv: The one who speaks in a tongue builds up himself, but the one who prophesies builds up the church.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the church.
verses.textEnNlt: A person who speaks in tongues is strengthened personally, but one who speaks a word of prophecy strengthens the entire church.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who speaks in a tongue edifies himself; but the one who prophesies edifies the church.
verses.textEn: Anyone who speaks in a tongue edifies themselves, but the one who prophesies edifies the church.

verses.textZh: 我愿意你们都说方言，但我更愿意你们都讲道；因为那说方言的，如果不翻译出来使教会得着造就，就远不如那讲道的了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我愿意你们都说方言，但我更愿意你们都讲道；因为那说方言的，如果不翻译出来使教会得着造就，就远不如那讲道的了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我愿意你们都说方言，更愿意你们作先知讲道；因为说方言的，若不翻出来，使教会被造就，那作先知讲道的，就比他强了。
verses.textEnNiv: I would like every one of you to speak in tongues, but I would rather have you prophesy. The one who prophesies is greater than the one who speaks in tongues, unless someone interprets, so that the church may be edified.
verses.textEnEsv: Now I want you all to speak in tongues, but even more to prophesy. The one who prophesies is greater than the one who speaks in tongues, unless someone interprets, so that the church may be built up.
verses.textEnNkjv: I wish you all spoke with tongues, but even more that you prophesied; for he who prophesies is greater than he who speaks with tongues, unless indeed he interprets, that the church may receive edification.
verses.textEnNlt: I wish you could all speak in tongues, but even more I wish you could all prophesy. For prophecy is greater than speaking in tongues, unless someone interprets what you are saying so that the whole church will be strengthened.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I wish that you all spoke in tongues, but rather that you would prophesy; and greater is the one who prophesies than the one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets, so that the church may receive edification.
verses.textEn: I would like every one of you to speak in tongues, but I would rather have you prophesy. The one who prophesies is greater than the one who speaks in tongues, unless someone interprets, so that the church may be edified.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，你们想想，如果我到你们那里去，只说方言，不向你们讲有关启示、知识、预言，或教训的话，那我对你们有甚么益处呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，你们想想，如果我到你们那里去，只说方言，不向你们讲有关启示、知识、预言，或教训的话，那我对你们有甚么益处呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我到你们那里去，若只说方言，不用启示，或知识，或预言，或教训，给你们讲解，我与你们有什么益处呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Now, brothers and sisters, if I come to you and speak in tongues, what good will I be to you, unless I bring you some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or word of instruction?
verses.textEnEsv: Now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you unless I bring you some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
verses.textEnNkjv: But now, brethren, if I come to you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you unless I speak to you either by revelation, by knowledge, by prophesying, or by teaching?
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, if I should come to you speaking in an unknown language, how would that help you? But if I bring you a revelation or some special knowledge or prophecy or teaching, that will be helpful.
verses.textEnNasb: But now, brothers and sisters, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophecy, or of teaching?
verses.textEn: Now, brothers and sisters, if I come to you and speak in tongues, what good will I be to you, unless I bring you some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or word of instruction?

verses.textZh: 甚至那些没有生命却能发声的东西，例如箫或琴，如果音调不分，怎能使人知道所弹所奏的是甚么呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 甚至那些没有生命却能发声的东西，例如箫或琴，如果音调不分，怎能使人知道所弹所奏的是甚么呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 就是那有声无气的物，或箫，或琴，若发出来的声音没有分别，怎能知道所吹所弹的是什么呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Even in the case of lifeless things that make sounds, such as the pipe or harp, how will anyone know what tune is being played unless there is a distinction in the notes?
verses.textEnEsv: If even lifeless instruments, such as the flute or the harp, do not give distinct notes, how will anyone know what is played?
verses.textEnNkjv: Even things without life, whether flute or harp, when they make a sound, unless they make a distinction in the sounds, how will it be known what is piped or played?
verses.textEnNlt: Even lifeless instruments like the flute or the harp must play the notes clearly, or no one will recognize the melody.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet even lifeless instruments, whether flute or harp, in producing a sound, if they do not produce a distinction in the tones, how will it be known what is played on the flute or on the harp?
verses.textEn: Even in the case of lifeless things that make sounds, such as the pipe or harp, how will anyone know what tune is being played unless there is a distinction in the notes?

verses.textZh: 又如果军号所发的声音不清楚，谁会准备作战呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 又如果军号所发的声音不清楚，谁会准备作战呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 若吹无定的号声，谁能预备打仗呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Again, if the trumpet does not sound a clear call, who will get ready for battle?
verses.textEnEsv: And if the bugle gives an indistinct sound, who will get ready for battle?
verses.textEnNkjv: For if the trumpet makes an uncertain sound, who will prepare for battle?
verses.textEnNlt: And if the bugler doesn’t sound a clear call, how will the soldiers know they are being called to battle?
verses.textEnNasb: For if the trumpet produces an indistinct sound, who will prepare himself for battle?
verses.textEn: Again, if the trumpet does not sound a clear call, who will get ready for battle?

verses.textZh: 你们也是这样，如果用舌头发出人听不懂的话来，人怎会知道你所讲的是甚么呢？这样，你们就是向空气说话了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也是这样，如果用舌头发出人听不懂的话来，人怎会知道你所讲的是甚么呢？这样，你们就是向空气说话了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们也是如此。舌头若不说容易明白的话，怎能知道所说的是什么呢？这就是向空说话了。
verses.textEnNiv: So it is with you. Unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.
verses.textEnEsv: So with yourselves, if with your tongue you utter speech that is not intelligible, how will anyone know what is said? For you will be speaking into the air.
verses.textEnNkjv: So likewise you, unless you utter by the tongue words easy to understand, how will it be known what is spoken? For you will be speaking into the air.
verses.textEnNlt: It’s the same for you. If you speak to people in words they don’t understand, how will they know what you are saying? You might as well be talking into empty space.
verses.textEnNasb: So you too, unless you produce intelligible speech by the tongue, how will it be known what is spoken? For you will just be talking to the air.
verses.textEn: So it is with you. Unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.

verses.textZh: 世上有那么多种语言，但没有一种是没有意义的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 世上有那么多种语言，但没有一种是没有意义的。
verses.textZhCuv: 世上的声音，或者甚多，却没有一样是无意思的。
verses.textEnNiv: Undoubtedly there are all sorts of languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.
verses.textEnEsv: There are doubtless many different languages in the world, and none is without meaning,
verses.textEnNkjv: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without significance.
verses.textEnNlt: There are many different languages in the world, and every language has meaning.
verses.textEnNasb: There are, perhaps, a great many kinds of languages in the world, and none is incapable of meaning.
verses.textEn: Undoubtedly there are all sorts of languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.

verses.textZh: 我若不明白某一种语言的意思，在那讲的人来看，我就是个外国人；在我来说，那讲话的人也是个外国人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若不明白某一种语言的意思，在那讲的人来看，我就是个外国人；在我来说，那讲话的人也是个外国人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若不明白那声音的意思，这说话的人必以我为化外之人，我也以他为化外之人。
verses.textEnNiv: If then I do not grasp the meaning of what someone is saying, I am a foreigner to the speaker, and the speaker is a foreigner to me.
verses.textEnEsv: but if I do not know the meaning of the language, I will be a foreigner to the speaker and the speaker a foreigner to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, if I do not know the meaning of the language, I shall be a foreigner to him who speaks, and he who speaks willbe a foreigner to me.
verses.textEnNlt: But if I don’t understand a language, I will be a foreigner to someone who speaks it, and the one who speaks it will be a foreigner to me.
verses.textEnNasb: So if I do not know the meaning of the language, I will be unintelligible to the one who speaks, and the one who speaks will be unintelligible to me.
verses.textEn: If then I do not grasp the meaning of what someone is saying, I am a foreigner to the speaker, and the speaker is a foreigner to me.

verses.textZh: 你们也是这样，你们既然热切地渴慕属灵的恩赐，就应当追求多多得着造就教会的恩赐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也是这样，你们既然热切地渴慕属灵的恩赐，就应当追求多多得着造就教会的恩赐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们也是如此，既是切慕属灵的恩赐，就当求多得造就教会的恩赐。
verses.textEnNiv: So it is with you. Since you are eager for gifts of the Spirit, try to excel in those that build up the church.
verses.textEnEsv: So with yourselves, since you are eager for manifestations of the Spirit, strive to excel in building up the church.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even so you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, let it be for the edification of the church that you seek to excel.
verses.textEnNlt: And the same is true for you. Since you are so eager to have the special abilities the Spirit gives, seek those that will strengthen the whole church.
verses.textEnNasb: So you too, since you are eager to possess spiritual gifts, strive to excel for the edification of the church.
verses.textEn: So it is with you. Since you are eager for gifts of the Spirit, try to excel in those that build up the church.

verses.textZh: 所以，说方言的应当祈求，使他能把方言翻译出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，说方言的应当祈求，使他能把方言翻译出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以那说方言的，就当求着能翻出来。
verses.textEnNiv: For this reason the one who speaks in a tongue should pray that they may interpret what they say.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, one who speaks in a tongue should pray that he may interpret.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore let him who speaks in a tongue pray that he may interpret.
verses.textEnNlt: So anyone who speaks in tongues should pray also for the ability to interpret what has been said.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, one who speaks in a tongue is to pray that he may interpret.
verses.textEn: For this reason the one who speaks in a tongue should pray that they may interpret what they say.

verses.textZh: 我若用方言祷告，是我的灵在祷告，我的理智并没有作用。
