verses.textZhCnvs: 我若用方言祷告，是我的灵在祷告，我的理智并没有作用。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若用方言祷告，是我的灵祷告，但我的悟性没有果效。
verses.textEnNiv: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.
verses.textEnEsv: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays but my mind is unfruitful.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.
verses.textEnNlt: For if I pray in tongues, my spirit is praying, but I don’t understand what I am saying.
verses.textEnNasb: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unproductive.
verses.textEn: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.

verses.textZh: 那么我应当怎样行呢？我要用灵祷告，也要用理智祷告；我要用灵歌唱，也要用理智歌唱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么我应当怎样行呢？我要用灵祷告，也要用理智祷告；我要用灵歌唱，也要用理智歌唱。
verses.textZhCuv: 这却怎么样呢？我要用灵祷告，也要用悟性祷告；我要用灵歌唱，也要用悟性歌唱。
verses.textEnNiv: So what shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my understanding; I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: What am I to do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will pray with my mind also; I will sing praise with my spirit, but I will sing with my mind also.
verses.textEnNkjv: What is theconclusion then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will also pray with the understanding. I will sing with the spirit, and I will also sing with the understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: Well then, what shall I do? I will pray in the spirit, and I will also pray in words I understand. I will sing in the spirit, and I will also sing in words I understand.
verses.textEnNasb: What is the outcome then? I will pray with the spirit, but I will pray with the mind also; I will sing with the spirit, but I will sing with the mind also.
verses.textEn: So what shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my understanding; I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my understanding.

verses.textZh: 不然，如果你用灵赞美，在场那些不明白的人，因为不知道你在说甚么，怎能在你感谢的时候说"阿们"呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 不然，如果你用灵赞美，在场那些不明白的人，因为不知道你在说甚么，怎能在你感谢的时候说"阿们"呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 不然，你用灵祝谢，那在座不通方言的人，既然不明白你的话，怎能在你感谢的时候说「阿们」呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Otherwise when you are praising God in the Spirit, how can someone else, who is now put in the position of an inquirer, say "Amen" to your thanksgiving, since they do not know what you are saying?
verses.textEnEsv: Otherwise, if you give thanks with your spirit, how can anyone in the position of an outsider say "Amen" to your thanksgiving when he does not know what you are saying?
verses.textEnNkjv: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who occupies the place of the uninformed say "Amen" at your giving of thanks, since he does not understand what you say?
verses.textEnNlt: For if you praise God only in the spirit, how can those who don’t understand you praise God along with you? How can they join you in giving thanks when they don’t understand what you are saying?
verses.textEnNasb: For otherwise, if you bless God in the spirit only, how will the one who occupies the place of the outsider know to say the "Amen" at your giving of thanks, since he does not understand what you are saying?
verses.textEn: Otherwise when you are praising God in the Spirit, how can someone else, who is now put in the position of an inquirer, say "Amen" to your thanksgiving, since they do not know what you are saying?

verses.textZh: 你感谢固然是好，但别人却得不着造就。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你感谢固然是好，但别人却得不着造就。
verses.textZhCuv: 你感谢的固然是好，无奈不能造就别人。
verses.textEnNiv: You are giving thanks well enough, but no one else is edified.
verses.textEnEsv: For you may be giving thanks well enough, but the other person is not being built up.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you indeed give thanks well, but the other is not edified.
verses.textEnNlt: You will be giving thanks very well, but it won’t strengthen the people who hear you.
verses.textEnNasb: For you are giving thanks well enough, but the other person is not edified.
verses.textEn: You are giving thanks well enough, but no one else is edified.

verses.textZh: 我感谢神，我说方言比你们大家都多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我感谢神，我说方言比你们大家都多。
verses.textZhCuv: 我感谢神，我说方言比你们众人还多。
verses.textEnNiv: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.
verses.textEnEsv: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I thank my God I speak with tongues more than you all;
verses.textEnNlt: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than any of you.
verses.textEnNasb: I thank God, I speak in tongues more than you all;
verses.textEn: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.

verses.textZh: 但在教会中，我宁愿用理智说五句话去教导人，胜过用方言说万句话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但在教会中，我宁愿用理智说五句话去教导人，胜过用方言说万句话。
verses.textZhCuv: 但在教会中，宁可用悟性说五句教导人的话，强如说万句方言。
verses.textEnNiv: But in the church I would rather speak five intelligible words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, in church I would rather speak five words with my mind in order to instruct others, than ten thousand words in a tongue.
verses.textEnNkjv: yet in the church I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I may teach others also, than ten thousand words in a tongue.
verses.textEnNlt: But in a church meeting I would rather speak five understandable words to help others than ten thousand words in an unknown language.
verses.textEnNasb: nevertheless, in church I prefer to speak five words with my mind so that I may instruct others also, rather than ten thousand words in a tongue.
verses.textEn: But in the church I would rather speak five intelligible words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，你们在思想上不要作小孩子，却要在恶事上作婴孩，在思想上作成年人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，你们在思想上不要作小孩子，却要在恶事上作婴孩，在思想上作成年人。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，在心志上不要作小孩子。然而，在恶事上要作婴孩，在心志上总要作大人。
verses.textEnNiv: Brothers and sisters, stop thinking like children. In regard to evil be infants, but in your thinking be adults.
verses.textEnEsv: Brothers, do not be children in your thinking. Be infants in evil, but in your thinking be mature.
verses.textEnNkjv: Brethren, do not be children in understanding; however, in malice be babes, but in understanding be mature.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, don’t be childish in your understanding of these things. Be innocent as babies when it comes to evil, but be mature in understanding matters of this kind.
verses.textEnNasb: Brothers and sisters, do not be children in your thinking; yet in evil be infants, but in your thinking be mature.
verses.textEn: Brothers and sisters, stop thinking like children. In regard to evil be infants, but in your thinking be adults.

verses.textZh: 律法上记着说："主说： 我要借着说别种话的人， 用外国人的嘴唇， 对这人民说话； 虽然这样，他们还是不听我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 律法上记着说："主说： 我要借着说别种话的人， 用外国人的嘴唇， 对这人民说话； 虽然这样，他们还是不听我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 律法上记着： 主说：我要用外邦人的舌头 和外邦人的嘴唇向这百姓说话； 虽然如此， 他们还是不听从我。
verses.textEnNiv: In the Law it is written: "With other tongues and through the lips of foreigners I will speak to this people, but even then they will not listen to me, says the Lord."
verses.textEnEsv: In the Law it is written, "By people of strange tongues and by the lips of foreigners will I speak to this people, and even then they will not listen to me, says the Lord."
verses.textEnNkjv: In the law it is written: "With menof other tongues and other lips I will speak to this people; And yet, for all that, they will not hear Me," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: It is written in the Scriptures : "I will speak to my own people through strange languages and through the lips of foreigners. But even then, they will not listen to me," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: In the Law it is written: "By men of strange tongues and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people, and even so they will not listen to Me," says the Lord.
verses.textEn: In the Law it is written: "With other tongues and through the lips of foreigners I will speak to this people, but even then they will not listen to me, says the Lord."

verses.textZh: 可见说方言不是要给信主的人作记号，而是要给未信的人；讲道不是要给未信的人，而是要给信主的人作记号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可见说方言不是要给信主的人作记号，而是要给未信的人；讲道不是要给未信的人，而是要给信主的人作记号。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样看来，说方言不是为信的人作证据，乃是为不信的人；作先知讲道不是为不信的人作证据，乃是为信的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers but for unbelievers; prophecy, however, is not for unbelievers but for believers.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus tongues are a sign not for believers but for unbelievers, while prophecy is a sign not for unbelievers but for believers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore tongues are for a sign, not to those who believe but to unbelievers; but prophesying is not for unbelievers but for those who believe.
verses.textEnNlt: So you see that speaking in tongues is a sign, not for believers, but for unbelievers. Prophecy, however, is for the benefit of believers, not unbelievers.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, tongues are for a sign, not to those who believe but to unbelievers; but prophecy is not for unbelievers, but for those who believe.
verses.textEn: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers but for unbelievers; prophecy, however, is not for unbelievers but for believers.

verses.textZh: 所以，如果全教会聚在一起的时候，大家都说方言，有不明白的人或未信的人进来，不是要说你们疯了吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，如果全教会聚在一起的时候，大家都说方言，有不明白的人或未信的人进来，不是要说你们疯了吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，全教会聚在一处的时候，若都说方言，偶然有不通方言的，或是不信的人进来，岂不说你们癫狂了吗？
verses.textEnNiv: So if the whole church comes together and everyone speaks in tongues, and inquirers or unbelievers come in, will they not say that you are out of your mind?
verses.textEnEsv: If, therefore, the whole church comes together and all speak in tongues, and outsiders or unbelievers enter, will they not say that you are out of your minds?
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore if the whole church comes together in one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in thosewhoare uninformed or unbelievers, will they not say that you are out of your mind?
verses.textEnNlt: Even so, if unbelievers or people who don’t understand these things come into your church meeting and hear everyone speaking in an unknown language, they will think you are crazy.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore if the whole church gathers together and all the people speak in tongues, and outsiders or unbelievers enter, will they not say that you are insane?
verses.textEn: So if the whole church comes together and everyone speaks in tongues, and inquirers or unbelievers come in, will they not say that you are out of your mind?

verses.textZh: 如果大家都讲道，有未信的人或不明白的人进来，他就会被众人劝服而知罪，被众人审问了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果大家都讲道，有未信的人或不明白的人进来，他就会被众人劝服而知罪，被众人审问了。
verses.textZhCuv: 若都作先知讲道，偶然有不信的，或是不通方言的人进来，就被众人劝醒，被众人审明，
verses.textEnNiv: But if an unbeliever or an inquirer comes in while everyone is prophesying, they are convicted of sin and are brought under judgment by all,
verses.textEnEsv: But if all prophesy, and an unbeliever or outsider enters, he is convicted by all, he is called to account by all,
verses.textEnNkjv: But if all prophesy, and an unbeliever or an uninformed person comes in, he is convinced by all, he is convicted by all.
verses.textEnNlt: But if all of you are prophesying, and unbelievers or people who don’t understand these things come into your meeting, they will be convicted of sin and judged by what you say.
verses.textEnNasb: But if all prophesy, and an unbeliever or an outsider enters, he is convicted by all, he is called to account by all;
verses.textEn: But if an unbeliever or an inquirer comes in while everyone is prophesying, they are convicted of sin and are brought under judgment by all,

verses.textZh: 他心里隐秘的事被显露出来，他就必俯伏敬拜神，宣告说："神真的是在你们中间了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他心里隐秘的事被显露出来，他就必俯伏敬拜神，宣告说："神真的是在你们中间了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他心里的隐情显露出来，就必将脸伏地，敬拜神，说：「神真是在你们中间了。」
verses.textEnNiv: as the secrets of their hearts are laid bare. So they will fall down and worship God, exclaiming, "God is really among you!"
verses.textEnEsv: the secrets of his heart are disclosed, and so, falling on his face, he will worship God and declare that God is really among you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed; and so, falling down on his face, he will worship God and report that God is truly among you.
verses.textEnNlt: As they listen, their secret thoughts will be exposed, and they will fall to their knees and worship God, declaring, "God is truly here among you."
verses.textEnNasb: the secrets of his heart are disclosed; and so he will fall on his face and worship God, declaring that God is certainly among you.
verses.textEn: as the secrets of their hearts are laid bare. So they will fall down and worship God, exclaiming, "God is really among you!"

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，那么应该怎么办呢？你们聚集在一起的时候，各人或有诗歌，或有教训，或有启示，或有方言，或有翻译出来的话，一切都应该能造就人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，那么应该怎么办呢？你们聚集在一起的时候，各人或有诗歌，或有教训，或有启示，或有方言，或有翻译出来的话，一切都应该能造就人。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，这却怎么样呢？你们聚会的时候，各人或有诗歌，或有教训，或有启示，或有方言，或有翻出来的话，凡事都当造就人。
verses.textEnNiv: What then shall we say, brothers and sisters? When you come together, each of you has a hymn, or a word of instruction, a revelation, a tongue or an interpretation. Everything must be done so that the church may be built up.
verses.textEnEsv: What then, brothers? When you come together, each one has a hymn, a lesson, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. Let all things be done for building up.
verses.textEnNkjv: How is it then, brethren? Whenever you come together, each of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a tongue, has a revelation, has an interpretation. Let all things be done for edification.
verses.textEnNlt: Well, my brothers and sisters, let’s summarize. When you meet together, one will sing, another will teach, another will tell some special revelation God has given, one will speak in tongues, and another will interpret what is said. But everything that is done must strengthen all of you.
verses.textEnNasb: What is the outcome then, brothers and sisters? When you assemble, each one has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has a tongue, has an interpretation. All things are to be done for edification.
verses.textEn: What then shall we say, brothers and sisters? When you come together, each of you has a hymn, or a word of instruction, a revelation, a tongue or an interpretation. Everything must be done so that the church may be built up.

verses.textZh: 如果有人说方言，只可以有两个人，或最多三个人，并且要轮流说，同时要有一个人翻译。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人说方言，只可以有两个人，或最多三个人，并且要轮流说，同时要有一个人翻译。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有说方言的，只好两个人，至多三个人，且要轮流着说，也要一个人翻出来。
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone speaks in a tongue, two—or at the most three—should speak, one at a time, and someone must interpret.
verses.textEnEsv: If any speak in a tongue, let there be only two or at most three, and each in turn, and let someone interpret.
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone speaks in a tongue, lettherebe two or at the most three, each in turn, and let one interpret.
verses.textEnNlt: No more than two or three should speak in tongues. They must speak one at a time, and someone must interpret what they say.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone speaks in a tongue, it must be by two or at the most three, and each one in turn, and one is to interpret;
verses.textEn: If anyone speaks in a tongue, two—or at the most three—should speak, one at a time, and someone must interpret.

verses.textZh: 如果没有人翻译，他就应当在会中闭口，只对自己和对神说好了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果没有人翻译，他就应当在会中闭口，只对自己和对神说好了。
verses.textZhCuv: 若没有人翻，就当在会中闭口，只对自己和神说就是了。
verses.textEnNiv: If there is no interpreter, the speaker should keep quiet in the church and speak to himself and to God.
verses.textEnEsv: But if there is no one to interpret, let each of them keep silent in church and speak to himself and to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in church, and let him speak to himself and to God.
verses.textEnNlt: But if no one is present who can interpret, they must be silent in your church meeting and speak in tongues to God privately.
verses.textEnNasb: but if there is no interpreter, he is to keep silent in church; and have him speak to himself and to God.
verses.textEn: If there is no interpreter, the speaker should keep quiet in the church and speak to himself and to God.

verses.textZh: 讲道的，也只可以两三个人讲，其余的人要衡量他们所讲的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 讲道的，也只可以两三个人讲，其余的人要衡量他们所讲的。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于作先知讲道的，只好两个人或是三个人，其余的就当慎思明辨。
verses.textEnNiv: Two or three prophets should speak, and the others should weigh carefully what is said.
verses.textEnEsv: Let two or three prophets speak, and let the others weigh what is said.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let two or three prophets speak, and let the others judge.
verses.textEnNlt: Let two or three people prophesy, and let the others evaluate what is said.
verses.textEnNasb: Have two or three prophets speak, and have the others pass judgment.
verses.textEn: Two or three prophets should speak, and the others should weigh carefully what is said.

verses.textZh: 在座的有人得了启示，那先讲的人就应当住口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在座的有人得了启示，那先讲的人就应当住口。
verses.textZhCuv: 若旁边坐着的得了启示，那先说话的就当闭口不言。
verses.textEnNiv: And if a revelation comes to someone who is sitting down, the first speaker should stop.
verses.textEnEsv: If a revelation is made to another sitting there, let the first be silent.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if anything is revealed to another who sits by, let the first keep silent.
verses.textEnNlt: But if someone is prophesying and another person receives a revelation from the Lord, the one who is speaking must stop.
verses.textEnNasb: But if a revelation is made to another who is seated, then the first one is to keep silent.
verses.textEn: And if a revelation comes to someone who is sitting down, the first speaker should stop.

verses.textZh: 因为你们都可以轮流讲道，好让大家都可以学习，都可以得到勉励。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们都可以轮流讲道，好让大家都可以学习，都可以得到勉励。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你们都可以一个一个地作先知讲道，叫众人学道理，叫众人得劝勉。
verses.textEnNiv: For you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged.
verses.textEnEsv: For you can all prophesy one by one, so that all may learn and all be encouraged,
verses.textEnNkjv: For you can all prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be encouraged.
verses.textEnNlt: In this way, all who prophesy will have a turn to speak, one after the other, so that everyone will learn and be encouraged.
verses.textEnNasb: For you can all prophesy one by one, so that all may learn and all may be exhorted;
verses.textEn: For you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged.

verses.textZh: 先知的灵是受先知控制的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 先知的灵是受先知控制的，
verses.textZhCuv: 先知的灵原是顺服先知的；
verses.textEnNiv: The spirits of prophets are subject to the control of prophets.
verses.textEnEsv: and the spirits of prophets are subject to prophets.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember that people who prophesy are in control of their spirit and can take turns.
verses.textEnNasb: and the spirits of prophets are subject to prophets;
verses.textEn: The spirits of prophets are subject to the control of prophets.

verses.textZh: 因为神不是混乱的，而是和平的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神不是混乱的，而是和平的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神不是叫人混乱，乃是叫人安静。
verses.textEnNiv: For God is not a God of disorder but of peace—as in all the congregations of the Lord’s people.
verses.textEnEsv: For God is not a God of confusion but of peace. As in all the churches of the saints,
verses.textEnNkjv: For God is not theauthor of confusion but of peace, as in all the churches of the saints.
verses.textEnNlt: For God is not a God of disorder but of peace, as in all the meetings of God’s holy people.
verses.textEnNasb: for God is not a God of confusion, but of peace. As in all the churches of the saints,
verses.textEn: For God is not a God of disorder but of peace—as in all the congregations of the Lord’s people.

verses.textZh: 妇女在聚会中应当闭口，好象在圣徒的众教会中一样，因为她们是不准讲话的；就如律法所说的，她们应该顺服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇女在聚会中应当闭口，好象在圣徒的众教会中一样，因为她们是不准讲话的；就如律法所说的，她们应该顺服。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇女在会中要闭口不言，像在圣徒的众教会一样，因为不准她们说话。她们总要顺服，正如律法所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Women should remain silent in the churches. They are not allowed to speak, but must be in submission, as the law says.
verses.textEnEsv: the women should keep silent in the churches. For they are not permitted to speak, but should be in submission, as the Law also says.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let your women keep silent in the churches, for they are not permitted to speak; but theyare to be submissive, as the law also says.
verses.textEnNlt: Women should be silent during the church meetings. It is not proper for them to speak. They should be submissive, just as the law says.
verses.textEnNasb: the women are to keep silent in the churches; for they are not permitted to speak, but are to subject themselves, just as the Law also says.
verses.textEn: Women should remain silent in the churches. They are not allowed to speak, but must be in submission, as the law says.

verses.textZh: 如果她们想要学甚么，可以在家里问自己的丈夫，因为妇女在聚会中讲话原是可耻的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果她们想要学甚么，可以在家里问自己的丈夫，因为妇女在聚会中讲话原是可耻的。
verses.textZhCuv: 她们若要学什么，可以在家里问自己的丈夫，因为妇女在会中说话原是可耻的。
verses.textEnNiv: If they want to inquire about something, they should ask their own husbands at home; for it is disgraceful for a woman to speak in the church.
verses.textEnEsv: If there is anything they desire to learn, let them ask their husbands at home. For it is shameful for a woman to speak in church.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if they want to learn something, let them ask their own husbands at home; for it is shameful for women to speak in church.
verses.textEnNlt: If they have any questions, they should ask their husbands at home, for it is improper for women to speak in church meetings.
verses.textEnNasb: If they desire to learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home; for it is improper for a woman to speak in church.
verses.textEn: If they want to inquire about something, they should ask their own husbands at home; for it is disgraceful for a woman to speak in the church.

verses.textZh: 难道神的道是从你们出来的吗？是单单临到你们的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道神的道是从你们出来的吗？是单单临到你们的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 神的道理岂是从你们出来吗？岂是单临到你们吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Or did the word of God originate with you? Or are you the only people it has reached?
verses.textEnEsv: Or was it from you that the word of God came? Or are you the only ones it has reached?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or did the word of God come originally from you? Or wasit you only that it reached?
verses.textEnNlt: Or do you think God’s word originated with you Corinthians? Are you the only ones to whom it was given?
verses.textEnNasb: Or was it from you that the word of God first went out? Or has it come to you only?
verses.textEn: Or did the word of God originate with you? Or are you the only people it has reached?

verses.textZh: 如果有人自以为是先知或是属灵的，他就应该知道我写给你们的是主的命令；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人自以为是先知或是属灵的，他就应该知道我写给你们的是主的命令；
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人以为自己是先知，或是属灵的，就该知道，我所写给你们的是主的命令。
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone thinks they are a prophet or otherwise gifted by the Spirit, let them acknowledge that what I am writing to you is the Lord’s command.
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone thinks that he is a prophet, or spiritual, he should acknowledge that the things I am writing to you are a command of the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things which I write to you are the commandments of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: If you claim to be a prophet or think you are spiritual, you should recognize that what I am saying is a command from the Lord himself.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone thinks that he is a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize that the things which I write to you are the Lord’s commandment.
verses.textEn: If anyone thinks they are a prophet or otherwise gifted by the Spirit, let them acknowledge that what I am writing to you is the Lord’s command.

verses.textZh: 如果有人不理会，别人也不必理会他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人不理会，别人也不必理会他。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有不知道的，就由他不知道吧！
verses.textEnNiv: But if anyone ignores this, they will themselves be ignored.
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone does not recognize this, he is not recognized.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you do not recognize this, you yourself will not be recognized.
verses.textEnNasb: But if anyone does not recognize this, he is not recognized.
verses.textEn: But if anyone ignores this, they will themselves be ignored.

verses.textZh: 所以我的弟兄们，你们要热切地追求讲道的恩赐，也不要禁止说方言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我的弟兄们，你们要热切地追求讲道的恩赐，也不要禁止说方言。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我弟兄们，你们要切慕作先知讲道，也不要禁止说方言。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.
verses.textEnEsv: So, my brothers, earnestly desire to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, brethren, desire earnestly to prophesy, and do not forbid to speak with tongues.
verses.textEnNlt: So, my dear brothers and sisters, be eager to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking in tongues.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, earnestly desire to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.
verses.textEn: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.

verses.textZh: 凡事都要规规矩矩地按着次序行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡事都要规规矩矩地按着次序行。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡事都要规规矩矩地按着次序行。
verses.textEnNiv: But everything should be done in a fitting and orderly way.
verses.textEnEsv: But all things should be done decently and in order.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let all things be done decently and in order.
verses.textEnNlt: But be sure that everything is done properly and in order.
verses.textEnNasb: But all things must be done properly and in an orderly way.
verses.textEn: But everything should be done in a fitting and orderly way.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我要把我从前传给你们的福音向你们讲明。这福音你们已经领受了，并且靠着它站立得稳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我要把我从前传给你们的福音向你们讲明。这福音你们已经领受了，并且靠着它站立得稳。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我如今把先前所传给你们的福音告诉你们知道；这福音你们也领受了，又靠着站立得住，
verses.textEnNiv: Now, brothers and sisters, I want to remind you of the gospel I preached to you, which you received and on which you have taken your stand.
verses.textEnEsv: Now I would remind you, brothers, of the gospel I preached to you, which you received, in which you stand,
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover, brethren, I declare to you the gospel which I preached to you, which also you received and in which you stand,
verses.textEnNlt: Let me now remind you, dear brothers and sisters, of the Good News I preached to you before. You welcomed it then, and you still stand firm in it.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I make known to you, brothers and sisters, the gospel which I preached to you, which you also received, in which you also stand,
verses.textEn: Now, brothers and sisters, I want to remind you of the gospel I preached to you, which you received and on which you have taken your stand.

verses.textZh: 你们若持守我所传给你们的道，就必靠这福音得救，不然就是徒然相信了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们若持守我所传给你们的道，就必靠这福音得救，不然就是徒然相信了。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且你们若不是徒然相信，能以持守我所传给你们的，就必因这福音得救。
verses.textEnNiv: By this gospel you are saved, if you hold firmly to the word I preached to you. Otherwise, you have believed in vain.
verses.textEnEsv: and by which you are being saved, if you hold fast to the word I preached to you— unless you believed in vain.
verses.textEnNkjv: by which also you are saved, if you hold fast that word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.
verses.textEnNlt: It is this Good News that saves you if you continue to believe the message I told you—unless, of course, you believed something that was never true in the first place.
verses.textEnNasb: by which you also are saved, if you hold firmly to the word which I preached to you, unless you believed in vain.
verses.textEn: By this gospel you are saved, if you hold firmly to the word I preached to you. Otherwise, you have believed in vain.

verses.textZh: 我从前领受了又传交给你们那最要紧的，就是基督照着圣经所记的，为我们的罪死了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从前领受了又传交给你们那最要紧的，就是基督照着圣经所记的，为我们的罪死了，
verses.textZhCuv: 我当日所领受又传给你们的：第一，就是基督照圣经所说，为我们的罪死了，
verses.textEnNiv: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance : that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
verses.textEnEsv: For I delivered to you as of first importance what I also received: that Christ died for our sins in accordance with the Scriptures,
verses.textEnNkjv: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
verses.textEnNlt: I passed on to you what was most important and what had also been passed on to me. Christ died for our sins, just as the Scriptures said.
verses.textEnNasb: For I handed down to you as of first importance what I also received, that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
verses.textEn: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance : that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

verses.textZh: 又埋葬了，又照着圣经所记的，第三天复活了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又埋葬了，又照着圣经所记的，第三天复活了；
verses.textZhCuv: 而且埋葬了；又照圣经所说，第三天复活了，
verses.textEnNiv: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
verses.textEnEsv: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day in accordance with the Scriptures,
verses.textEnNkjv: and that He was buried, and that He rose again the third day according to the Scriptures,
verses.textEnNlt: He was buried, and he was raised from the dead on the third day, just as the Scriptures said.
verses.textEnNasb: and that He was buried, and that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
verses.textEn: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

verses.textZh: 并且曾经向矶法显现，然后向十二使徒显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且曾经向矶法显现，然后向十二使徒显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且显给矶法看，然后显给十二使徒看；
verses.textEnNiv: and that he appeared to Cephas, and then to the Twelve.
verses.textEnEsv: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.
verses.textEnNkjv: and that He was seen by Cephas, then by the twelve.
verses.textEnNlt: He was seen by Peter and then by the Twelve.
verses.textEnNasb: and that He appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.
verses.textEn: and that he appeared to Cephas, and then to the Twelve.

verses.textZh: 以后又有一次向五百多个弟兄显现。他们中间大多数到现今还在，也有些已经睡了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以后又有一次向五百多个弟兄显现。他们中间大多数到现今还在，也有些已经睡了。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来一时显给五百多弟兄看，其中一大半到如今还在，却也有已经睡了的。
verses.textEnNiv: After that, he appeared to more than five hundred of the brothers and sisters at the same time, most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he appeared to more than five hundred brothers at one time, most of whom are still alive, though some have fallen asleep.
verses.textEnNkjv: After that He was seen by over five hundred brethren at once, of whom the greater part remain to the present, but some have fallen asleep.
verses.textEnNlt: After that, he was seen by more than 500 of his followers at one time, most of whom are still alive, though some have died.
verses.textEnNasb: After that He appeared to more than five hundred brothers and sisters at one time, most of whom remain until now, but some have fallen asleep;
verses.textEn: After that, he appeared to more than five hundred of the brothers and sisters at the same time, most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.

verses.textZh: 以后也向雅各显现，再后又向众使徒显现，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以后也向雅各显现，再后又向众使徒显现，
verses.textZhCuv: 以后显给雅各看，再显给众使徒看，
verses.textEnNiv: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,
verses.textEnEsv: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles.
verses.textEnNkjv: After that He was seen by James, then by all the apostles.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he was seen by James and later by all the apostles.
verses.textEnNasb: then He appeared to James, then to all the apostles;
verses.textEn: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

verses.textZh: 最后也向我显现；我好象一个未到产期而生的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 最后也向我显现；我好象一个未到产期而生的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 末了也显给我看；我如同未到产期而生的人一般。
verses.textEnNiv: and last of all he appeared to me also, as to one abnormally born.
verses.textEnEsv: Last of all, as to one untimely born, he appeared also to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then last of all He was seen by me also, as by one born out of due time.
verses.textEnNlt: Last of all, as though I had been born at the wrong time, I also saw him.
verses.textEnNasb: and last of all, as to one untimely born, He appeared to me also.
verses.textEn: and last of all he appeared to me also, as to one abnormally born.

verses.textZh: 我原是使徒中最小的，本来没有资格称为使徒，因为我曾经迫害神的教会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我原是使徒中最小的，本来没有资格称为使徒，因为我曾经迫害神的教会。
verses.textZhCuv: 我原是使徒中最小的，不配称为使徒，因为我从前逼迫神的教会。
verses.textEnNiv: For I am the least of the apostles and do not even deserve to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
verses.textEnEsv: For I am the least of the apostles, unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I am the least of the apostles, who am not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
verses.textEnNlt: For I am the least of all the apostles. In fact, I’m not even worthy to be called an apostle after the way I persecuted God’s church.
verses.textEnNasb: For I am the least of the apostles, and not fit to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
verses.textEn: For I am the least of the apostles and do not even deserve to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

verses.textZh: 然而靠着神的恩典，我得以有了今天，而且他赐给我的恩典并没有落空；我比众使徒格外劳苦，其实不是我，而是神的恩典与我同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而靠着神的恩典，我得以有了今天，而且他赐给我的恩典并没有落空；我比众使徒格外劳苦，其实不是我，而是神的恩典与我同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，我今日成了何等人，是蒙神的恩才成的，并且他所赐我的恩不是徒然的。我比众使徒格外劳苦；这原不是我，乃是神的恩与我同在。
verses.textEnNiv: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and his grace to me was not without effect. No, I worked harder than all of them—yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.
verses.textEnEsv: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and his grace toward me was not in vain. On the contrary, I worked harder than any of them, though it was not I, but the grace of God that is with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace toward me was not in vain; but I labored more abundantly than they all, yet not I, but the grace of God whichwas with me.
verses.textEnNlt: But whatever I am now, it is all because God poured out his special favor on me—and not without results. For I have worked harder than any of the other apostles; yet it was not I but God who was working through me by his grace.
verses.textEnNasb: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace toward me did not prove vain; but I labored even more than all of them, yet not I, but the grace of God with me.
verses.textEn: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and his grace to me was not without effect. No, I worked harder than all of them—yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.

verses.textZh: 因此，不论是我，或是众使徒，我们这样传，你们也这样信了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，不论是我，或是众使徒，我们这样传，你们也这样信了。
verses.textZhCuv: 不拘是我，是众使徒，我们如此传，你们也如此信了。
verses.textEnNiv: Whether, then, it is I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed.
verses.textEnEsv: Whether then it was I or they, so we preach and so you believed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, whether itwas I or they, so we preach and so you believed.
verses.textEnNlt: So it makes no difference whether I preach or they preach, for we all preach the same message you have already believed.
verses.textEnNasb: Whether then it was I or they, so we preach and so you believed.
verses.textEn: Whether, then, it is I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed.

verses.textZh: 我们既然传基督从死人中复活了，你们中间怎么有人说没有死人复活呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们既然传基督从死人中复活了，你们中间怎么有人说没有死人复活呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 既传基督是从死里复活了，怎么在你们中间有人说没有死人复活的事呢？
verses.textEnNiv: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
verses.textEnEsv: Now if Christ is proclaimed as raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now if Christ is preached that He has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
verses.textEnNlt: But tell me this—since we preach that Christ rose from the dead, why are some of you saying there will be no resurrection of the dead?
verses.textEnNasb: Now if Christ is preached, that He has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
verses.textEn: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

verses.textZh: 倘若没有死人复活的事，基督也就没有复活了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 倘若没有死人复活的事，基督也就没有复活了。
verses.textZhCuv: 若没有死人复活的事，基督也就没有复活了。
verses.textEnNiv: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.
verses.textEnEsv: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, then Christ is not risen.
verses.textEnNlt: For if there is no resurrection of the dead, then Christ has not been raised either.
verses.textEnNasb: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised;
verses.textEn: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.

verses.textZh: 如果基督没有复活，我们所传的就是枉然，你们的信也是枉然，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果基督没有复活，我们所传的就是枉然，你们的信也是枉然，
verses.textZhCuv: 若基督没有复活，我们所传的便是枉然，你们所信的也是枉然；
verses.textEnNiv: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is useless and so is your faith.
verses.textEnEsv: And if Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith is in vain.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if Christ is not risen, then our preaching is empty and your faith is also empty.
verses.textEnNlt: And if Christ has not been raised, then all our preaching is useless, and your faith is useless.
verses.textEnNasb: and if Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain, your faith also is in vain.
verses.textEn: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is useless and so is your faith.

verses.textZh: 我们也会被人认为是替神作假见证的了，因为我们为神作过见证说，他使基督复活了。如果死人没有复活，神也就没有使基督复活了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们也会被人认为是替神作假见证的了，因为我们为神作过见证说，他使基督复活了。如果死人没有复活，神也就没有使基督复活了。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且明显我们是为神妄作见证的，因我们见证神是叫基督复活了。若死人真不复活，神也就没有叫基督复活了。
verses.textEnNiv: More than that, we are then found to be false witnesses about God, for we have testified about God that he raised Christ from the dead. But he did not raise him if in fact the dead are not raised.
verses.textEnEsv: We are even found to be misrepresenting God, because we testified about God that he raised Christ, whom he did not raise if it is true that the dead are not raised.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, and we are found false witnesses of God, because we have testified of God that He raised up Christ, whom He did not raise up—if in fact the dead do not rise.
verses.textEnNlt: And we apostles would all be lying about God—for we have said that God raised Christ from the grave. But that can’t be true if there is no resurrection of the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, we are even found to be false witnesses of God, because we testified against God that He raised Christ, whom He did not raise, if in fact the dead are not raised.
verses.textEn: More than that, we are then found to be false witnesses about God, for we have testified about God that he raised Christ from the dead. But he did not raise him if in fact the dead are not raised.

verses.textZh: 因为如果死人没有复活，基督也就没有复活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为如果死人没有复活，基督也就没有复活。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为死人若不复活，基督也就没有复活了。
verses.textEnNiv: For if the dead are not raised, then Christ has not been raised either.
verses.textEnEsv: For if the dead are not raised, not even Christ has been raised.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if the dead do not rise, then Christ is not risen.
verses.textEnNlt: And if there is no resurrection of the dead, then Christ has not been raised.
verses.textEnNasb: For if the dead are not raised, then not even Christ has been raised;
verses.textEn: For if the dead are not raised, then Christ has not been raised either.

verses.textZh: 基督若没有复活，你们的信就是徒然，你们仍在你们的罪里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基督若没有复活，你们的信就是徒然，你们仍在你们的罪里。
verses.textZhCuv: 基督若没有复活，你们的信便是徒然，你们仍在罪里。
verses.textEnNiv: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.
verses.textEnEsv: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile and you are still in your sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if Christ is not risen, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins!
verses.textEnNlt: And if Christ has not been raised, then your faith is useless and you are still guilty of your sins.
verses.textEnNasb: and if Christ has not been raised, your faith is worthless; you are still in your sins.
verses.textEn: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.

verses.textZh: 那么，在基督里睡了的人也就灭亡了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，在基督里睡了的人也就灭亡了。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是在基督里睡了的人也灭亡了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ are lost.
verses.textEnEsv: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then also those who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
verses.textEnNlt: In that case, all who have died believing in Christ are lost!
verses.textEnNasb: Then also those who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
verses.textEn: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ are lost.

verses.textZh: 如果我们在基督里只在今生有盼望，就比所有人更可怜了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我们在基督里只在今生有盼望，就比所有人更可怜了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若靠基督只在今生有指望，就算比众人更可怜。
verses.textEnNiv: If only for this life we have hope in Christ, we are of all people most to be pitied.
verses.textEnEsv: If in Christ we have hope in this life only, we are of all people most to be pitied.
verses.textEnNkjv: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men the most pitiable.
verses.textEnNlt: And if our hope in Christ is only for this life, we are more to be pitied than anyone in the world.
verses.textEnNasb: If we have hoped in Christ only in this life, we are of all people most to be pitied.
verses.textEn: If only for this life we have hope in Christ, we are of all people most to be pitied.

verses.textZh: 现在基督已经从死人中复活，成为睡了的人初熟的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在基督已经从死人中复活，成为睡了的人初熟的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 但基督已经从死里复活，成为睡了之人初熟的果子。
verses.textEnNiv: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.
verses.textEnEsv: But in fact Christ has been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now Christ is risen from the dead, and has become the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.
verses.textEnNlt: But in fact, Christ has been raised from the dead. He is the first of a great harvest of all who have died.
verses.textEnNasb: But the fact is, Christ has been raised from the dead, the first fruits of those who are asleep.
verses.textEn: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

verses.textZh: 死既借着一人而来，死人复活也借着一人而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 死既借着一人而来，死人复活也借着一人而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 死既是因一人而来，死人复活也是因一人而来。
verses.textEnNiv: For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man.
verses.textEnEsv: For as by a man came death, by a man has come also the resurrection of the dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: For since by man came death, by Man also came the resurrection of the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: So you see, just as death came into the world through a man, now the resurrection from the dead has begun through another man.
verses.textEnNasb: For since by a man death came, by a Man also came the resurrection of the dead.
verses.textEn: For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man.

verses.textZh: 在亚当里众人都死了，照样，在基督里众人也都要复活；
verses.textZhCnvs: 在亚当里众人都死了，照样，在基督里众人也都要复活；
verses.textZhCuv: 在亚当里众人都死了；照样，在基督里众人也都要复活。
verses.textEnNiv: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.
verses.textEnEsv: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ shall all be made alive.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ all shall be made alive.
verses.textEnNlt: Just as everyone dies because we all belong to Adam, everyone who belongs to Christ will be given new life.
verses.textEnNasb: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.
verses.textEn: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.

verses.textZh: 只是各人要按着自己的次序：初熟的果子是基督，以后，在他来的时候，是那些属基督的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是各人要按着自己的次序：初熟的果子是基督，以后，在他来的时候，是那些属基督的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 但各人是按着自己的次序复活：初熟的果子是基督；以后，在他来的时候，是那些属基督的。
verses.textEnNiv: But each in turn: Christ, the firstfruits; then, when he comes, those who belong to him.
verses.textEnEsv: But each in his own order: Christ the firstfruits, then at his coming those who belong to Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: But each one in his own order: Christ the firstfruits, afterward those whoare Christ’s at His coming.
verses.textEnNlt: But there is an order to this resurrection: Christ was raised as the first of the harvest; then all who belong to Christ will be raised when he comes back.
verses.textEnNasb: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, after that those who are Christ’s at His coming,
verses.textEn: But each in turn: Christ, the firstfruits; then, when he comes, those who belong to him.

verses.textZh: 再后，末期到了的时候，基督把所有的统治者、掌权者和有能者都毁灭了，就把国度交给父神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 再后，末期到了的时候，基督把所有的统治者、掌权者和有能者都毁灭了，就把国度交给父神。
verses.textZhCuv: 再后，末期到了，那时基督既将一切执政的、掌权的、有能的都毁灭了，就把国交与父神。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the end will come, when he hands over the kingdom to God the Father after he has destroyed all dominion, authority and power.
verses.textEnEsv: Then comes the end, when he delivers the kingdom to God the Father after destroying every rule and every authority and power.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then comes the end, when He delivers the kingdom to God the Father, when He puts an end to all rule and all authority and power.
verses.textEnNlt: After that the end will come, when he will turn the Kingdom over to God the Father, having destroyed every ruler and authority and power.
verses.textEnNasb: then comes the end, when He hands over the kingdom to our God and Father, when He has abolished all rule and all authority and power.
verses.textEn: Then the end will come, when he hands over the kingdom to God the Father after he has destroyed all dominion, authority and power.

verses.textZh: 因为基督必要作王，直到神把所有的仇敌都放在他的脚下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为基督必要作王，直到神把所有的仇敌都放在他的脚下。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为基督必要作王，等神把一切仇敌都放在他的脚下。
verses.textEnNiv: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
verses.textEnEsv: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He must reign till He has put all enemies under His feet.
verses.textEnNlt: For Christ must reign until he humbles all his enemies beneath his feet.
verses.textEnNasb: For He must reign until He has put all His enemies under His feet.
verses.textEn: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

verses.textZh: 最后要毁灭的仇敌就是死，
verses.textZhCnvs: 最后要毁灭的仇敌就是死，
verses.textZhCuv: 尽末了所毁灭的仇敌就是死。
verses.textEnNiv: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.
verses.textEnEsv: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.
verses.textEnNkjv: The last enemy that will be destroyed is death.
verses.textEnNlt: And the last enemy to be destroyed is death.
verses.textEnNasb: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.
verses.textEn: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.

verses.textZh: 因为经上记着说："他使万物都服在他脚下。"既然说万物都服了他，显然那使万物服他的就不包括在内了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为经上记着说："他使万物都服在他脚下。"既然说万物都服了他，显然那使万物服他的就不包括在内了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为经上说：「神叫万物都服在他的脚下。」既说万物都服了他，明显那叫万物服他的，不在其内了。
verses.textEnNiv: For he "has put everything under his feet." Now when it says that "everything" has been put under him, it is clear that this does not include God himself, who put everything under Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: For "God has put all things in subjection under his feet." But when it says, "all things are put in subjection," it is plain that he is excepted who put all things in subjection under him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For "He has put all things under His feet." But when He says "all things are put under Him," itis evident that He who put all things under Him is excepted.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Scriptures say, "God has put all things under his authority." (Of course, when it says "all things are under his authority," that does not include God himself, who gave Christ his authority.)
verses.textEnNasb: For He has put all things in subjection under His feet. But when He says, "All things are put in subjection," it is clear that this excludes the Father who put all things in subjection to Him.
verses.textEn: For he "has put everything under his feet." Now when it says that "everything" has been put under him, it is clear that this does not include God himself, who put everything under Christ.

verses.textZh: 等到万物都服了他，那时子自己也要服那位叫万物服他的，好使神在万有之上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 等到万物都服了他，那时子自己也要服那位叫万物服他的，好使神在万有之上。
verses.textZhCuv: 万物既服了他，那时子也要自己服那叫万物服他的，叫神在万物之上，为万物之主。
verses.textEnNiv: When he has done this, then the Son himself will be made subject to him who put everything under him, so that God may be all in all.
verses.textEnEsv: When all things are subjected to him, then the Son himself will also be subjected to him who put all things in subjection under him, that God may be all in all.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when all things are made subject to Him, then the Son Himself will also be subject to Him who put all things under Him, that God may be all in all.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, when all things are under his authority, the Son will put himself under God’s authority, so that God, who gave his Son authority over all things, will be utterly supreme over everything everywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: When all things are subjected to Him, then the Son Himself will also be subjected to the One who subjected all things to Him, so that God may be all in all.
verses.textEn: When he has done this, then the Son himself will be made subject to him who put everything under him, so that God may be all in all.

verses.textZh: 不然，那些为死人受洗的，是为了甚么呢？如果死人根本不会复活，那么为甚么要为他们受洗呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 不然，那些为死人受洗的，是为了甚么呢？如果死人根本不会复活，那么为甚么要为他们受洗呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 不然，那些为死人受洗的，将来怎样呢？若死人总不复活，因何为他们受洗呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Now if there is no resurrection, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?
verses.textEnEsv: Otherwise, what do people mean by being baptized on behalf of the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized on their behalf?
verses.textEnNkjv: Otherwise, what will they do who are baptized for the dead, if the dead do not rise at all? Why then are they baptized for the dead?
verses.textEnNlt: If the dead will not be raised, what point is there in people being baptized for those who are dead? Why do it unless the dead will someday rise again?
verses.textEnNasb: For otherwise, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why then are they baptized for them?
verses.textEn: Now if there is no resurrection, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?

verses.textZh: 我们又为甚么时刻冒险呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们又为甚么时刻冒险呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我们又因何时刻冒险呢？
verses.textEnNiv: And as for us, why do we endanger ourselves every hour?
verses.textEnEsv: Why are we in danger every hour?
verses.textEnNkjv: And why do we stand in jeopardy every hour?
verses.textEnNlt: And why should we ourselves risk our lives hour by hour?
verses.textEnNasb: Why are we also in danger every hour?
verses.textEn: And as for us, why do we endanger ourselves every hour?

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我是天天冒死的，这是我凭着我在我们的主耶稣基督里，因你们而夸口说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我是天天冒死的，这是我凭着我在我们的主耶稣基督里，因你们而夸口说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我在我主基督耶稣里，指着你们所夸的口极力地说，我是天天冒死。
verses.textEnNiv: I face death every day—yes, just as surely as I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: I protest, brothers, by my pride in you, which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die every day!
verses.textEnNkjv: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
verses.textEnNlt: For I swear, dear brothers and sisters, that I face death daily. This is as certain as my pride in what Christ Jesus our Lord has done in you.
verses.textEnNasb: I affirm, brothers and sisters, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, that I die daily.
verses.textEn: I face death every day—yes, just as surely as I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.textZh: 我在以弗所和野兽搏斗，如果照着人的意思来看，那对我有甚么益处呢？如果死人不会复活， "我们就吃吃喝喝吧， 因为我们明天就要死了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在以弗所和野兽搏斗，如果照着人的意思来看，那对我有甚么益处呢？如果死人不会复活， "我们就吃吃喝喝吧， 因为我们明天就要死了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我若当日像寻常人，在以弗所同野兽战斗，那于我有什么益处呢？若死人不复活， 我们就吃吃喝喝吧！ 因为明天要死了。
verses.textEnNiv: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus with no more than human hopes, what have I gained? If the dead are not raised, "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die."
verses.textEnEsv: What do I gain if, humanly speaking, I fought with beasts at Ephesus? If the dead are not raised, "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die."
verses.textEnNkjv: If, in the manner of men, I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantage isit to me? If the dead do not rise, "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!"
verses.textEnNlt: And what value was there in fighting wild beasts—those people of Ephesus —if there will be no resurrection from the dead? And if there is no resurrection, "Let’s feast and drink, for tomorrow we die!"
verses.textEnNasb: If from human motives I fought with wild beasts at Ephesus, what good is it to me? If the dead are not raised, let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.
verses.textEn: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus with no more than human hopes, what have I gained? If the dead are not raised, "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die."

verses.textZh: 你们不要自欺， "滥交朋友是会败坏品德的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不要自欺， "滥交朋友是会败坏品德的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不要自欺；滥交是败坏善行。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be misled: "Bad company corrupts good character."
verses.textEnEsv: Do not be deceived: "Bad company ruins good morals."
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be deceived: "Evil company corrupts good habits."
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be fooled by those who say such things, for "bad company corrupts good character."
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be deceived: "Bad company corrupts good morals."
verses.textEn: Do not be misled: "Bad company corrupts good character."

verses.textZh: 你们理当醒悟过来，不要犯罪，因为你们中间有人不认识神；我说这话是要你们羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们理当醒悟过来，不要犯罪，因为你们中间有人不认识神；我说这话是要你们羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要醒悟为善，不要犯罪，因为有人不认识神。我说这话是要叫你们羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: Come back to your senses as you ought, and stop sinning; for there are some who are ignorant of God—I say this to your shame.
verses.textEnEsv: Wake up from your drunken stupor, as is right, and do not go on sinning. For some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
verses.textEnNkjv: Awake to righteousness, and do not sin; for some do not have the knowledge of God. I speak this to your shame.
verses.textEnNlt: Think carefully about what is right, and stop sinning. For to your shame I say that some of you don’t know God at all.
verses.textEnNasb: Sober up morally and stop sinning, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
verses.textEn: Come back to your senses as you ought, and stop sinning; for there are some who are ignorant of God—I say this to your shame.

verses.textZh: 但有人会说："死人怎样复活呢？要带着怎么样的身体来呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但有人会说："死人怎样复活呢？要带着怎么样的身体来呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 或有人问：「死人怎样复活，带着什么身体来呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But someone will ask, "How are the dead raised? With what kind of body will they come?"
verses.textEnEsv: But someone will ask, "How are the dead raised? With what kind of body do they come?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But someone will say, "How are the dead raised up? And with what body do they come?"
verses.textEnNlt: But someone may ask, "How will the dead be raised? What kind of bodies will they have?"
verses.textEnNasb: But someone will say, "How are the dead raised? And with what kind of body do they come?"
verses.textEn: But someone will ask, "How are the dead raised? With what kind of body will they come?"

verses.textZh: 无知的人哪，你所种的若不死去，就不能生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无知的人哪，你所种的若不死去，就不能生。
verses.textZhCuv: 无知的人哪，你所种的，若不死就不能生。
verses.textEnNiv: How foolish! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
verses.textEnEsv: You foolish person! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Foolish one, what you sow is not made alive unless it dies.
verses.textEnNlt: What a foolish question! When you put a seed into the ground, it doesn’t grow into a plant unless it dies first.
verses.textEnNasb: You fool! That which you sow does not come to life unless it dies;
verses.textEn: How foolish! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.

verses.textZh: 你们所种的，不是那将来要长成的形体，只不过是一粒种子，也许是麦子或别的种子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们所种的，不是那将来要长成的形体，只不过是一粒种子，也许是麦子或别的种子。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且你所种的不是那将来的形体，不过是子粒，即如麦子，或是别样的谷。
verses.textEnNiv: When you sow, you do not plant the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or of something else.
verses.textEnEsv: And what you sow is not the body that is to be, but a bare kernel, perhaps of wheat or of some other grain.
verses.textEnNkjv: And what you sow, you do not sow that body that shall be, but mere grain—perhaps wheat or some other grain.
verses.textEnNlt: And what you put in the ground is not the plant that will grow, but only a bare seed of wheat or whatever you are planting.
verses.textEnNasb: and that which you sow, you do not sow the body which is to be, but a bare grain, perhaps of wheat or of something else.
verses.textEn: When you sow, you do not plant the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or of something else.

verses.textZh: 但神随着自己的意思给它一个形体，给每一样种子各有自己的形体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但神随着自己的意思给它一个形体，给每一样种子各有自己的形体。
verses.textZhCuv: 但神随自己的意思给他一个形体，并叫各等子粒各有自己的形体。
verses.textEnNiv: But God gives it a body as he has determined, and to each kind of seed he gives its own body.
verses.textEnEsv: But God gives it a body as he has chosen, and to each kind of seed its own body.
verses.textEnNkjv: But God gives it a body as He pleases, and to each seed its own body.
verses.textEnNlt: Then God gives it the new body he wants it to have. A different plant grows from each kind of seed.
verses.textEnNasb: But God gives it a body just as He wished, and to each of the seeds a body of its own.
verses.textEn: But God gives it a body as he has determined, and to each kind of seed he gives its own body.

verses.textZh: 而且各种身体也都不一样，人有人的身体，兽有兽的身体，鸟有鸟的身体，鱼有鱼的身体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而且各种身体也都不一样，人有人的身体，兽有兽的身体，鸟有鸟的身体，鱼有鱼的身体。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡肉体各有不同：人是一样，兽又是一样，鸟又是一样，鱼又是一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Not all flesh is the same: People have one kind of flesh, animals have another, birds another and fish another.
verses.textEnEsv: For not all flesh is the same, but there is one kind for humans, another for animals, another for birds, and another for fish.
verses.textEnNkjv: All flesh is not the same flesh, but thereis one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.
verses.textEnNlt: Similarly there are different kinds of flesh—one kind for humans, another for animals, another for birds, and another for fish.
verses.textEnNasb: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of mankind, another flesh of animals, another flesh of birds, and another of fish.
verses.textEn: Not all flesh is the same: People have one kind of flesh, animals have another, birds another and fish another.

verses.textZh: 有天上的形体，也有地上的形体；天上形体的荣光是一样，地上形体的荣光又是一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有天上的形体，也有地上的形体；天上形体的荣光是一样，地上形体的荣光又是一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 有天上的形体，也有地上的形体；但天上形体的荣光是一样，地上形体的荣光又是一样。
verses.textEnNiv: There are also heavenly bodies and there are earthly bodies; but the splendor of the heavenly bodies is one kind, and the splendor of the earthly bodies is another.
verses.textEnEsv: There are heavenly bodies and earthly bodies, but the glory of the heavenly is of one kind, and the glory of the earthly is of another.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereare also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
verses.textEnNlt: There are also bodies in the heavens and bodies on the earth. The glory of the heavenly bodies is different from the glory of the earthly bodies.
verses.textEnNasb: There are also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies, but the glory of the heavenly is one, and the glory of the earthly is another.
verses.textEn: There are also heavenly bodies and there are earthly bodies; but the splendor of the heavenly bodies is one kind, and the splendor of the earthly bodies is another.

verses.textZh: 太阳有太阳的荣光，月亮有月亮的荣光，星星有星星的荣光，而且每一颗星的荣光也都不同。
verses.textZhCnvs: 太阳有太阳的荣光，月亮有月亮的荣光，星星有星星的荣光，而且每一颗星的荣光也都不同。
verses.textZhCuv: 日有日的荣光，月有月的荣光，星有星的荣光；这星和那星的荣光也有分别。
verses.textEnNiv: The sun has one kind of splendor, the moon another and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.
verses.textEnEsv: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for star differs from star in glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereis one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.
verses.textEnNlt: The sun has one kind of glory, while the moon and stars each have another kind. And even the stars differ from each other in their glory.
verses.textEnNasb: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for star differs from star in glory.
verses.textEn: The sun has one kind of splendor, the moon another and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.

verses.textZh: 死人复活也是这样。所种的是必朽坏的，复活的是不朽坏的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 死人复活也是这样。所种的是必朽坏的，复活的是不朽坏的；
verses.textZhCuv: 死人复活也是这样：所种的是必朽坏的，复活的是不朽坏的；
verses.textEnNiv: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead. The body that is sown is perishable, it is raised imperishable;
verses.textEnEsv: So is it with the resurrection of the dead. What is sown is perishable; what is raised is imperishable.
verses.textEnNkjv: So also is the resurrection of the dead. Thebody is sown in corruption, it is raised in incorruption.
verses.textEnNlt: It is the same way with the resurrection of the dead. Our earthly bodies are planted in the ground when we die, but they will be raised to live forever.
verses.textEnNasb: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown a perishable body, it is raised an imperishable body;
verses.textEn: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead. The body that is sown is perishable, it is raised imperishable;

verses.textZh: 所种的是卑贱的，复活的是荣耀的；所种的是软弱的，复活的是有能力的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 所种的是卑贱的，复活的是荣耀的；所种的是软弱的，复活的是有能力的；
verses.textZhCuv: 所种的是羞辱的，复活的是荣耀的；所种的是软弱的，复活的是强壮的；
verses.textEnNiv: it is sown in dishonor, it is raised in glory; it is sown in weakness, it is raised in power;
verses.textEnEsv: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
verses.textEnNkjv: It is sown in dishonor, it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness, it is raised in power.
verses.textEnNlt: Our bodies are buried in brokenness, but they will be raised in glory. They are buried in weakness, but they will be raised in strength.
verses.textEnNasb: it is sown in dishonor, it is raised in glory; it is sown in weakness, it is raised in power;
verses.textEn: it is sown in dishonor, it is raised in glory; it is sown in weakness, it is raised in power;

verses.textZh: 所种的是属血气的身体，复活的是属灵的身体。既然有属血气的身体，也会有属灵的身体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所种的是属血气的身体，复活的是属灵的身体。既然有属血气的身体，也会有属灵的身体。
verses.textZhCuv: 所种的是血气的身体，复活的是灵性的身体。若有血气的身体，也必有灵性的身体。
verses.textEnNiv: it is sown a natural body, it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.
verses.textEnEsv: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.
verses.textEnNkjv: It is sown a natural body, it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
verses.textEnNlt: They are buried as natural human bodies, but they will be raised as spiritual bodies. For just as there are natural bodies, there are also spiritual bodies.
verses.textEnNasb: it is sown a natural body, it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.
verses.textEn: it is sown a natural body, it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.

verses.textZh: 经上也是这样记着说："第一个人亚当成了有生命的活人，末后的亚当成了使人活的灵。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 经上也是这样记着说："第一个人亚当成了有生命的活人，末后的亚当成了使人活的灵。"
verses.textZhCuv: 经上也是这样记着说：「首先的人亚当成了有灵 的活人」；末后的亚当成了叫人活的灵。
verses.textEnNiv: So it is written: "The first man Adam became a living being" ; the last Adam, a life-giving spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus it is written, "The first man Adam became a living being"; the last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it is written, "The first man Adam became a living being." The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: The Scriptures tell us, "The first man, Adam, became a living person." But the last Adam—that is, Christ—is a life-giving Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: So also it is written: "The first man, Adam, became a living person." The last Adam was a life-giving spirit.
verses.textEn: So it is written: "The first man Adam became a living being" ; the last Adam, a life-giving spirit.

verses.textZh: 但那首先的不是属灵的，而是属血气的，然后才有属灵的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那首先的不是属灵的，而是属血气的，然后才有属灵的。
verses.textZhCuv: 但属灵的不在先，属血气的在先，以后才有属灵的。
verses.textEnNiv: The spiritual did not come first, but the natural, and after that the spiritual.
verses.textEnEsv: But it is not the spiritual that is first but the natural, and then the spiritual.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, the spiritual is not first, but the natural, and afterward the spiritual.
verses.textEnNlt: What comes first is the natural body, then the spiritual body comes later.
verses.textEnNasb: However, the spiritual is not first, but the natural; then the spiritual.
verses.textEn: The spiritual did not come first, but the natural, and after that the spiritual.

verses.textZh: 第一个人是出于地，是属土的；第二个人是出于天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一个人是出于地，是属土的；第二个人是出于天。
verses.textZhCuv: 头一个人是出于地，乃属土；第二个人是出于天。
verses.textEnNiv: The first man was of the dust of the earth; the second man is of heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: The first man was from the earth, a man of dust; the second man is from heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: The first man was of the earth, made of dust; the second Man is the Lord from heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: Adam, the first man, was made from the dust of the earth, while Christ, the second man, came from heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: The first man is from the earth, earthy; the second Man is from heaven.
verses.textEn: The first man was of the dust of the earth; the second man is of heaven.

verses.textZh: 那属土的怎样，所有属土的也都怎样；属天的怎样，所有属天的也都怎样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那属土的怎样，所有属土的也都怎样；属天的怎样，所有属天的也都怎样。
verses.textZhCuv: 那属土的怎样，凡属土的也就怎样；属天的怎样，凡属天的也就怎样。
verses.textEnNiv: As was the earthly man, so are those who are of the earth; and as is the heavenly man, so also are those who are of heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: As was the man of dust, so also are those who are of the dust, and as is the man of heaven, so also are those who are of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: As was the man of dust, so also are those whoaremade of dust; and as is the heavenly Man, so also are those whoare heavenly.
verses.textEnNlt: Earthly people are like the earthly man, and heavenly people are like the heavenly man.
verses.textEnNasb: As is the earthy one, so also are those who are earthy; and as is the heavenly One, so also are those who are heavenly.
verses.textEn: As was the earthly man, so are those who are of the earth; and as is the heavenly man, so also are those who are of heaven.

verses.textZh: 我们既然有了属土的形象，将来也必有属天的形象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们既然有了属土的形象，将来也必有属天的形象。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们既有属土的形状，将来也必有属天的形状。
verses.textEnNiv: And just as we have borne the image of the earthly man, so shall we bear the image of the heavenly man.
verses.textEnEsv: Just as we have borne the image of the man of dust, we shall also bear the image of the man of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as we have borne the image of the man of dust, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly Man.
verses.textEnNlt: Just as we are now like the earthly man, we will someday be like the heavenly man.
verses.textEnNasb: Just as we have borne the image of the earthy, we will also bear the image of the heavenly.
verses.textEn: And just as we have borne the image of the earthly man, so shall we bear the image of the heavenly man.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我告诉你们，血肉之体不能承受神的国，必朽坏的也不能承受那不朽坏的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我告诉你们，血肉之体不能承受神的国，必朽坏的也不能承受那不朽坏的。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我告诉你们说，血肉之体不能承受神的国，必朽坏的不能承受不朽坏的。
verses.textEnNiv: I declare to you, brothers and sisters, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God, nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.
verses.textEnEsv: I tell you this, brothers: flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God, nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; nor does corruption inherit incorruption.
verses.textEnNlt: What I am saying, dear brothers and sisters, is that our physical bodies cannot inherit the Kingdom of God. These dying bodies cannot inherit what will last forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I say this, brothers and sisters, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.
verses.textEn: I declare to you, brothers and sisters, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God, nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.

verses.textZh: 这必朽坏的必须穿上不朽坏的，这必死的必须穿上不死的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 这必朽坏的必须穿上不朽坏的，这必死的必须穿上不死的；
verses.textZhCuv: 我如今把一件奥秘的事告诉你们：我们不是都要睡觉，乃是都要改变，
verses.textEnNiv: Listen, I tell you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—
verses.textEnEsv: Behold! I tell you a mystery. We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I tell you a mystery: We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed—
verses.textEnNlt: But let me reveal to you a wonderful secret. We will not all die, but we will all be transformed!
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I am telling you a mystery; we will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,
verses.textEn: Listen, I tell you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—

verses.textZh: 这必朽坏的既穿上了不朽坏的，这必死的既穿上了不死的，那时，经上的话就应验了： "胜利了！死亡已经被吞灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这必朽坏的既穿上了不朽坏的，这必死的既穿上了不死的，那时，经上的话就应验了： "胜利了！死亡已经被吞灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 就在一霎时，眨眼之间，号筒末次吹响的时候。因号筒要响，死人要复活成为不朽坏的，我们也要改变。
verses.textEnNiv: in a flash, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.
verses.textEnEsv: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised imperishable, and we shall be changed.
verses.textEnNkjv: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
verses.textEnNlt: It will happen in a moment, in the blink of an eye, when the last trumpet is blown. For when the trumpet sounds, those who have died will be raised to live forever. And we who are living will also be transformed.
verses.textEnNasb: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet; for the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.
verses.textEn: in a flash, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.

verses.textZh: 死亡啊！你的胜利在哪里？ 死亡啊！你的毒刺在哪里？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 死亡啊！你的胜利在哪里？ 死亡啊！你的毒刺在哪里？"
verses.textZhCuv: 这必朽坏的总要变成 不朽坏的，这必死的总要变成不死的。
verses.textEnNiv: For the perishable must clothe itself with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality.
verses.textEnEsv: For this perishable body must put on the imperishable, and this mortal body must put on immortality.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
verses.textEnNlt: For our dying bodies must be transformed into bodies that will never die; our mortal bodies must be transformed into immortal bodies.
verses.textEnNasb: For this perishable must put on the imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.
verses.textEn: For the perishable must clothe itself with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality.

verses.textZh: 死的毒刺就是罪，罪的权势就是律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 死的毒刺就是罪，罪的权势就是律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 这必朽坏的既变成不朽坏的，这必死的既变成不死的，那时经上所记「死被得胜吞灭」的话就应验了。
verses.textEnNiv: When the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality, then the saying that is written will come true: "Death has been swallowed up in victory."
verses.textEnEsv: When the perishable puts on the imperishable, and the mortal puts on immortality, then shall come to pass the saying that is written: "Death is swallowed up in victory."
verses.textEnNkjv: So when this corruptible has put on incorruption, and this mortal has put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written: "Death is swallowed up in victory."
verses.textEnNlt: Then, when our dying bodies have been transformed into bodies that will never die, this Scripture will be fulfilled: "Death is swallowed up in victory.
verses.textEnNasb: But when this perishable puts on the imperishable, and this mortal puts on immortality, then will come about the saying that is written: "Death has been swallowed up in victory.
verses.textEn: When the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality, then the saying that is written will come true: "Death has been swallowed up in victory."

verses.textZh: 感谢神，他借着我们的主耶稣基督，把胜利赐给我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 感谢神，他借着我们的主耶稣基督，把胜利赐给我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 死啊！你得胜的权势在哪里？ 死啊！你的毒钩在哪里？
verses.textEnNiv: "Where, O death, is your victory? Where, O death, is your sting?"
verses.textEnEsv: "O death, where is your victory? O death, where is your sting?"
verses.textEnNkjv: "O Death, where is your sting? O Hades, where is your victory?"
verses.textEnNlt: O death, where is your victory? O death, where is your sting? "
verses.textEnNasb: Where, O Death, is your victory? Where, O Death, is your sting?"
verses.textEn: "Where, O death, is your victory? Where, O death, is your sting?"

verses.textZh: 所以，我亲爱的弟兄们，你们务要坚固，不可动摇，常常竭力多作主工，因为知道你们的劳苦，在主里面不是徒然的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我亲爱的弟兄们，你们务要坚固，不可动摇，常常竭力多作主工，因为知道你们的劳苦，在主里面不是徒然的。
verses.textZhCuv: 死的毒钩就是罪，罪的权势就是律法。
verses.textEnNiv: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
verses.textEnEsv: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sting of death is sin, and the strength of sin is the law.
verses.textEnNlt: For sin is the sting that results in death, and the law gives sin its power.
verses.textEnNasb: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the Law;
verses.textEn: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

verses.textZh: 感谢神，使我们藉着我们的主耶稣基督得胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 感谢神，使我们藉着我们的主耶稣基督得胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 感谢神，使我们藉着我们的主耶稣基督得胜。
verses.textEnNiv: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: But thank God! He gives us victory over sin and death through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: but thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 所以，我亲爱的弟兄们，你们务要坚固，不可摇动，常常竭力多做主工；因为知道，你们的劳苦在主里面不是徒然的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我亲爱的弟兄们，你们务要坚固，不可摇动，常常竭力多做主工；因为知道，你们的劳苦在主里面不是徒然的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我亲爱的弟兄们，你们务要坚固，不可摇动，常常竭力多做主工；因为知道，你们的劳苦在主里面不是徒然的。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, my dear brothers and sisters, stand firm. Let nothing move you. Always give yourselves fully to the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, knowing that in the Lord your labor is not in vain.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, knowing that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So, my dear brothers and sisters, be strong and immovable. Always work enthusiastically for the Lord, for you know that nothing you do for the Lord is ever useless.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, my beloved brothers and sisters, be firm, immovable, always excelling in the work of the Lord, knowing that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
verses.textEn: Therefore, my dear brothers and sisters, stand firm. Let nothing move you. Always give yourselves fully to the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.

verses.textZh: 关于捐献给圣徒的事，从前我怎样吩咐加拉太的众教会，你们也要照着去行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于捐献给圣徒的事，从前我怎样吩咐加拉太的众教会，你们也要照着去行。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到为圣徒捐钱，我从前怎样吩咐加拉太的众教会，你们也当怎样行。
verses.textEnNiv: Now about the collection for the Lord’s people: Do what I told the Galatian churches to do.
verses.textEnEsv: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I directed the churches of Galatia, so you also are to do.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given orders to the churches of Galatia, so you must do also:
verses.textEnNlt: Now regarding your question about the money being collected for God’s people in Jerusalem. You should follow the same procedure I gave to the churches in Galatia.
verses.textEnNasb: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I directed the churches of Galatia, so you are to do as well.
verses.textEn: Now about the collection for the Lord’s people: Do what I told the Galatian churches to do.

verses.textZh: 每逢七日的第一日，你们各人要按着自己的收入抽一些出来留着，免得我来的时候才现凑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每逢七日的第一日，你们各人要按着自己的收入抽一些出来留着，免得我来的时候才现凑。
verses.textZhCuv: 每逢七日的第一日，各人要照自己的进项抽出来留着，免得我来的时候现凑。
verses.textEnNiv: On the first day of every week, each one of you should set aside a sum of money in keeping with your income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will have to be made.
verses.textEnEsv: On the first day of every week, each of you is to put something aside and store it up, as he may prosper, so that there will be no collecting when I come.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the first day of the week let each one of you lay something aside, storing up as he may prosper, that there be no collections when I come.
verses.textEnNlt: On the first day of each week, you should each put aside a portion of the money you have earned. Don’t wait until I get there and then try to collect it all at once.
verses.textEnNasb: On the first day of every week, each of you is to put aside and save as he may prosper, so that no collections need to be made when I come.
verses.textEn: On the first day of every week, each one of you should set aside a sum of money in keeping with your income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will have to be made.

verses.textZh: 我来到之后，你们选中了甚么人，我就派他们带着书信，把你们的捐款送到耶路撒冷去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我来到之后，你们选中了甚么人，我就派他们带着书信，把你们的捐款送到耶路撒冷去。
