verses.textZhCuv: 及至我来到了，你们写信举荐谁，我就打发他们，把你们的捐资送到耶路撒冷去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then, when I arrive, I will give letters of introduction to the men you approve and send them with your gift to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And when I arrive, I will send those whom you accredit by letter to carry your gift to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when I come, whomever you approve by your letters I will send to bear your gift to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: When I come, I will write letters of recommendation for the messengers you choose to deliver your gift to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: When I arrive, whomever you approve, I will send them with letters to take your gift to Jerusalem;
verses.textEn: Then, when I arrive, I will give letters of introduction to the men you approve and send them with your gift to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 如果我也应该去，他们就可以和我一同去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我也应该去，他们就可以和我一同去。
verses.textZhCuv: 若我也该去，他们可以和我同去。
verses.textEnNiv: If it seems advisable for me to go also, they will accompany me.
verses.textEnEsv: If it seems advisable that I should go also, they will accompany me.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if it is fitting that I go also, they will go with me.
verses.textEnNlt: And if it seems appropriate for me to go along, they can travel with me.
verses.textEnNasb: and if it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.
verses.textEn: If it seems advisable for me to go also, they will accompany me.

verses.textZh: 我现在正要路过马其顿。过了马其顿，我就会到你们那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我现在正要路过马其顿。过了马其顿，我就会到你们那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要从马其顿经过；既经过了，就要到你们那里去，
verses.textEnNiv: After I go through Macedonia, I will come to you—for I will be going through Macedonia.
verses.textEnEsv: I will visit you after passing through Macedonia, for I intend to pass through Macedonia,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I will come to you when I pass through Macedonia (for I am passing through Macedonia).
verses.textEnNlt: I am coming to visit you after I have been to Macedonia, for I am planning to travel through Macedonia.
verses.textEnNasb: But I will come to you after I go through Macedonia; for I am going through Macedonia,
verses.textEn: After I go through Macedonia, I will come to you—for I will be going through Macedonia.

verses.textZh: 我也许会和你们同住一些时候，甚至和你们一同过冬；这样，我无论要到哪里去，你们都可以给我送行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也许会和你们同住一些时候，甚至和你们一同过冬；这样，我无论要到哪里去，你们都可以给我送行。
verses.textZhCuv: 或者和你们同住几时，或者也过冬。无论我往哪里去，你们就可以给我送行。
verses.textEnNiv: Perhaps I will stay with you for a while, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go.
verses.textEnEsv: and perhaps I will stay with you or even spend the winter, so that you may help me on my journey, wherever I go.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it may be that I will remain, or even spend the winter with you, that you may send me on my journey, wherever I go.
verses.textEnNlt: Perhaps I will stay awhile with you, possibly all winter, and then you can send me on my way to my next destination.
verses.textEnNasb: and perhaps I will stay with you or even spend the winter, so that you may send me on my way wherever I go.
verses.textEn: Perhaps I will stay with you for a while, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go.

verses.textZh: 我不愿意只是顺路见见你们，主若许可，我盼望和你们同住一个时期。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不愿意只是顺路见见你们，主若许可，我盼望和你们同住一个时期。
verses.textZhCuv: 我如今不愿意路过见你们；主若许我，我就指望和你们同住几时。
verses.textEnNiv: For I do not want to see you now and make only a passing visit; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.
verses.textEnEsv: For I do not want to see you now just in passing. I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I do not wish to see you now on the way; but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.
verses.textEnNlt: This time I don’t want to make just a short visit and then go right on. I want to come and stay awhile, if the Lord will let me.
verses.textEnNasb: For I do not want to see you now just in passing; for I hope to remain with you for some time, if the Lord permits.
verses.textEn: For I do not want to see you now and make only a passing visit; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.

verses.textZh: 不过我要在以弗所住到五旬节，
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过我要在以弗所住到五旬节，
verses.textZhCuv: 但我要仍旧住在以弗所，直等到五旬节；
verses.textEnNiv: But I will stay on at Ephesus until Pentecost,
verses.textEnEsv: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will tarry in Ephesus until Pentecost.
verses.textEnNlt: In the meantime, I will be staying here at Ephesus until the Festival of Pentecost.
verses.textEnNasb: But I will remain in Ephesus until Pentecost;
verses.textEn: But I will stay on at Ephesus until Pentecost,

verses.textZh: 因为这里有又宽大又有果效的门为我开了，同时反对的人也很多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这里有又宽大又有果效的门为我开了，同时反对的人也很多。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为有宽大又有功效的门为我开了，并且反对的人也多。
verses.textEnNiv: because a great door for effective work has opened to me, and there are many who oppose me.
verses.textEnEsv: for a wide door for effective work has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.
verses.textEnNkjv: For a great and effective door has opened to me, and thereare many adversaries.
verses.textEnNlt: There is a wide-open door for a great work here, although many oppose me.
verses.textEnNasb: for a wide door for effective service has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.
verses.textEn: because a great door for effective work has opened to me, and there are many who oppose me.

verses.textZh: 如果提摩太来了，你们务要使他在你们那里不会惧怕，因为他像我一样是作主的工作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果提摩太来了，你们务要使他在你们那里不会惧怕，因为他像我一样是作主的工作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 若是提摩太来到，你们要留心，叫他在你们那里无所惧怕；因为他劳力做主的工，像我一样。
verses.textEnNiv: When Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is carrying on the work of the Lord, just as I am.
verses.textEnEsv: When Timothy comes, see that you put him at ease among you, for he is doing the work of the Lord, as I am.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if Timothy comes, see that he may be with you without fear; for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
verses.textEnNlt: When Timothy comes, don’t intimidate him. He is doing the Lord’s work, just as I am.
verses.textEnNasb: Now if Timothy comes, see that he has no reason to be afraid while among you, for he is doing the Lord’s work, as I also am.
verses.textEn: When Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is carrying on the work of the Lord, just as I am.

verses.textZh: 所以，谁也不要小看他。你们要送他平平安安地前行，使他到我这里来，因为我正在等着他和弟兄们一同来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，谁也不要小看他。你们要送他平平安安地前行，使他到我这里来，因为我正在等着他和弟兄们一同来。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，无论谁都不可藐视他，只要送他平安前行，叫他到我这里来，因我指望他和弟兄们同来。
verses.textEnNiv: No one, then, should treat him with contempt. Send him on his way in peace so that he may return to me. I am expecting him along with the brothers.
verses.textEnEsv: So let no one despise him. Help him on his way in peace, that he may return to me, for I am expecting him with the brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore let no one despise him. But send him on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I am waiting for him with the brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let anyone treat him with contempt. Send him on his way with your blessing when he returns to me. I expect him to come with the other believers.
verses.textEnNasb: So do not look down on him, anyone. But send him on his way in peace, so that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.
verses.textEn: No one, then, should treat him with contempt. Send him on his way in peace so that he may return to me. I am expecting him along with the brothers.

verses.textZh: 至于亚波罗弟兄，我曾再三劝他要和弟兄们一同到你们那里去；但他不愿意现在就去，机会到了，他是会去的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于亚波罗弟兄，我曾再三劝他要和弟兄们一同到你们那里去；但他不愿意现在就去，机会到了，他是会去的。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于兄弟亚波罗，我再三地劝他同弟兄们到你们那里去；但这时他决不愿意去，几时有了机会他必去。
verses.textEnNiv: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. He was quite unwilling to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.
verses.textEnEsv: Now concerning our brother Apollos, I strongly urged him to visit you with the other brothers, but it was not at all his will to come now. He will come when he has opportunity.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now concerning our brother Apollos, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brethren, but he was quite unwilling to come at this time; however, he will come when he has a convenient time.
verses.textEnNlt: Now about our brother Apollos—I urged him to visit you with the other believers, but he was not willing to go right now. He will see you later when he has the opportunity.
verses.textEnNasb: Now concerning our brother Apollos, I strongly encouraged him to come to you with the brothers; and it was not at all his desire to come now, but he will come when he has the opportunity.
verses.textEn: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. He was quite unwilling to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.

verses.textZh: 你们要警醒，要在信仰上站立得稳，要作大丈夫，要刚强。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要警醒，要在信仰上站立得稳，要作大丈夫，要刚强。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们务要警醒，在真道上站立得稳，要作大丈夫，要刚强。
verses.textEnNiv: Be on your guard; stand firm in the faith; be courageous; be strong.
verses.textEnEsv: Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong.
verses.textEnNkjv: Watch, stand fast in the faith, be brave, be strong.
verses.textEnNlt: Be on guard. Stand firm in the faith. Be courageous. Be strong.
verses.textEnNasb: Be on the alert, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong.
verses.textEn: Be on your guard; stand firm in the faith; be courageous; be strong.

verses.textZh: 你们所作的一切，都要凭爱心去作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们所作的一切，都要凭爱心去作。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡你们所做的都要凭爱心而做。
verses.textEnNiv: Do everything in love.
verses.textEnEsv: Let all that you do be done in love.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let all that you do be done with love.
verses.textEnNlt: And do everything with love.
verses.textEnNasb: All that you do must be done in love.
verses.textEn: Do everything in love.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，你们知道司提反一家人是亚该亚初结的果子，他们专心地服事圣徒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，你们知道司提反一家人是亚该亚初结的果子，他们专心地服事圣徒。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，你们晓得司提反一家，是亚该亚初结的果子，并且他们专以服事圣徒为念。
verses.textEnNiv: You know that the household of Stephanas were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the Lord’s people. I urge you, brothers and sisters,
verses.textEnEsv: Now I urge you, brothers —you know that the household of Stephanas were the first converts in Achaia, and that they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints—
verses.textEnNkjv: I urge you, brethren—you know the household of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have devoted themselves to the ministry of the saints—
verses.textEnNlt: You know that Stephanas and his household were the first of the harvest of believers in Greece, and they are spending their lives in service to God’s people. I urge you, dear brothers and sisters,
verses.textEnNasb: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters: you know the household of Stephanas, that they are the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have devoted themselves to ministry to the saints;
verses.textEn: You know that the household of Stephanas were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the Lord’s people. I urge you, brothers and sisters,

verses.textZh: 我劝你们要顺服这样的人，和所有与他们一同工作一同劳苦的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我劝你们要顺服这样的人，和所有与他们一同工作一同劳苦的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我劝你们顺服这样的人，并一切同工同劳的人。
verses.textEnNiv: to submit to such people and to everyone who joins in the work and labors at it.
verses.textEnEsv: be subject to such as these, and to every fellow worker and laborer.
verses.textEnNkjv: that you also submit to such, and to everyone who works and labors with us.
verses.textEnNlt: to submit to them and others like them who serve with such devotion.
verses.textEnNasb: I urge that you also be subject to such as these and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.
verses.textEn: to submit to such people and to everyone who joins in the work and labors at it.

verses.textZh: 司提反、福徒拿都和亚该古都来了，所以我很快乐，因为他们补上了你们的不足，
verses.textZhCnvs: 司提反、福徒拿都和亚该古都来了，所以我很快乐，因为他们补上了你们的不足，
verses.textZhCuv: 司提反和福徒拿都，并亚该古到这里来，我很喜欢；因为你们待我有不及之处，他们补上了。
verses.textEnNiv: I was glad when Stephanas, Fortunatus and Achaicus arrived, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.
verses.textEnEsv: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus, because they have made up for your absence,
verses.textEnNkjv: I am glad about the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus, for what was lacking on your part they supplied.
verses.textEnNlt: I am very glad that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have come here. They have been providing the help you weren’t here to give me.
verses.textEnNasb: I rejoice over the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus, because they have supplied what was lacking on your part.
verses.textEn: I was glad when Stephanas, Fortunatus and Achaicus arrived, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.

verses.textZh: 使我和你们的心都得着畅快。这样的人你们要敬重他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使我和你们的心都得着畅快。这样的人你们要敬重他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们叫我和你们心里都快活。这样的人，你们务要敬重。
verses.textEnNiv: For they refreshed my spirit and yours also. Such men deserve recognition.
verses.textEnEsv: for they refreshed my spirit as well as yours. Give recognition to such people.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge such men.
verses.textEnNlt: They have been a wonderful encouragement to me, as they have been to you. You must show your appreciation to all who serve so well.
verses.textEnNasb: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge such men.
verses.textEn: For they refreshed my spirit and yours also. Such men deserve recognition.

verses.textZh: 亚西亚的众教会都问候你们。亚居拉和百基拉，以及他们家里的教会在主里再三问候你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚西亚的众教会都问候你们。亚居拉和百基拉，以及他们家里的教会在主里再三问候你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚细亚的众教会问你们安。亚居拉和百基拉并在他们家里的教会，因主多多地问你们安。
verses.textEnNiv: The churches in the province of Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.
verses.textEnEsv: The churches of Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Prisca, together with the church in their house, send you hearty greetings in the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: The churches of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you heartily in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
verses.textEnNlt: The churches here in the province of Asia send greetings in the Lord, as do Aquila and Priscilla and all the others who gather in their home for church meetings.
verses.textEnNasb: The churches of Asia greet you. Aquila and Prisca greet you heartily in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
verses.textEn: The churches in the province of Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.

verses.textZh: 所有的弟兄都问候你们。你们要用圣洁的亲吻彼此问安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的弟兄都问候你们。你们要用圣洁的亲吻彼此问安。
verses.textZhCuv: 众弟兄都问你们安。你们要亲嘴问安，彼此务要圣洁。
verses.textEnNiv: All the brothers and sisters here send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
verses.textEnEsv: All the brothers send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the brethren greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
verses.textEnNlt: All the brothers and sisters here send greetings to you. Greet each other with a sacred kiss.
verses.textEnNasb: All the brothers and sisters greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
verses.textEn: All the brothers and sisters here send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

verses.textZh: 我保罗亲笔问候你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我保罗亲笔问候你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我－保罗亲笔问安。
verses.textEnNiv: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand.
verses.textEnEsv: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: The salutation with my own hand—Paul’s.
verses.textEnNlt: Here is my greeting in my own handwriting—Paul.
verses.textEnNasb: The greeting is in my own hand—that of Paul.
verses.textEn: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand.

verses.textZh: 如果有人不爱主，他就该受咒诅。主啊，愿你来！
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人不爱主，他就该受咒诅。主啊，愿你来！
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人不爱主，这人可诅可咒。主必要来！
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone does not love the Lord, let that person be cursed! Come, Lord !
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone has no love for the Lord, let him be accursed. Our Lord, come!
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone does not love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be accursed. O Lord, come!
verses.textEnNlt: If anyone does not love the Lord, that person is cursed. Our Lord, come!
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone does not love the Lord, he is to be accursed. Maranatha!
verses.textEn: If anyone does not love the Lord, let that person be cursed! Come, Lord !

verses.textZh: 愿主耶稣基督的恩惠与你们同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿主耶稣基督的恩惠与你们同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿主耶稣基督的恩常与你们众人同在！
verses.textEnNiv: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.
verses.textEnEsv: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.textEnNlt: May the grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.
verses.textEnNasb: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.
verses.textEn: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.

verses.textZh: 我的爱在基督耶稣里也与你们同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的爱在基督耶稣里也与你们同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在基督耶稣里的爱与你们众人同在。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.textEn: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
